programme.title: SeaFoam Camaro Finish Up and Payoff
programme.desc: With the SeaFoam Camaro finished up, it is time to see what all those upgrades have done for our Restomod Giveaway. Then we help a viewer with some repairs on their vehicle on another Driveway Rescue

programme.title: How To Set Up A Rear End To Meet Factory Tolerances On A Chevy Tahoe
programme.desc: While freshening up the old drum brakes on our '96 Chevy Tahoe, we noticed that we have a sloppy rear end. We'll tear down the ring and pinion and show you how to put it all back together, making sure our Tahoe's rear end is nice and tight.

programme.title: How to Install a Convertible Top
programme.desc: Step by step, we install a new top on our 1966 Pontiac convertible. Plus, a High Performance visit to Las Vegas for LS Fest West.

programme.title: The Perfect Fit For The '71 Chevy Caprice Body Panels
programme.desc: A touch of glass - We begin to piece our '71 Caprice Fat Stack back together, installing the front and rear glass as well as the hood, deck lid, and body panels showing you some how-to-hints for favorable fitment.

programme.title: Hard Charger Power Plant Reveal
programme.desc: It's time to reveal the engine that's going to power the 1969 Charger project, and a viewer's Chevelle gets a helping hand with a Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: Pulling The L28 Out Of Our 1978 Datsun 280Z Heritage Restomod
programme.desc: We start tearing into the powertrain of our Datsun 280Z, freshening up the engine and converting the automatic transmission to a sportier manual setup. We'll also take a look at the new Nissan Z!

programme.title: Project Rapid Runner is Complete - SEMA Build Part 2
programme.desc: Challenging times are coming as the deadline of Project Rapid Runner comes into view. Chris and Eric's 2025 Nissan Frontier Pro 4X still has a ton of work needed to finish up in time for SEMA. Can they do it?

programme.title: Chevy DragAlanche - Part 3 The Ultimate Hook-Up
programme.desc: Our Chevy Avalanche, Project DragAlanche, gets a stronger rear end featuring beefier gears and an upgraded braking system built to handle increased performance. Then the factory rear suspension is replaced with a fully adjustable 4-link setup, providing the tuning capability and traction needed for maximum grip and consistent launches down the drag strip.

programme.title: How to Build a Higher Power Diesel Beast
programme.desc: Modifying a Duramax to make high power starts with a teardown and some machining before the new performance parts are added. Plus Austin mods up the body for a cool clean look.

programme.title: Faux Guy Square Body Shifts Into Gear With A New Transfer Case
programme.desc: Our K-10 Square body is starting to come back to life. The cab, body panels and bed all get reassembled. We add cooling, electrical, resto parts and measure the driveshaft and finalize the transmission linkage. The end is in sight!

programme.title: Turning A Mazda Miata From Street Car to Spec Race Car - Part 1
programme.desc: The Carcass crew heads out to the NCM Motorsports Park for a High Performance Driving Experience! Then they take their new project car, a Mazda Miata, out on the track to get baseline numbers! Plus we add performance parts to get a boost in power!

programme.title: Transforming A '72 Dodge Dart From Lawn Ornament To Pavement Pounder
programme.desc: A '72 Dodge Dart gets a second lease on life after an eight-year outdoor slumber.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 7 - Midnight Masterpiece
programme.desc: Clutch performance - Today Tommy and Joel install a new third pedal and show you the do's and don'ts on how to bleed the transmission to make your ride run smooth. Then, the dash gets an upgrade but its aesthetic stays true to its retro-glory.

programme.title: Project Rapid Runner Introduction - SEMA Build Part 1
programme.desc: Chris and Eric begin the craziest build of the season: A 2025 Nissan Frontier Pro 4X for the ultimate kayak enthusiast. They're calling it "Rapid Runner" and the plan is simple: build the best kayaking vehicle in the world. The craziest thing of all, they've only got one month to do it.

programme.title: Laying The Foundation To Rebuild A GM 4.3L V6
programme.desc: The first steps you take in building any engine can lay the foundation for a reliable powerplant that lives up to its potential.

programme.title: Ultimate 318 LA: Part 2
programme.desc: Our small block 318 Mopar returns to be prettied up and completed on this episode. We cover it in a custom color and go through a detailed assembly process to get it ready for our Dyno. But things go sideways during the testing with our 318, first making excellent power then revealing major problems, and we hope we caught it in time.

programme.title: Building a Windsor Stroker
programme.desc: There's a surefire way to make more horsepower for our Windsor, Make it a Stroker! Plus, all new dyno room - Meet Cellblock D!

programme.title: Road Course Camaro Part 13 Final Systems Check
programme.desc: The Carcass crew add some vital parts to their '72 Camaro, installing the fuel system and working on the cooling system. They install the new carbon fiber drive shaft before testing it on the chassis dyno.

programme.title: 700 Horsepower Shelby GT500 Debut
programme.desc: The North American Auto Show in Detroit introduces the powerful, sleek, and radical Shelby GT500.

programme.title: Junkyard Ford 390 FE Teardown and Rebuild
programme.desc: Mike and Pat stroke a vintage junkyard Ford 390 but an unexpected surprise puts a delay in their progress. Then it's full steam ahead for finding the limit for this big block stump puller

programme.title: Modding a Mustang GT for an Aggressive Look
programme.desc: We add a body kit and a wrap to our EBC Brakes giveaway Mustang plus, Tommy and Marc bring back the Hellcat '69 Charger.

programme.title: Diesel Deconstruction
programme.desc: With Dragonali about to get torn down, we discuss what goes into planning and building your diesel project truck.

programme.title: Stock To Stacked: Bumper, Tire, and Suspension Upgrades To A 2021 Bronco
programme.desc: We pull a brand new 2021 Ford Bronco into the shop and make it better! Better bumpers, wheels & tires, steps, and a lift. You'll get our full review of this popular SUV!

programme.title: Modding A Jeep Wrangler JK Into An Extreme Off-Road Weekend Warrior Part 1
programme.desc: The team ventures to the north Georgia mountains to pick up and test an '07 Jeep Wrangler JK, then we head to the Summit Racing store in search of parts to mod it for extreme off-road fun!

programme.title: Small Block Showdown Round 4
programme.desc: Our 305 Small Block Chevy and 302 Small Block Ford return for another round of the brand loyalty war. In this matchup, both engines get aftermarket higher flowing induction and solid roller valvetrain to increase their RPM range and power. We'll find out if the stalemate ends and if the Blue Oval or the Bowtie comes out on top.

programme.title: Field of Dreams
programme.desc: Yard Work - Tommy and Joel hit the road to introduce two new Detroit Muscle project builds: a 1956 Chevy 210 and an A-Body Mopar they hope will hit the bullseye for their vision. Their destination: Stephen's Performance, a muscle car graveyard with the world's largest collection of Mopars.

programme.title: Building the Beast - Project UnSanctioned Part 4
programme.desc: Our 2001 BMW race car gets a set of coilovers, as well as big brake upgrade. Then we change the aerodynamics of our project to give it a fierce look.

programme.title: SeaFoam Camaro Part 4/Matco Tool Expo
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc finish up the last few details on our '69 SeaFoam Camaro. Plus a mechanics fantasy land we head to California for the Matco Tools Expo to see what new products they have coming out.

programme.title: Cooling Down & Increasing Power On The '71 Chevy Caprice
programme.desc: Cool Running - We install the cooling system on our '71 Caprice and then put the pedal to the metal to give you the lowdown on electronic throttle vs mechanical.

programme.title: Busting Rust & Mending Dents On The '71 Caprice - Fat Stack Part 4
programme.desc: We make repairs on Fat Stack, a 1971 Chevy Caprice, showing you how to remove rust and pull dents. Then, we'll cruise around in a '73 Camaro to diagnose what needs fixing as we help another viewer with a Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: Complete Rebuild Of An AMC 304 Including Adding Port Fuel Injection
programme.desc: We take the original anemic 304 powerplant from an AMC Javelin, and turn it into a high-tech muscle car bullet with some bite!

programme.title: Building a Mudracing Willys Mega Truck
programme.desc: Let the cutting, grinding, and blasting begin! We're boxing the frame on our 1963 Wicked Wet Willys in preparation for an 1100+ horsepower bullet from Engine Power.

programme.title: Ford F-250 Project Part 1: Heavy Hauling
programme.desc: The MCT guys bring in the F-250 shop truck for some upgrades to help with hauling our fleet of trailers. They install a gooseneck receiver hitch and air lift suspension. Plus they'll upgrade the braking capabilities to help slow down those heavy haulers.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 11: Built to Cruise
programme.desc: Project Cream Puff just needs a few final touches before it's ready to hit the road. We'll add a custom interior to match that sharp exterior, then put our '72 C-10 through its paces-both on the dyno and out on the street-to make sure Cream Puff is ready for whatever we throw at it.

programme.title: The Perfect Project Car?
programme.desc: Can our budget build rival a new Lexus? For our first project, we're taking a bone stock 2011 Lexus IS 250 and spending as little as possible to make it look and drive like a 2025.

programme.title: Will This Junkyard 1977 C-30 Square Body Tow Truck Start?
programme.desc: The Carcass Duo find a left for dead tow truck that they want to give a new life through fabrication and a little imagination.

programme.title: Mocking Up a New 1974 Bronco
programme.desc: It's time to mock everything in place in our 1974 Bronco. We'll also have the frame blasted and powder coated, the body in epoxy, and assembled to the frame.

programme.title: Slammed '65 C10 Fleetside
programme.desc: The '65 C10 Fleetside gets a coilover conversion that will slam her to the ground!

programme.title: Spec Miata Hammers Down at the Track
programme.desc: We show you painting tips on how to properly prep your aging clear coat for paint. Then we give our Mazda a fresh look before heading to the track to test those performance parts!

programme.title: Lifting Big with 8" BDS Coilover Conversion and 35" Tires
programme.desc: We jack up the '14 Silverado and add big wheels, tires, and brake upgrades.

programme.title: Stroking Our Favorite Big Blocks (and One Small Block) For More Power
programme.desc: There's no replacement for displacement! We stroke some of our favorite engines, looking for all the horsepower we can find.

programme.title: Dirt Oval Destroyer
programme.desc: The UNOH motor sports team pays a visit to Engine Power to build a race-ready small block to meet the new class rules at their local dirt track. The students help us put together a 434ci small block with 23 degree heads for the competitive stock car class. Once it's completed, we prove it's race-ready on the Dyno and look for big gains over their previous powerplants.

programme.title: Grandma's Beige Buick Regal Gets a Splash of Color
programme.desc: The '85 Buick is ready for some fit and finish with body work and candy paint.

programme.title: Why This Can Am Baja Bug Conversion Is So Retro Rad
programme.desc: Baja Style bug gets a 80's retro style paint job to go along with a long travel suspension before the Carcass team takes this incredible combo to Dirty Turtle Offroad Park. This is Part 3 of 3 of the BajAwesome build.

programme.title: Taking our '69 Camaro into the Modern Era
programme.desc: We take our '69 Camaro and upgrade the suspension, brakes and tires to give it better handling and performance on the street.

programme.title: Building a Man-Sized Go-Kart from a Junkyard Bound Chassis
programme.desc: The Carcass team revives a junkyard bound Buick Regal. The left for dead chassis gets a slew of guerrilla-style upgrades that triples the horsepower, improves the handling, and roasts some tires!

programme.title: Super Nova Swap
programme.desc: Drag Strip Swap - Tommy and Joel elevate the curb appeal of an old 1967 Chevy Nova race car, showing you how to swap out some shiny stuff, which includes new bumpers and trim, as well as beef up the fire suppression system to get it looking cool and staying cool.

programme.title: Transforming the VW Bug From Cool to Bajawesome
programme.desc: The Carcass duo adds a custom fit roll cage, fabricated louvers out back, and a whole bunch of style points to this baja style bug. This is part 2 of 3 of the BajAwesome build.

programme.title: Mopar Big Block and Transmission Drop
programme.desc: Today, our 1969 Dodge Dart, Project Bullseye, gets a major power upgrade. We also get our brakes lined out and connect all the steering linkage for total control. The icing on the cake, we paint the scooped hood and add our Swinger stripe.

programme.title: AMC Javelin Paint Goes From Boring To Bright Candy Apple Red
programme.desc: Our AMC Javelin gets a freshen-up in the paint department with some help from an old friend. We show you some simple and easy ways to make your paint look amazing.

programme.title: Extreme Diesel Rigs at Ultimate Callout Challenge
programme.desc: LT & Austin purchase a 2011 Sierra Denali HD, plus they are on the road in Indy for coverage of the Ultimate Callout Challenge.

programme.title: Turbo Tahoe 383 SBC : Part 2
programme.desc: We're putting the final touches on our turbocharged Gen 1 small block and prove you don't need big money to make big power. Once this dead reliable 383 is assembled, it hits the Dyno for NA power pulls before we add boost to Blacktop Speed Shop's pump-gas show stopper.

programme.title: G-Body Buck Regal Build, Checking Glass and Trim Off the List
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc give us some tips on painting trim and glass installation before our '85 Buick gets a new interior. Plus a Chevelle owner in need of a little rescuing.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 2 - Medical Checkup
programme.desc: The warden's calling for diagnostics for Detroit Muscle's next prisoner, their 1969 Pontiac GTO. They'll have to tear down and look inside the skeleton of this old muscle car before they fix it up.

programme.title: Taking A 1970 Mustang From Pony To Stallion
programme.desc: This 1970 Mustang will take a 50 year leap into the future, and we're building it to give away! EBC Brakes is teaming up with Detroit Muscle to turn this pony car into a stallion.

programme.title: Boosted 4.3L V6 Makes Over 500 lb-ft On The Dyno!
programme.desc: We crank up the power on our old-school GM 4.3L V6 with some turbocharged forced induction.

programme.title: Pre-Runner Ranger Part 2
programme.desc: We're getting our Coyote engine and transmission installed in our 2002 Ford Ranger!

programme.title: Building Up a New 6.4L Gen III HEMI For Reliable Muscle Car Power
programme.desc: Starting with a bare block, we build a piece of big modern Mopar muscle! Complete with a Holley High-Ram Intake and Terminator X Max Fuel Injection, we get a big jump in power that's dyno proven!

programme.title: How To Choose A Square Body
programme.desc: We're at Stovalls collision and wrecking service searching through their private inventory for our next project. We're after a 4 wheel drive square body.

programme.title: EBC Mustang Gets a New Suspension, Wheels, and Tires
programme.desc: Our EBC Mustang Sweepstakes car gets all new suspension, wheels and tires, as well as an upgraded brake and rotor package. Then we take it out for a little testing and some fun!

programme.title: 509ci W-Series Big Block Chevy Part 2
programme.desc: We continue the buildup of our 509ci W-Series engine as we get it ready to hit the engine dyno. We wrap up this vintage looking hot rod power plant with high flowing induction and throttle body EFI before we see how much power it makes in the dyno.

programme.title: The Great Intake Debate: Dual Vs. Single Plane Intake Manifolds
programme.desc: We test multiple configurations of our V8 to see what makes the biggest difference on the engine dyno.

programme.title: Triple Threat Completion
programme.desc: It's down to the wire, as we ready our Camaro race car for the track.

programme.title: Solid Roller 318 LA
programme.desc: Our 318 Mopar is back AGAIN, so we can take it to the next level! This already stout small block gets a solid roller camshaft and a single plane intake to crank up the RPM and turn up the horsepower.

programme.title: OBS 632 SS Part 2 Chassis Chaos
programme.desc: The OBS Chevy is in the shop to mock up it's new suspension. We'll have to make a few modifications to the spring pockets before installing our front suspension. In the rear we'll address frame issues before we can add a c-notch to get our rear suspension in place before our chassis heads out to poweder coat.

programme.title: Brake the Pavement
programme.desc: The EBC Brakes and Pedal Commander Dodge Charger gets its final touches on brakes and cosmetics before hitting the track.

programme.title: Bedtime
programme.desc: It's bedtime! Today, Eric and Joel are laying down the freshly painted back end on our 1993 Dodge W350-Project Nightshift. We'll address the fuel system and core support, and slap on an all-new exhaust, getting us one step closer to the finish line.

programme.title: Turn The Volume Up For The AMC Javelin's New Set Of Side Pipes
programme.desc: Javelin gets a new sick sound with a set of side pipes, before hitting the road for a little fun.

programme.title: SCCA SPEC Mustang Part 1
programme.desc: Engine Power embarks on a new project for SCCA's inaugural SPEC Mustang class. We'll take a 2008 Mustang GT and begin getting it ready for this entry level, but competitive class.

programme.title: 505ci Monster Mopar
programme.desc: A big block legend returns, as Pat and Frankie from Engine Power bring their 505ci RB Mopar out of the moth balls and into the shop for a few upgrades in the search for more power! With some well-placed parts changes and a complete color makeover, they will get this pump gas beast ready to slip between the frame rails of a worthy hotrod.

programme.title: Project Leadfoot Gets a New Heart
programme.desc: Chris and Eric team up to tackle the monumental task of finally installing the 600 horsepower Ford 460 Big Block into Project Leadfoot with a brand new Tremec TR4050 transmission.

programme.title: One-of-a-Kind Cadillac Becomes a Chameleon!
programme.desc: The finish line is in sight! The Blacktop Speed Shop crew is putting the final touches on one of the rarest wagons ever built. Color-shift wrap, custom lighting, and a racing simulator we can haul in a trailer. SEMA, here we come!

programme.title: Reuniting The '71 Chevy Caprice With Its Updated Chassis
programme.desc: A marriage made in heaven - Our Fat Stack Caprice gets reunited with our updated chassis. Then it gets lined out with a new fuel system to ensure this LS can handle all of the horsepower of this heavy Chevy.

programme.title: Project Shell Shock - Metal Makeover
programme.desc: Rust Revival - Brian and Joel are back in the shop with their sleeves rolled up and ready to bust the rust in their Chevy 210, Project Shell Shock. Watch as they cut, fit, and weld fresh floor pans into place, to help give this classic a solid foundation inside and out. Then it's full steam ahead as the guys strip Shell Shock down to bare metal, prepping every inch for a new paint job.

programme.title: Retro Hurst Olds Exterior Gets Restored Back To Its Showroom Finish - Part 2
programme.desc: We restore a '83 Hurst Olds retro rocket's finish to a showroom shine and update the exterior with decals that put the icing on the cake.

programme.title: Prison Tats
programme.desc: Project Henchman is hoping to get a new look on this episode of Detroit Muscle. Tommy and Peyton begin rust repair and a new paint job that'll make this '69 Pontiac GTO shine.

programme.title: Installing a Mustang Foxbody Wing
programme.desc: To keep Project Sydewinder on the ground we need a little help. Plus it's new wheels and tires and some body work on our '85 Buick.

programme.title: OEM Ford F-100 Suspension Swap
programme.desc: Shockingly, a sixty-year-old suspension needs replacing. So, Eric and Joel kick it old school with some OEM parts for Clint Black's 1960 Ford F-100.

programme.title: Dirty JL
programme.desc: We're on the trail! We are taking our Jeep JL to Burning Rock Off Road park, and the Hatfield McCoy Trail system in West Virginia to see just how dirty our Jeep can get!

programme.title: The Falcon Ford Should Have Built
programme.desc: Today we kick off Project Black Bird - a 1963 Ford Falcon that we hope will make more than it's advertised 65 horsepower. We didn't pick this car for its engine though...we picked it because we are going to improve everything you wish it had, turning it into the Falcon Ford should have built. First thing we've got to do is see if those dismal dyno numbers are true.

programme.title: Valvoline Camaro Part 1
programme.desc: A 2017 Camaro SS is upgraded to be given away to one lucky viewer.

programme.title: Lowering And Chopping The Bed On The Turbocharged Ford 300 Flatbed
programme.desc: We bring our now turbocharged 1964 Ford F350 flatbed shop truck back for upgrades. We'll bob the bed by cutting the frame, build and install a new exhaust, and then drive it like we stole it!

programme.title: Tearing Down A 1971 Chevy Caprice - Fat Stack Part 1
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel kick off a new project, a 1971 Chevy Caprice. They search through a big-body boneyard to find the inspiration to help separate this car from stereotypical b-body builds.

programme.title: Will There Be A Big Power Difference On A Mildly Modded AMC 258 Straight 6?
programme.desc: What started as a simple "aerosol overhaul" for a Postal Jeep's powerplant gets a little more complicated!

programme.title: Over 13:1 on Pump Gas! Chevy 350 Dyno Mule - Part 2
programme.desc: We finish our 350 ci Small Block Chevy with high-performance induction, then we put it to the test in the dyno cell!

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger: Headers & Shocks
programme.desc: Cagetube, Rollcage, Shock loops and more, our Prerunner Ranger is getting custom headers and long travel shocks.

programme.title: Engine Powers' Favorite Dyno Days
programme.desc: As we say in Engine Power, "Dyno days are the BEST days!" and these are some of our favorite dyno runs.

programme.title: The Unbreakable Suburban is Going Off Road
programme.desc: The guys put Project Unbreakable, our '91 Chevy Suburban, to the test at Adventure Off Road Park! From trails to mud we'll see it all! Plus, we're off to a viewer's house to rescue the interior of her 1966 Chevy C10.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 5 - New Chains
programme.desc: Prisoners love their chains, and Project Henchman is no different. On this episode of Detroit Muscle, the 1969 GTO gets a shiny new exterior look.

programme.title: Lifting Big with 8" BDS Coilover Conversion and 35" Tires
programme.desc: We jack up the '14 Silverado and add big wheels, tires, and brake upgrades.

programme.title: CTS-V Wagon SEMA Build
programme.desc: Rare Cadillac. Big plans. We're partnering with EBC Brakes to transform a 2014 CTS-V Wagon with into the ultimate trailer towing SEMA showstopper.

programme.title: Dropping the Hammer On The Retro Rocket Hurst Olds - Part 5
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel visit a museum in a Lane of its own to see some one-of-a-kind vehicles. Then, they head over to the track to put the pedal to the metal on their '83 Hurst Olds retro rocket!

programme.title: Lighting the Way Forward
programme.desc: Project Spartan, our 1969 Jeep Kaiser M715, is getting a major overhaul from the ground up. We start by upgrading the lighting system with modern headlights and some vintage C10 turn signals, then move on to the critical work of patching and reinforcing the frame; fixing all the damage left behind by years of rust and corrosion. But the real milestone comes when we reunite the engine with the transmission, build custom mounts, and drop the heart of this beast back onto the frame.

programme.title: LS Fest: Test Sled ET's
programme.desc: There's no better place for the test sled's first pass on the strip than LS Fest in Bowling Green, KY!

programme.title: Ford 300 Inline Six Gets Eye-Popping Off-The-Shelf Power
programme.desc: Even after 45 years, our antique Ford engine still runs. And after some needed upgrades, it will run like a champ!

programme.title: The Fall Guy Meets Faux Guy: Finally Finished
programme.desc: We wrap up our Chevy K-10 square body build with the final assembly of trim work, bumpers, hood and more. Plus a piece of Hollywood history shows up in our studio.

programme.title: Building a Baja Style Bug With a VW Beetle and A Stock Can-Am Maverick X3
programme.desc: What do you get when you combine a Bug and a UTV? The answer: BajAwesome. The Carcass team builds a baja style bug with a left for dead VW Beetle and a stock Can-Am Maverick X3. This is part 1 of a 3 part BajAwesome build.

programme.title: This Horse Has Horsepower
programme.desc: It's time to triple the horsepower in our 1990 Mustang! Project Fast Lane Fox Body is getting a new heart, as Tommy and Peyton make final adjustments to their pony car's new Windsor motor. Plus we'll show you how to install a new fuel injector pump with a pro from Edelbrock.

programme.title: 427ci LSx Part 1
programme.desc: We kick off a brand new, ground up build for a Music City Trucks project, featuring a scratch built 427ci pump gas LSx. With awesome hot rod power and durability in mind, we start with a new Summit Racing Pro LS block and prep this beast for serious short-bed C10 service.

programme.title: Transforming a Honda Civic Hatchback Into The Ultimate Rally Car Part 1
programme.desc: We find a parked Honda Civic and try to get it back on the road. Then take it to the shop and start planning what to build.

programme.title: JL Rubicon: Strength
programme.desc: Our Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon gets a stronger axle, and a custom built bumper. Plus, how you can build your own rack for trail tools.

programme.title: 2011 Diesel Denali Gets Lowered
programme.desc: Our 2011 Diesel Denali nicknamed "Dragonali" gets lowered & de-badged, plus we're in a viewers' driveway rescuing their beat up pick-up.

programme.title: Junkyard Ford 390 FE Teardown
programme.desc: Mike and Pat stroke a vintage junkyard Ford 390 but an unexpected surprise puts a delay in their progress. Then it's full steam ahead for finding the limit for this big block stump puller

programme.title: Camaro Racecar Body Modifications To Make Room For The Drivetrain
programme.desc: The Carcass crew makes modifications to the firewall of their Road Course Camaro so that the new mounting points for the engine and transmission fit. We'll also show you how to measure for custom wheels for your next project.

programme.title: Welcome to Dirt and Trails
programme.desc: Hosts Eric Smart and Chris Reader take you on an offroad adventure, making the coolest offroad and overland trucks and SUV's imaginable. This week, we test out the capabilities of a1987 Toyota Land Cruiser, as well as a 1994 Ford F150 we named Project Leadfoot.

programme.title: Project Leadfoot is Complete
programme.desc: We take a look back at our 1994 Ford F150 that we call Leadfoot and how this truck handled the great outdoors when we picked it up, all the crazy and amazing work we did to it, and then we take it out for a full shakedown back on the trail to see how it stacks up once again. And, we have a special guest appearance from Bigfoot, the inspiration behind the whole build!

programme.title: Basket Case - Rusted, Busted, and Ruined
programme.desc: Tommy and Peyton make a plan of attack to resurrect a 1966 Chevy Nova, a first for the Detroit Muscle shop. After their upscale treatment, this Nova, codenamed Project Starstruck, will be a low, mean, aggressive street machine with killer looks.

programme.title: Project Struck Out
programme.desc: As Tommy and Peyton resume work on their 1966 Chevy Nova, they suddenly learn that this project may go from Starstruck to Struck Out. With that, they switch gears into another historic muscle car, 1969 Pontiac GTO.

programme.title: '56 Chevy Goes Gasser
programme.desc: We finally found a home for our 509 cubic inch W-Series Big Block: A 1956 Chevrolet 210. We start with a frame and a body, and we immediately get to work on getting our high-performance powertrain fitted up.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 6 - The Art of Darkness
programme.desc: Steel meets style - Today the boys finally lay down some paint on their '69 GTO. Peyton and Tommy then wrestle the body back onto the frame and slap on all new weather stripping to lock out the elements and preserve this poised piece of Pontiac perfection.

programme.title: Ford F150 EcoBoost vs Dodge Ram SRT-10: Muscle Trux Build-Off
programme.desc: Does a '15 F150 Ford EcoBoost stand a chance against a '05 Dodge Ram SRT-10? It's a head-to-head build-off that starts with a track and dyno baseline. Let the tear down begin!

programme.title: Memorial
programme.desc: We help out our friends in Engine Power with fabricated fenders for their new test sled, and we go on a Driveway Rescue that helps build a memorial for a fallen soldier.

programme.title: Toughening Up The '91 Suburban With New Axles And A 4-Link Coilover Kit
programme.desc: Our GMC "Unbreakable" Suburban gets its new suspension along with a good sanding and paint job to help get it ready for the real world.

programme.title: Squeezing the Heartbeat Of Our '69 Camaro Between the Fenders
programme.desc: The guys down in Engine Power have finished beefing up our '69 Camaro' s engine with some high-performance parts, now we have to install it and upgrade the drive train so it can hold it's own with today's modern muscle.

programme.title: Sierra HD Duramax Allison Transmission
programme.desc: We'll show you the step-by-step inner workings of an Allison transmission when our guys build the gearbox for a Sierra HD Duramax.

programme.title: Building a 4-Link Suspension to Conquer the Trails
programme.desc: Our '78 Postal Jeep gets an upgraded suspension that can handle the trails. We'll start by fabricating our axles and frame for a 4 link setup.

programme.title: Project Leadfoot Gets A Lift Kit
programme.desc: Chris takes Project Leadfoot, our 1994 Ford F150, and installs a roll cage, while Eric installs a new lift kit, suspension, steering, and brakes.

programme.title: OBS 632 SS Part 8 Sport Truck Assemble/Crossing the Finish Line
programme.desc: The 632 OBS Chevy is in the final lap of completion. We'll finish up the interior with new seats and gauge cluster. Then we'll add one more detail to accentuate our exterior, before hitting the streets and the strip.

programme.title: Rebuilding the Rear End of a Chevy K1500
programme.desc: LT and Austin take delivery on "Project Lo 'n Slo". Find out what's in store for this 53 year old C-10. Plus loose ends on the Chevy K1500 "RedTide" get tied up including gearing and a rear-end rebuild.

programme.title: Adding JDM Styling Cues To The 1978 Datsun 280Z Heritage Restomod
programme.desc: The Carcass crew makes body modifications to our 1978 280Z that take on some JDM styling cues. And we're in the paint booth to show you how to make your paint come out smooth as glass.

programme.title: Revamped Tahoe Part 2
programme.desc: Our 1996 Chevy Tahoe continues its conversion with exterior improvements and new wheels and tires. Plus, we'll show you some tips on how to properly measure for new a driveshaft.

programme.desc: Beaver and Larry must attend dances.

programme.title: Beaver's House Guest
programme.desc: Impressed by a friend from a broken home, Beaver secretly wishes his parents would divorce.

programme.title: Summit
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species...and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Descent
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: The Haven
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Dj Vu
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Starcrossed
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Better Luck Next Time
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Judgment Day
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: The Gun
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it...literally.

programme.title: Skin Deep
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before...and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Manifest Destiny
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Breaking Point
programme.desc: When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

programme.title: The Beholder
programme.desc: A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

programme.title: Seeds Of Destruction
programme.desc: A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming ...human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

programme.title: Simon Says
programme.desc: After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Stasis
programme.desc: Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

programme.title: Down To Earth
programme.desc: When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

programme.title: Inner Child
programme.desc: After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

programme.title: Glitch
programme.desc: Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real...and neither is Tom.

programme.title: Decompression
programme.desc: After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

programme.title: Abaddon
programme.desc: The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

programme.title: The Grid
programme.desc: A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

programme.title: Revival
programme.desc: A preacher (Gary Busey), who lost his faith when his wife died, performs staged healing miracles at tent revivals until he finds his faith -- and livelihood -- being tested as never before by the appearance of a mysterious wheelchair-bound man.

programme.title: Gettysburg
programme.desc: Two friends re-enacting the Battle of Gettysburg unwittingly find themselves transported back in time and taken prisoner by a deranged Confederate colonel (Meatloaf) who might not only endanger their future...but the future of the country as well.

programme.title: Something About Harry
programme.desc: A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission...a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

programme.title: Zig Zag
programme.desc: An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

programme.title: Nest
programme.desc: When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

programme.title: Final Appeal (Part 1)
programme.desc: Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

programme.title: Family Values
programme.desc: An overworked father who wants to relieve the tension in his home due to the demands of his job orders a robot to keep house and perform other chores. Much to the father's surprise, the robot starts to replace him as head of the household.

programme.title: Patient Zero
programme.desc: A military colonel travels into the past from a plagued-ridden future where billions have died from a deadly virus. His mission: track down Patient Zero, the woman who had all three strains of DNA that produced the virus and assassinate her.

programme.title: A New Life
programme.desc: A couple and their friend join a mysterious religious sect in order to lead a more spiritual existence and find a new direction in life. They soon learn, however, that their new-found direction may take them further than they ever thought possible.

programme.title: The Surrogate
programme.desc: Young and artistic Claire Linkwood, who struggles financially to make ends meet, volunteers for a surrogate mother program. But after the embryo is successfully implanted at the clinic, she begins to have nightmares of a most "alien" nature.

programme.title: The Vessel
programme.desc: The lone survivor (Jere Burns) of a space shuttle disaster discovers he's greatly transformed since surviving the crash. For one, his body seems to be indestructible, and he embraces a new-found humanity...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Mona Lisa
programme.desc: Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

programme.title: Replica
programme.desc: A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

programme.title: Think Like A Dinosaur
programme.desc: A man (Enrico Colantoni) has second thoughts about a process that transmits a copy of a person light years away but requires that the human "shell" left behind be destroyed in order to maintain a balance in the Universe.

programme.title: Alien Shop
programme.desc: An unemployed man wanders into a curio shop owned by a shape-shifting alien and is offered a rather unique wallet...one that fills with the money of anyone the man comes in physical contact with. However, if it's too good to be true, it often is.

programme.title: Worlds Within
programme.desc: A dying scientist (Joanna Going) makes it her mission to save a mutant "child" -- a link to another dimension of time and space -- from those scientists who seek fame and from shadowy government forces that desire to exploit it.

programme.title: In The Blood
programme.desc: A four-person space crew travels through a wormhole that lands them in an unknown universe where Native American Astrophysicist Callie Whitehorse Landau experiences bizarre hallucinations that reveal the true nature of the entire universe.

programme.title: Flower Child
programme.desc: When an alien seed travels through space and lands on Earth in a rooftop garden, the exotic "flower" it spawns turns out to be an alluring woman who consumes the life and energy out of human victims in the attempt to perpetuate her species on Earth.

programme.title: Free Spirit
programme.desc: After a botched military experiment some four years earlier resulted in the death of one of the test subjects, a doctor now believes the deceased test subject's vengeful spirit is able to jump from one body to another...and is after her.

programme.title: Mindreacher
programme.desc: In an effort to help the mentally ill, a psychiatrist (Jamie Lunar) creates a device that allows her to enter the subconscious of her patients. But when things go wrong, she finds that her own sanity -- and possibly her life -- may be in danger.

programme.title: Time To Time
programme.desc: A time traveler recruits a young woman from present day to join a team of time travelers-for-hire, but when she ends up attempting to change her own past, doing irreparable damage to the present and the future, the institute must race to stop her.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: When an alien abducts five students and transports them to a reproduction of their school, it informs them that they are part of a grand experiment. But as part of that experiment, together they must decide which of the five should be killed.

programme.title: Rule Of Law
programme.desc: A circuit court judge (Dennis Haysbert) agrees to preside over a case on a colonized planet that has never had any organized rule of law. On a world in which humans and aliens live side by side, he finds his first case is one of murder.

programme.title: Lion's Den
programme.desc: A desperate high school wrestling coach gives his team an untested performance-enhancing inhalant. Of course, the team suddenly starts winning...but their victory may be short-lived as the drug comes with killer side effects.

programme.title: The Tipping Point
programme.desc: An employee of a computer company uncovers a plot by its CEO/founder to take control of the world's computer network by having computers communicate at a more sentient level and, if successful, set himself up for world domination

programme.title: Dark Child
programme.desc: A woman who was abducted by aliens 17 years earlier tries to move past the mental scars, especially for the sake of her daughter, and finds love with a new teacher at her daughter's school. But she soon learns he is not the man he appears to be.

programme.title: The Human Factor
programme.desc: A rogue android who is part of the crew on Ganymede outpost threatens to destroy Earth's last hope of survival, claiming that human beings are no better than an infestation in the universe and not worthy of survival. And perhaps he is right...

programme.title: Human Trials
programme.desc: A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

programme.title: Sandkings (Parts One and Two)
programme.desc: Beau Bridges stars in this bone-chilling thriller. A ride of harrowing suspense, this taut film is packed with heart-stopping tension that faithfully fulfills the tradition of the ground-breaking series upon which it is based, the "Outer Limits."

programme.title: Valerie 23
programme.desc: Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

programme.title: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

programme.title: The Second Soul
programme.desc: A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

programme.title: White Light Fever
programme.desc: An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens the natural order of things when an embittered billionaire (William Hickey) pays brilliant cardiologist (Bruce Davidson) to help him cheat death. But is death willing to be cheated so easily?

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

programme.title: Virtual Future
programme.desc: When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

programme.title: Living Hell
programme.desc: Ben Kohler's (Sam Robards) life is saved after having an experimental microchip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing murders as if through the eyes of the killer, it becomes clear that something is desperately wrong.

programme.title: Corner Of The Eye
programme.desc: When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it...but nothing comes without a cost.

programme.title: Under The Bed
programme.desc: When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

programme.title: Dark Matters
programme.desc: Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

programme.title: The Conversion
programme.desc: Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

programme.title: Ritual
programme.desc: A visiting doctor, thought to be a terrorist, becomes a suspect in the death of an Egyptian man; Ross learns the doctor specializes in female circumcision.

programme.title: Under the Influence
programme.desc: An accident that kills three people hits close to home for Curtis and brings back painful memories for McCoy.

programme.title: Expert
programme.desc: A forensic specialist is targeted by killers, challenging Briscoe and Curtis to find a suspect; McCoy and Ross turn up evidence on the victim.

programme.title: Castoff
programme.desc: Detectives search for the killer of a physician who had a dangerous sex life; an attorney maintains murders are a result of too much television.

programme.title: Grief
programme.desc: Detectives seek a motive for a man's brutal beating; Ross uncovers an unlikely accomplice in the assault case.

programme.title: Faccia a Faccia
programme.desc: The detectives link a dead FBI witness to an overeager hit man and a gangster; Schiff pushes to prosecute the mob for the murder.

programme.title: Divorce
programme.desc: The stabbing death of a psychologist draws Detectives Briscoe and Curtis into a heated divorce case and pits McCoy and Ross against a manipulative attorney.

programme.title: Carrier
programme.desc: A girl's death at a party provides a puzzle for Briscoe and Curtis; McCoy and Ross work around the margins of law.

programme.title: Stalker
programme.desc: Detectives try to find out what happened to a woman who was found unconscious at the bottom of her apartment stairs.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: McCoy and Ross must negotiate with an informant to get information about a missing couple and the main suspect in the disappearance.

programme.title: Burden
programme.desc: The death of a disabled teenage boy raises questions about whether a suspected killer was motivated by mercy or something more sinister.

programme.title: Bad Girl
programme.desc: Schiff's re-election may hinge on the stabbing death of a police officer; Briscoe's daughter is arrested for dealing drugs.

programme.title: Damaged
programme.desc: Detectives Briscoe and Curtis take on a double shooting case; McCoy and Ross prosecute the alleged gang rape of a girl with disabilities.

programme.title: Tabloid
programme.desc: When a well-known law professor is killed while being chased by a tabloid journalist, the victim's husband tries to keep family secrets out of the press.

programme.title: Monster
programme.desc: Opponents of Adam Schiff question the handling of a sexual-assault case by the police and the D.A.'s office.

programme.title: Cherished
programme.desc: The investigation into a girl's death reveals secrets the adoptive family was desperately trying to hide.

programme.title: DWB
programme.desc: Detectives discover a shocking twist involving unlikely suspects when they investigate the brutal beating of a black man dumped near the highway.

programme.title: Bait
programme.desc: A robbery/assault victim feeds the police half-truths leading to the discovery of the cold-blooded murder of a young girl.

programme.title: Flight
programme.desc: The death of a boy from an injection of a lethal flu sends detectives Briscoe and Curtis and prosecutors McCoy and Carmichael after the murderer.

programme.title: Agony
programme.desc: A serial killer confesses to new crimes, and McCoy and Carmichael face a moral dilemma when they learn they have the wrong man.

programme.title: Scrambled
programme.desc: The death of a female embryologist at a fertility clinic leads Briscoe and Curtis on a search for a desperate killer.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: The shooting death of a young escort prompts an investigation into high society in New York, while McCoy and Carmichael track down career criminals.

programme.title: Punk
programme.desc: The murder of a corrections officer leads detectives to a women's prison where a guard was linked to an inmate Carmichael put away on drug charges.

programme.title: True North
programme.desc: Detectives feel a woman is withholding information when they probe the murder of her wealthy husband and very young daughter.

programme.title: Hate
programme.desc: Evidence points Detectives Briscoe and Curtis in the direction of a fascist youth gathering after the brutal beating and murder of a high-school girl.

programme.title: Ramparts
programme.desc: A shooting sends police divers into the Hudson River where they find a VW bus linked to a murder case closed in the 1960s during student uprisings.

programme.title: Hunters
programme.desc: Discovery of a parolee's corpse in a car trunk sends detectives after a suspect that bounty hunters also want, dead or alive.

programme.title: Haven
programme.desc: Briscoe and Curtis probe the murder of a popular Harlem community leader; McCoy and Carmichael struggle to prevent a chaotic situation.

programme.title: Sideshow
programme.desc: Discovery of a corpse in Battery Park reunites squads when the victim turns out to be a Baltimore official. (Concluding on "Homicide: Life on the Street.")

programme.title: Disciple
programme.desc: Briscoe and Curtis investigate the death of a girl who managed to die, unnoticed, amid the hustle and bustle of an ER's waiting room.

programme.title: Harm
programme.desc: Briscoe and Curtis investigate a possible homicide while probing the assault of a retired divorce attorney.

programme.title: Shield
programme.desc: Briscoe and Curtis investigate the murder of a police officer who was shot while on an undercover stakeout.

programme.title: Juvenile
programme.desc: Detectives link the shooting of an investigative reporter to a sensationalized murder case, closed 20 years earlier.

programme.title: Tabula Rasa
programme.desc: Family secrets unravel when detectives look for motives for a college professor being thrown into the path of a subway train.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Briscoe and Curtis investigate a corporate mogul's death, caused by an overdose of a drug that enhances sexual performance.

programme.title: Ambitious
programme.desc: When the murder of an audio-system installer links to the mob, McCoy's office must ensure witnesses' safety.

programme.title: Admissions
programme.desc: Briscoe and Curtis investigate the death of a promising mathematician who was involved in a turbulent relationship with a college professor.

programme.title: Refuge
programme.desc: Briscoe and Curtis become entangled in the Russian mafia while investigating two murders with a speechless child as the only witness.

programme.title: Refuge

programme.title: It's What's on the Inside That Counts
programme.desc: Host Jesse Palmer gives the seven bakers advent calendars filled with chocolate to inspire them to make desserts with a surprise inside. Then, for the main heat, the competitors must bake one delicious cheesecake with three different flavors.

programme.title: Topsy-Turvy Holidays
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer challenges the competitors to work in teams to create a twist on traditional Hanukkah jelly doughnuts; the bakers get creative with holiday decorated upside-down cakes to satisfy the judges.

programme.title: A Classic Christmas
programme.desc: Host Jesse Palmer asks the five bakers to create an over-the-top version of a holiday trifle. Then, the classics continue in the main heat when the competitors make the ultimate Charlotte royale for judges Nancy Fuller, Duff Goldman and Carla Hall.

programme.title: Christmas Windows in Time
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer kicks things off by asking the final four competitors to create a holiday macaron tower. In the main heat, the bakers must feature an assigned icing style -- marzipan, buttercream or mirror glaze -- in a stunning cake to win $25,000.

programme.title: Sweet Secrets
programme.desc: Judges Nancy Fuller, Duff Goldman and Carla Hall look back at how the final four bakers made it to the finale, revealing the best bakes of the season and some of the slip-ups; they give an exciting behind-the-scenes view into how the show is made.

programme.title: Falling Into Winter
programme.desc: The 12 bakers embrace the seasonal transition by making fall and winter doughnuts; the competitors combine holiday cheese board staples in creative apple and cheese desserts.

programme.title: Yule Be Merry
programme.desc: The bakers team up to take on boozy desserts and are challenged with five different styles of yule log cakes in 10 different flavor combinations.

programme.title: Attitude of Gratitude
programme.desc: The nine bakers make Mason jar fruit desserts; the competitors create heartfelt messages on top of a favorite Thanksgiving dessert: pie.

programme.title: Best Thanksgiving Ever
programme.desc: In a nod to the day after Thanksgiving, the bakers use Black Friday kitchen gadgets to make desserts; the competitors work in teams to create cornucopia bread baskets filled with flavored holiday breads.

programme.title: Gifts That Keep on Giving
programme.desc: In honor of the Hanukkah oil that kept burning, the seven remaining bakers must create festive Hanukkah olive oil cakes; in the main heat, the competitors randomly choose a dreaded holiday dessert and attempt to spin it into holiday happiness.

programme.title: Make New Friends, but Keep the Old
programme.desc: The six remaining bakers make tasty treats for guests with a dietary restriction; host Jesse Palmer challenges the competitors to update an assigned vintage holiday dessert to create a new Christmas delight.

programme.title: Holidays in All the Ways
programme.desc: Host Jesse Palmer asks the bakers to create sweet potato and spice desserts in honor of Kwanzaa; in the main heat, the competitors make Christmas card cakes that depict a perfect family snapshot for a holiday card.

programme.title: Ultimate Holiday Party
programme.desc: The bakers create dessert charcuterie boards and piñata desserts, then the competitors take on holiday party theme cakes and incorporate lights into their designs; the most successful baker becomes the Holiday Baking Champion and gets $25,000!

programme.title: First Snow
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer welcomes the 12 bakers by challenging them to create fall pavlova wreaths; the competitors divide into cake and pie teams to finally decide the best holiday dessert and win immunity from judges Nancy Fuller, Duff Goldman and Carla Hall.

programme.title: Getting Ready for Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer tasks the bakers with creating desserts featuring ingredients from Thanksgiving dinner; the competitors go beyond cookies to give the jolly gingerbread man a makeover to impress the judges.

programme.title: Feeling Sweet and Thankful
programme.desc: Smoked, fried, brined, roasted and bacon-wrapped, Jesse Palmer uses the five-way turkey as inspiration for the bakers' preheat challenge; the competitors divide into teams to create a flight of pies that takes the judges on a flavorful journey.

programme.title: Dining Out for the Holidays
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer asks the bakers to turn steakhouse desserts into decadent holiday treats; then, the competitors impress the judges by transforming a traditional steakhouse icon into a tasty Christmas tree.

programme.title: Holiday Movie Magic
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer challenges the bakers to create a holiday high tea; the bakers get inspired by a holiday movie trope to create a dessert that's dripping with festive decorations.

programme.title: The World of Holidays
programme.desc: In honor of Kwanzaa, Jesse Palmer tasks the bakers with crafting desserts that feature fresh corn for a traditional Kwanzaa display; the competitors put their personal stamp on international holiday desserts.

programme.title: Holiday Rush
programme.desc: The bakers feel the holiday rush as Jesse Palmer sends them through three heated challenges: create ugly sweater cakes, turn store-bought cake into tasty centerpieces and build a snowman croquembouche.

programme.desc: Jesse Palmer escapes the cold weather by challenging the bakers to create dessert-inspired succulent tarts, and two competitors are sent skiing into a cookie cake showdown.

programme.title: SiREN
programme.desc: One week before his wedding day, Jonah and his groomsmen hit the town for a wild night of club hopping and debauchery. The night soon takes a twisted turn for the worse when the group is invited to a seedy underground club. After Jonah frees a seemingly imprisoned dancer, he realizes that the woman he released is actually a terrifying, legendary creature that will stop at nothing to claim her prey.

programme.title: The Skulls
programme.desc: For Luke McNamara (Joshua Jackson), an invitation to join the prestigious secret college organization, The Skulls, is a dream come true. But he soon comes to realize just how powerful The Skulls organization really is -- and that the truth, like success, comes at a very high price.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruit Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: The Skulls III
programme.desc: In this sequel, beautiful and determined college student Taylor Brooks (Clare Kramer) is intent on joining the secret society known as the Skulls, despite its history of being an organization consisting solely of men. Although she encounters strong resistance, Taylor takes steps toward being accepted into their ranks, but her efforts are derailed when her boyfriend is found dead. Taylor is considered the prime suspect. Can she clear her name and track down the real murderer?

programme.title: The Spider Woman Strikes Back
programme.desc: She (Gale Sondergaard) and her hulking servant grow bloodsucking plants, as a young woman (Brenda Joyce) finds out.

programme.title: Stephanie
programme.desc: A young girl is left alone in her house during a worldwide catastrophe and fearfully hides from a malevolent force that is stalking her. When her parents miraculously return, they try to settle back into normal life, but become increasingly concerned about something that has affected their daughter Stephanie.

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: Caught in a typhoon, a tugboat commanded by Robert Everton (Donald Sutherland) comes across a mysterious near-deserted ship. Excited to find a vessel that could be sold for as much as $30 million, Everton and his crew board and prepare to move the craft, despite the warnings of sole survivor Nadia Vinogradova (Joanna Pacula). When a malevolent alien presence begins killing off the crew, navigator Kit Foster (Jamie Lee Curtis) tries to convince the rest of them to leave before it's too late.

programme.title: Visions
programme.desc: After moving to a vineyard with her family, a pregnant woman experiences horrifying visions.

programme.title: Wer
programme.desc: In France, an American female attorney (A.J. Cook) defends a murder suspect who has a brutish appearance and a deadly secret.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: The Wilding
programme.desc: A family tries to start over following a daughter's release from a mental health institution.

programme.title: Munster Masquerade
programme.desc: The Munsters are invited to a masquerade dance party to meet the family of Marilyn's beau.

programme.title: My Fair Munster
programme.desc: Lily and Herman find themselves the unwelcome targets of amorous advances made by their nosy neighbors; Grandpa's love potion affects the wrong people.

programme.title: A Walk on the Mild Side
programme.desc: Herman is mistaken for a monster when he takes a walk in the local park.

programme.title: Rock-a-Bye Munster
programme.desc: Herman thinks Lily pregnant.

programme.title: Pike's Pique
programme.desc: Hysterical gas company workers inform their boss of the Munsters' existence.

programme.title: Low-Cal Munster
programme.desc: Herman embarks on a crash diet after he is invited to an Army reunion and discovers he can't squeeze into his uniform.

programme.title: Tin Can Man
programme.desc: Eddie's science project malfunctions.

programme.title: Herman the Great
programme.desc: Herman attempts to earn money for Eddie's college education by moonlighting as a pro wrestler.

programme.title: Knock Wood, Here Comes Charlie
programme.desc: Herman's twin brother, a known con artist, visits the Munsters.

programme.title: Autumn Croakus
programme.desc: Grandpa writes to a matrimonial agency hoping to find a wife.

programme.title: The Midnight Ride of Herman Munster
programme.desc: Robbers mistake Herman.

programme.title: The Sleeping Cutie
programme.desc: Grandpa puts Marilyn in a coma.

programme.title: A Family Portrait
programme.desc: A national magazine's computers pick the Munsters as the Average American Family.

programme.title: Grandpa Leaves Home
programme.desc: After clashing with the rest of the family, Grandpa feels unappreciated; he leaves home and performs a magic act at a local nightclub.

programme.title: Herman's Rival
programme.desc: Lily secretly goes to work to help out the family's finances.

programme.title: Grandpa's Call of the Wild
programme.desc: Grandpa turns himself into a wolf.

programme.title: All-Star Munster
programme.desc: Due to an error, Marilyn's college tuition is not paid, and she is told that she cannot return.

programme.title: If a Martian Answers, Hang Up
programme.desc: While listening to his ham radio, Herman mistakes some playing children for beings from outer space.

programme.title: Eddie's Nickname
programme.desc: Eddie refuses to return to school because the students call him "Shorty."

programme.title: Bats of a Feather
programme.desc: Grandpa may be the first bat in space.

programme.title: Don't Bank on Herman
programme.desc: When Lily sends Grandpa and Herman to the bank, they wind up involved in a robbery.

programme.title: Dance With Me, Herman
programme.desc: After seeing the school ball's invitation, Herman takes dancing lessons from a shady dance instructor.

programme.title: Follow That Munster
programme.desc: Herman takes a correspondence course to become a private detective.

programme.title: Love Locked Out
programme.desc: Herman gets a little tipsy at an office party; Lily makes him spend the night on the sofa after he comes home drunk.

programme.title: Come Back, Little Googie
programme.desc: Grandpa tries to turn Eddie's nasty pal (Bill Mumy) into a rabbit.

programme.title: Far Out Munsters
programme.desc: A visiting rock 'n' roll group attempts to rent the Munster house for privacy.

programme.title: Munsters on the Move
programme.desc: Herman is offered a job promotion that would mean moving out of town.

programme.title: Movie Star Munster
programme.desc: Two gangsters try to use Herman to swindle insurance companies.

programme.title: Herman the Rookie
programme.desc: Herman is given a tryout by Leo Durocher after his mighty drive sends a baseball sailing out of the ballpark.

programme.title: Country Club Munsters
programme.desc: Herman is convinced that a television competition is fixed, until he wins free membership at an exclusive country club.

programme.title: Love Comes to Mockingbird Heights
programme.desc: Marilyn decides to elope with a bank employee who is interested in the Munsters' money.

programme.title: Mummy Munster
programme.desc: Herman falls asleep in a mummy case.

programme.title: Lily Munster, Girl Model
programme.desc: Lily works as a model.

programme.title: Munster the Magnificent
programme.desc: Eddie volunteers to have Herman perform in a school talent show.

programme.title: Herman's Happy Valley
programme.desc: Herman buys a piece of land as a vacation home for the family, which he discovers in a prospectus; the fraudsters who originally sold the property have received a better offer and want it back.

programme.title: Hot Rod Herman
programme.desc: Herman drag-races in the family hearse to back up Eddie's boast that his dad is a better driver than his friend's father.

programme.title: Herman's Raise
programme.desc: When Herman is forced to work overtime at the parlor, Lily grows furious and convinces him that he deserves a raise; he is fired when he demands an increase in pay.

programme.title: Yes, Galen, There Is a Herman
programme.desc: Herman rescues a little boy whose head is trapped in the park railings, but doesn't get all the credit he deserves; Herman strikes up a friendship with the youngster.

programme.title: Underground Munster
programme.desc: Herman causes a major crisis when he chastises Spot for tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Herman's Child Psychology
programme.desc: Eddie runs away when one of his friends convinces him that all parents are mean.

programme.title: Herman, the Master Spy
programme.desc: Herman decides to try out his diving equipment while at the ocean.

programme.title: Bronco-Bustin' Munster
programme.desc: Herman competes in bronco-busting.

programme.title: Herman Munster, Shutterbug
programme.desc: Herman is in a jam when he inadvertently takes pictures of a bank robbery.

programme.title: Herman, Coach of the Year
programme.desc: Herman appoints himself Eddie's coach.

programme.title: Happy 100th Anniversary
programme.desc: Lily and Herman take part-time jobs to buy each other anniversary presents.

programme.title: Operation Herman
programme.desc: Herman slips in to visit hospitalized Eddie, who is having his tonsils removed.

programme.title: Lily's Star Boarder
programme.desc: The Munsters unknowingly rent their spare bedroom to a policeman.

programme.title: John Doe Munster
programme.desc: Herman develops amnesia when he is hit on the head by a 300-pound safe falling from a building.

programme.title: The Man for Marilyn
programme.desc: A frog becomes Marilyn's beau.

programme.title: Herman's Driving Test
programme.desc: Herman must regain his license to accept a promotion as driver of the hearse at the funeral parlor.

programme.title: Will Success Spoil Herman Munster?
programme.desc: Herman becomes a popular folk-singer.

programme.title: The Treasure of Mockingbird Heights
programme.desc: Herman and Grandpa discover a clue to the pirate treasure hidden in their backyard.

programme.title: Herman's Peace Offensive
programme.desc: Herman is forced to practice what he preaches when he urges Eddie to ignore a schoolyard bully.

programme.title: Herman Picks a Winner
programme.desc: Herman tries to teach Eddie a lesson on the futility of gambling.

programme.title: Just Another Pretty Face
programme.desc: Herman is "disfigured" when he is hit by a bolt of artificial lightning from one of Grandpa's machines.

programme.title: Heap Big Herman
programme.desc: Vacation-bound Herman blunders into a remote American Indian village after he is accidentally left behind.

programme.title: The Most Beautiful Ghoul in the World
programme.desc: A windfall causes disagreement.

programme.title: Grandpa's Lost Wife
programme.desc: Grandpa could be married.

programme.title: The Fregosi Emerald
programme.desc: Grandpa warns Marilyn that the emerald ring Eddie gave her may bring bad luck.

programme.title: Zombo
programme.desc: Herman believes Eddie's affection is being stolen by a children's television idol.

programme.title: Cyrano de Munster

programme.desc: Winx Club is a fantasy saga revolving around six fairies and their adventures. The protagonists Bloom, Stella, Flora, Aisha, Tecna and Musa live their daily life on Magix world, among lessons, loves, quarrels and moments of strong friendship. At any moment, when needed, they can transform into super-heroines, ready to defeat evil and save who is in danger.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn't take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn't give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow's nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown's face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What's that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.
