programme.title: Intimate Stranger
programme.desc: With the help of Ares (Kevin Smith) in the Underworld, Callisto (Hudson Leick) switches bodies with Xena and returns to the land of the living where the two women warriors battle once more, this time disguised as each other.

programme.title: Ten Little Warlords
programme.desc: While still trapped in the body of her enemy, Callisto, Xena is forced to enter a competition where warlords vie to become the new god of war.

programme.title: A Solstice Carol
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle try to bring the warmth of the holiday season to a cold-hearted king (Peter Vere Jones) who has outlawed the Winter Solstice celebration.

programme.title: The Xena Scrolls
programme.desc: In 1940, two archaeologists look for the legendary scrolls that Gabrielle wrote about her adventures with Xena.

programme.title: Here She Comes...Miss Amphipolis
programme.desc: Xena masquerades as a beauty pageant contestant to stop a saboteur, who is bent on destroying a peace treaty between three warlords.

programme.title: Destiny
programme.desc: After being critically injured in a fight, Xena lets her mind flash back to the time that Julius Caesar (Karl Urban) taught her a valuable lesson about destiny.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: Gabrielle's attempt to take Xena's body to be buried with her brother are complicated by would-be thieves, Amazon dynasty squabbles, and Xena attempts to communicate through Autolycus.

programme.title: A Necessary Evil
programme.desc: In order to stop the evil Velasca (Melinda Clarke) from hunting down Gabrielle, Xena must unleash an even more depraved immortal to vanquish her---Callisto (Hudson Leick).

programme.title: A Day In The Life
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) has 24 hours to prevent a warlord from plundering one village, and the world's biggest giant from destroying another.

programme.title: For Him The Bell Tolls
programme.desc: While engaged in a battle of wills with her son, Cupid, Aphrodite (Alexandra Tydings) turns Joxer into a dashing hero tasked with stealing a princess's heart away from her betrothed.

programme.title: The Execution
programme.desc: When Meleager, the hero who once saved Gabrielle's village, is condemned for murder, Gabrielle and Xena have only one turn of the sand dial to produce evidence that he is innocent.

programme.title: Blind Faith
programme.desc: A warrior (Jeremy Callaghan) wants to make his name by killing Xena. He fails, but he succeeds in putting the warrior princess in a blind rage when he kidnaps Gabrielle and sells her to agents of a king.

programme.title: Ulysses
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle chance upon King Ulysses on his way home to Ithaca from Troy, and when they see that Poseidon doesn't want him to get there, they do everything they can to make sure that he does.

programme.title: The Price
programme.desc: Xena reverts to her old ways to whip a dispirited Athenian army into shape to take on a foe known as the Horde.

programme.title: Lost Mariner
programme.desc: After a shipwreck, Gabrielle is rescued by the cursed ship of Cecrops, where she will have to stay until she dies -- unless Xena can break the curse.

programme.title: A Comedy of Eros
programme.desc: The baby of Cupid & Psyche, on the loose with Daddy's love-causing bow, complicates Xena's attempt to stop Draco from attacking a temple of Hestian virgins.

programme.title: The Furies
programme.desc: When the Furies find out that Xena never avenged the death of her father, they curse her with persecution and madness until she completes her task.

programme.title: Been There, Done That
programme.desc: The exact same day continues to start over and over again and only Xena can unravel the mystery.

programme.title: The Dirty Half Dozen
programme.desc: Xena enlists the help of four notorious criminals to steal back the secret to an impenetrable metal that Ares is using to win wars.

programme.title: The Deliverer
programme.desc: When Xena goes to help an old foe in a battle against Caesar, she ends up rescuing Gabrielle from the evil talons of Dahak, the 'One God.'

programme.title: Gabrielle's Hope
programme.desc: When Gabrielle is mysteriously impregnated, Xena must fight in a battle between the warriors and the Banshees to determine if the child is evil or good.

programme.title: The Debt
programme.desc: When Xena is given a cryptic message about a Green Dragon, she heads to the Kingdom of Chin to kill him.

programme.title: The Debt II
programme.desc: While awaiting execution for attempting to kill the Ming ruler, Xena finally repays the debt she owes her spiritual mentor, Lao Ma.

programme.title: The King of Assassins
programme.desc: When Joxer's twin brother, Jett, plans to assassinate Cleopatra with the help of Autolycus, Gabrielle uses as many Xena-like tactics as possible to try to stop the murder.

programme.title: Warrior...Priestess...Tramp
programme.desc: When Xena saves her look-alike, the Hestian Priestess Leah, from Balius, the supposed Hestian Priest, she must enlist the help of Meg, yet another Xena clone.

programme.title: The Quill Is Mightier
programme.desc: Gabrielle gains new respect for the power of the word when Aphrodite casts a spell on her scroll, turning everything she writes into reality.

programme.title: Maternal Instincts
programme.desc: Imbued with the evil power of her father Dahak, Gabrielle's daughter Hope joins forces with Callisto to kill Xena's son, Solan.

programme.title: The Bitter Suite
programme.desc: The bitter conflict between Xena and Gabrielle reaches a crescendo in this musical episode, set in the dream world of Illusia.

programme.title: One Against An Army
programme.desc: When Gabrielle is struck with a poisonous arrow, Xena must find a way to save her while single-handedly battling the entire Persian army.

programme.title: Forgiven
programme.desc: When Xena and Gabrielle set out to recover the stolen Urn of Apollo, they are joined by Tara, a feisty 16-year old who wants a chance to turn her life around.

programme.title: King Con
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle join forces with two con men to exact revenge against a ruthless gaming club owner who has ordered Joxer's death.

programme.title: When in Rome...
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle battle the ruthless Caesar to rescue the mighty Gaul warrior, Vercinix.

programme.title: Forget Me Not
programme.desc: Haunted by images of the past, Gabrielle goes to the Temple of Mnemosyne to forget her painful memories.

programme.title: Fins, Femmes & Gems
programme.desc: When Aphrodite obtains the stolen Mystic Diamond, she puts a spell on Xena, Gabrielle and Joxer to distract them from rescuing the prized jewel.

programme.title: Tsunami
programme.desc: Xena, Gabrielle and Autolycus summon all their resources to escape from a ship submerged by a monstrous tidal wave.

programme.title: Vanishing Act
programme.desc: Xena, Gabrielle and Autolycus pull off a spectacular heist to retrieve the golden statue of Pax.

programme.title: Sacrifice, Part I
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle struggle in vain to prevent the rebirth of Gabrielle's child Hope, the evil daughter of Dahak.

programme.title: Sacrifice, Part II
programme.desc: Xena reluctantly agrees to join forces with Callisto to kill Gabrielle's evil daughter Hope.

programme.title: Adventures in the Sin Trade - Part I
programme.desc: Distraught with grief over the loss of Gabrielle, Xena travels to Siberia and the Amazon Land of the Dead to find her friend.

programme.title: Adventures in the Sin Trade - Part II
programme.desc: Xena travels to the Amazon Resting Place to battle the evil Witch, Alti, and learns that Gabrielle is still alive.

programme.title: A Family Affair
programme.desc: Xena reunites with Gabrielle and the two friends face off with the evil Hope and Dahak's grandson, the monstrous Destroyer.

programme.title: In Sickness And in Hell
programme.desc: Suffering from an array of physical ailments, Xena and Gabrielle battle a Scythian army.

programme.title: A Good Day
programme.desc: Xena engineers a giant battle between Caesar and Pompey to save Greece.

programme.title: A Tale of Two Muses
programme.desc: Xena, Gabrielle and Autolycus bring dancing to a town where it is banned.

programme.title: Locked Up And Tied Down
programme.desc: Xena is banished to Shark Island Prison for all the crimes and murders she committed in her dark past.

programme.title: Crusader
programme.desc: Xena and Najara, a radiant young woman who preaches about the Light, compete for Gabrielle's heart and soul.

programme.title: Past Imperfect
programme.desc: In order to save a town from destruction, Xena must figure out who is copycatting her past evil deeds.

programme.title: The Key To The Kingdom
programme.desc: A double for Xena double-crosses Autolycus in an attempt to steal a special baby.

programme.title: Daughter of Pomira

programme.title: If The Shoe Fits

programme.title: Paradise Found
programme.desc: In a seemingly idyllic land, Gabrielle finds peace and calm as Xena is beset by visions of violence.

programme.title: Devi

programme.title: Between The Lines

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Xena invokes the help of the god Krishna (Rajiv Varma) to rescue Gabrielle and Eli (Timothy Omundson) from Indrajit (Rajneel Singh), the King of Demons.

programme.title: The Convert

programme.title: Takes One to Know One
programme.desc: On a dark and stormy night, Xena must determine which one of her friends is a murderer.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: When Brutus kills Ephiny, Gabrielle is called back to be queen of the Amazons.

programme.title: The Ides Of March
programme.desc: Callisto returns to tempt Xena as Caesar plans to declare himself emperor.

programme.title: Deja Vu All Over Again
programme.desc: A woman is convinced she is the reincarnation of Xena, the Warrior Princess.

programme.title: Fallen Angel
programme.desc: After being crucified by the Romans, Gabrielle's (Renee O'Connor) soul struggles to save Xena (Lucy Lawless), who literally becomes a demon from Hell.

programme.title: Guatemala
programme.desc: Fresh bull testicle ceviche and possum Sunday dinner in Guatemala where ancient flavors are still alive.

programme.title: Croatia's Dalmatian Coast
programme.desc: Ancient tastes in Croatia like roasted dormice and giant offal kebabs to baked rooster and grilled frog.

programme.title: Paris Reborn: Cow Heads, Caves
programme.desc: Mushrooms harvested in underground caves; brined ham delivered to the presidential palace; aging artisanal French cheese.

programme.title: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Cheese-steak and shad cake to turkey neck and pig liver in Philadelphia where pride brings good food.

programme.title: Oaxaca
programme.desc: Winged ants, grilled intestines, grasshoppers and dried beef hearts enjoyed in Mexico's culinary capital.

programme.title: Amsterdam
programme.desc: Unique re-inventions of traditional Dutch recipes in Amsterdam from goose croquettes to insect-filled nuggets to smoked local eel and hollow pig head.

programme.title: Kansas City Snoots and Spleens
programme.desc: Andrew tours Kansas City for pig snoots, backyard woodchuck and BBQ.

programme.title: Jerusalem
programme.desc: Andrew travels to Jerusalem for tastes older than the city itself; he tries cow udder, veal brain, turkey balls and mullet roe.

programme.title: Madrid
programme.desc: Andrew visits Madrid for pig heads, organ omelets and duck liver jewelry.

programme.title: Senegal
programme.desc: Andrew harvests ancient sea salt, roasts a sheep's head and fishes the wild waters in Senegal's West African culture.

programme.title: North Carolina
programme.desc: Andrew tastes pig appendix and raw turtle testicle; hunting feral hogs and brewing ancestral pot likker.

programme.title: The Bronx
programme.desc: In the Bronx, Andrew tries coyote and raw clams from Long Island Sound.

programme.title: Okinawa
programme.desc: Andrew visits Okinawa, Japan, to taste poisonous pufferfish and raw goat.

programme.title: Shanghai
programme.desc: Andrew goes to Shanghai for softshell turtle, snail shells and live snake.

programme.title: Stockholm
programme.desc: Putrefied herring; smoked sperm; reindeer testicle; aged horse meat; high-end hot dogs; whiskey goose blood soup.

programme.title: Cyprus
programme.desc: Stuffed grape leaves and pork belly in Cyprus; curdling goat milk and sampling sun-dried goat; the world's oldest cookie.

programme.title: Lewis and Clark Trail
programme.desc: Andrew follows in the footsteps of Lewis and Clark while experiencing the bountiful cuisine of the Pacific Northwest; sampling Pacific lampreys, forages for edible barnacles and harvests for sea salt on this culinary adventure.

programme.title: The Southern BBQ Trail
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern eats his way through the Southern BBQ Trail; dry-aged brisket in Atlanta; liver nip dumplings in South Carolina; raccoon hash in Hull, Georgia.

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern sinks his teeth into the foods that have sustained soldiers and civilians since the lean times of the Civil War and shaped a region's cuisine, from barbecued raccoon and squirrel stew to tooth-cracking hard tack.

programme.title: Road Tripping Route 66
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern sets off on historic Route 66, where he tries ranch dressing soda, judges a calf fry cook-off and dines at some of the most iconic diners along the world-famous highway; quail stew, onion burgers and ox tail.

programme.title: Great Lakes
programme.desc: From pork shoulder cooked underground to hearty pasties and whitefish plucked from the tumultuous Lake Superior, Andrew Zimmern explores the cuisine of the individualistic Upper Peninsula in Michigan.

programme.title: The Pacific Coast Highway
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern cruises up the most scenic highway in America on a seafood-sampling adventure; hagfish fishing in the Pacific, eating the slimy reproductive organs of sea urchins and foraging for juicy gooseneck barnacles.

programme.title: Magnificent Mississippi River
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern follows Mark Twain's path down the Mississippi River for a slice of Americana; floating from meal to meal, he tries frog legs on a cargo ship, hunts wood duck, grills huge fish ribs and learns the art of Deep South pheasant pot pie.

programme.title: Cajun Country Trail
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern heads south to explore Louisiana's Cajun country; from blood sausage to chewy ginger cakes, seafood gumbo to wild hog heart, Andrew finds that Cajun country is rife with edible resources and French-inspired recipes from the past.

programme.title: Twin Cities
programme.desc: Old-fashioned is combined with modern innovation to create some interesting comfort foods in Minneapolis and St. Paul.

programme.title: New Orleans
programme.desc: Bizarre Foods America visits the Big Easy where the food and the culture are a mix of Southern traditions and modern influence. Andrew eats stuffed pig stomach and smoked raccoon served with a side of live jazz.

programme.title: Seattle
programme.desc: Andrew visits Seattle, where the food scene can be high-tech or ruggedly simple. He's an eyewitness to how complicated gadgets create brand-new tastes, and he visits an all-natural farm to eat cow placenta.

programme.title: Boston
programme.desc: Andrew visits Boston to prove that a traditional city can be a breeding ground for new food trends. He meets a group of Harvard scientists, and a Cambodian family that injects new food traditions into a Boston suburb.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Andrew finds out if it is food that keeps Detroit's motor running. Andrew visits Motown and gets revved up about tasting some of the city's food, including iconic soul food and lamb brain sandwiches, in the heart of Arab America.

programme.title: West Virginia
programme.desc: West Virginia's culinary delights are celebrated, including fresh deer organs after a kill, groundhog burgoo, and a roadkill cook-off.

programme.title: Charleston
programme.desc: Andrew gets a taste of the rewards from hard work and discovers the true flavor of Charleston's food scene.

programme.title: Savannah
programme.desc: Andrew tastes the cultural influences of the Southern city of Savannah on the sea and dines with The Lady Chablis.

programme.title: Las Vegas
programme.desc: Hamburger that costs five thousand dollars; a seafood restaurant that has an Italian fish market flown in every day; dinner for 1,800 people at Muhammad Ali's 70th birthday.

programme.title: San Diego
programme.desc: From wild vegetables to wild animals, Andrew gets a taste of the unexpected when he visits San Diego.

programme.title: Miami
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern tracks down the iconic treasures and hidden delights that make Miami's food scene so special.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: Zimmern explores the many layers of flavors from the past and present that can be found in this southwestern state.

programme.title: L.A. Pop Up
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern creates a menu inspired by his travels around the world for a hungry dinner crowd in LA.

programme.title: Austin
programme.desc: Bloody Mary's made with real blood, whole roasted pigeons, donuts topped with chicken and milkshakes made with bacon.

programme.title: The Blues Trail
programme.desc: Andrew tastes everything from southern staples like smoked baloney sandwiches, deep-fried chicken livers, and pork rinds, to new spins on old staples.

programme.title: The Other Florida
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern goes deep into the interior of Florida and discovers that people in the rural areas are still living off the land and eating much like their ancestors did.

programme.title: Washington D.C.
programme.desc: Fresh snakehead pulled from the Potomac; pupusas at a Salvadoran restaurant; peanut butter sandwiches made with foie gras.

programme.title: Denver
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain oysters at a ballpark; yak and elk served at an historic restaurant; pheasant cooked outside.

programme.title: Iowa

programme.title: Alaska's Inside Passage

programme.title: Wisconsin

programme.title: Chicago's Cutting Edge
programme.desc: A fish dish made with ambergris; charcuterie that includes duck heart pate; a soup that smells like a dead body.

programme.title: Portland

programme.title: Hidden Los Angeles

programme.desc: Andrew wants to find out what Hawaiians really like to eat; dried octopus bile sac; crispy pork intestine;and a traditional take on a raw fish salad that includes the eyeballs.

programme.desc: Andrew visits the forgotten Gulf shore where people strive to preserve their own unique way of life; stingray tacos; pan fried duck testicles; nutria stew.

programme.title: Birmingham: The New South
programme.desc: A Chinese style noodle bowl made with frog legs and pig skin; sautéed rabbit offal and goat head soup.

programme.title: Rhode Island

programme.title: Louisville: Bourbon and Burgoo
programme.desc: Andrew visits Louisville, KY, when he tastes its unique foods; barbecued sheep meat, pork brain sandwiches and burgoo, a hunter's stew made with squirrel.

programme.title: St. Croix

programme.title: St. Louis
programme.desc: Brain sandwiches and crispy pig snouts; pig heart pastrami; dessert made with organ meats and caramel sauce.

programme.title: Houston

programme.title: New Jersey

programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern makes some tasty new discoveries in Cleveland; pig head; kidney ramen; popcorn shoots.

programme.title: Back to Basics
programme.desc: Dave buys a 1965 Volkswagen bus to restore, re-upholster and flip.

programme.title: De-pimp My Ride, Please!
programme.desc: Handicap golf professional Dennis Walters asks Dave to de-pimp his ride.

programme.title: Anyone Know Where I Can Find a Bitchin' Ride?
programme.desc: Dave transforms a stock '68 Camaro for a client from Massachusetts.

programme.title: Nomad? No Way!
programme.desc: The crew takes on a 1955 Nomad that's been through two previous shops.

programme.title: New Season, New Headache
programme.desc: A 1957 Ford Fairlane 500 that hasn't seen the road since 1957 gets revived.

programme.title: Mint Condition
programme.desc: The team faces obstacles while trying to get the Fairlane's engine running.

programme.title: On the Road Again
programme.desc: Dave and Kevin head to Colorado in hopes of winning an award for the shop.

programme.title: It Sounds Bitchin', Let's Make It Look Bitchin'
programme.desc: A 1969 Camaro's new owner wants to finish its build with fresh upgrades.

programme.title: The Supernova
programme.desc: Sixteen years in the making, the shop is finally finishing a '67 Nova.

programme.title: The One Where Nick Gets Arrested
programme.desc: The guys prepare for Pleasanton, CA, and a major West Coast car show.

programme.title: That's One Bitchin' Grocery Getter
programme.desc: A repeat client and collaborator brings a 1927 Shadow Rod to the shop.

programme.title: I Blew Your Inheritance on a Bitchin' Ride
programme.desc: A client wants the shop to build his dream car, a 1958 Lincoln Continental.

programme.title: A Lincoln Legend
programme.desc: With approval from "The Boss," the Continental build continues.

programme.title: Land of 10,000 Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Kevin and Dave gear up for the biggest car show in America in St. Paul, MN.

programme.title: If It Was Easy, Anyone Could Do It
programme.desc: The shop's next challenge is a 1967 Chevelle with a Great 8 pedigree.

programme.title: A Family Affair
programme.desc: The Kindig family works to create a retirement gift: a '57 Corvette.

programme.title: It's Getting Hot in Here
programme.desc: The shop pulls out all the stops for the last car show of the season.

programme.title: The Future is Now
programme.desc: A client enlists the shop to update a '32 Roadster for his wife's birthday.

programme.title: The Secret Client
programme.desc: Dave must find and transform a 1967 GTO for a secret client.

programme.title: GT...OHHH HELL YEAH!
programme.desc: The final details on the 1967 GTO come together to create a masterpiece.

programme.title: We Build Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and the team start a one-of-a-kind build with a 1964 Ford Ranchero.

programme.title: 24 Karat Magic
programme.desc: Dave struggles to find the perfect name for the Ranchero build.

programme.title: The Little Sister
programme.desc: A father-daughter team wants a little sister for the '65 Safari Bus.

programme.title: A Caldera-What?
programme.desc: An old build is back for an interior revamp and a new name.

programme.title: The Hummer of the Future
programme.desc: Dave tries to envision what the Hummer H2 might look like in the future.

programme.title: Fiberglass, Fiberglass and More Fiberglass
programme.desc: The team tries to correct flaws in a Mercedes Gullwing kit car.

programme.title: The Snowball Episode
programme.desc: A '41 Chevy rolls in for a trunk-lid fix, but things go south quickly.

programme.title: Green for the Money
programme.desc: The Mercedes Gullwing build finally comes to an epic conclusion.

programme.title: Where's the Gold, Paulie?
programme.desc: Dave and the crew swap the chassis of a 1955 Chevrolet Nomad.

programme.title: Dave Kindig, Guest Judge
programme.desc: A show in Stockton wants Dave to be a judge and to present a special award.

programme.title: Veruca Violet
programme.desc: A '63 Corvette gets an LSX engine, a larger transmission and new paint.

programme.title: Little Red Corvette
programme.desc: The crew stretches a '62 Corvette and makes some other improvements.

programme.title: The Last Mopar
programme.desc: Vinnie Massaro is back looking to build the biggest, baddest Mopar ever.

programme.title: The Bitchin' Coronet
programme.desc: Metal work on the '67 Coronet is done, so now it's on to the paint booth.

programme.title: Two Cadillacs, Too Reliable
programme.desc: For years Mike has wanted to build a 200-mph Cadillac, and now David has finally agreed to make it happen; they purchase a 1961 bubbletop Cadillac DeVille in Northern California; a Cadillac 500 engine wrapped inside a '73 AMC Gremlin.

programme.title: Twice the Power, Half the Trucks and Leah Pritchett
programme.desc: David and Mike merge the front halves of two four-wheel-drive vehicles.

programme.title: Rear-Engine Replacement: The Econorado Is Born
programme.desc: David and Mike attempt to fill the Mazdarati void with their new Econorado.

programme.title: 440 Big-Block Samurai: From the Junkyard to the Road
programme.desc: David and Steve built the Super Sammy, a junkyard-rescued Suzuki Samurai that they crammed a 440 Chrysler big-block into right where it sat in the middle of the junkyard; now they're back to find out why Suzuki never offered this engine combination.

programme.title: The Ultimate Beater Burnout Machine
programme.desc: David and Mike consider themselves masters of burnout-ology; yet they have never actually entered a burnout competition until now; they take a rusted-out '76 Camaro and set out across Texas to show how to scientifically get the best burnouts.

programme.title: Junkyard Rescue Four-Speed Big Block
programme.desc: David and Mike take a 1964 Ford Galaxie 500 XL that absolutely needed to be rescued; after a few miles, the car begins to smoke worse than any car in the history of Roadkill.

programme.title: Cheap Beater Battle
programme.desc: David and Mike find beaters under $3K; it's a four-vehicle shootout with Chevy vs. Ford, truck vs. car, and old vs. newer; Freiburger chose a 2006 Crown Vic and a 1999 Chevy S-10; Finnegan went vintage with a 1972 Ford Maverick and a 1976 Chevy LUV.

programme.title: Parking Lot Engine Swap
programme.desc: The guys return to a parking lot to swap out the engine in a '74 Jag XJ12.

programme.title: Trading Cars Across Power Tour
programme.desc: Mike and David drive a new car every day as they trade their way through the 25th Hot Rod Power Tour; each day, they'll swap their junk for someone else's and try to make it to the next stop on the tour.

programme.title: Junkyard Rescue T-37 Pontiac!
programme.desc: Steve finds a '71 Pontiac T-37 at a junkyard in Idaho; Mike and David take their time reviving a motor that's been sitting for 38 years.

programme.title: Road Trip Survival: The LUV Is All You Need!
programme.desc: Mike Finnegan and Tony Angelo buy a mid-1970s Chevy LUV mini-truck and hit the road, enduring electrical problems, torrential downpours, water in the engine, and floods.

programme.title: Episode 100: Back to Throwing Darts!
programme.desc: David and Mike take the show back to its roots, but take things to new heights with a bigger map and a four-door Dart; they'll see how the 2013 version stacks against the '76 318-powered Dodge that started it all.

programme.title: Project Car Showdown and Roadkill Nights Powered by Dodge!
programme.desc: David and Mike bring their best Dodge project cars out to the M1 Concourse for the annual Roadkill Nights event in Pontiac, Mich.; this time, it's a road course, skidpad and drag racing with seven favorite projects.

programme.title: Blasphemi takes on HOT ROD Drag Week!
programme.desc: Mike, Tony and the '55 Chevy race for glory in a brutal five-day test for drag-racing, street-driven cars; Blasphemi is known for three things, going fast, being awesome and breaking apart.

programme.title: Rotsun Lives Again!
programme.desc: The guys want to revive the long-neglected '71 240Z and drive it to SEMA.

programme.title: Diesel Swapped Drag Racing Torino Wagon!
programme.desc: Mike and Tony divert from a road trip to accept a drag racing challenge.

programme.title: Hilarious Car Shootout
programme.desc: Mike and David buy each other their worst automotive nightmares and put them to the test against Steve in a showdown; Finnegan rides high, Freiburger works through some "cosmetic" damage and Dulcich rampages through fire.

programme.title: Blown T-Bird Winter Road Trip!
programme.desc: The T-Bizzle is an '86 Thunderbird powered by a 302 V8, topped with a 6-71 blower and welded gears; Freiburger and Finnegan take it across the frozen tundra of the northern U.S., on a classic road trip with plenty of fail.

programme.title: Top Project Car Updates!
programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan take a look at Roadkill's Top Project Cars.

programme.title: D100 Pick Up Rescue!
programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan clean out wheels that have been stashed in the garage for far too long by slapping them on a neglected '66 Dodge D100 Utiline truck; they hit the road on a quest to find the perfect 440 for it.

programme.title: At-Home Build-Off: COVID 350 vs Mini Truck!
programme.desc: The guys scrounge their parts piles and come up with impressive results.

programme.title: Cheap 4x4 Challenge!
programme.desc: Freiburger and Dulcich settle who has the better cheap 4x4.

programme.title: Budget Drag Build and Battle!
programme.desc: The guys have a build off and race like no other; Tony transforms a shell of an '85 Monte Carlo into a beast, while Finnegan makes Newbern's Nova run with ramp truck parts; it's three days of wrenching, two tracks and one unbelievable race.

programme.title: Barn Find Firebird Rescue!
programme.desc: Mike Finnegan and David Newbern rescue a mint '67 Pontiac Firebird that has been stowed in a barn for almost two decades; the guys battle old parts, downpours and other issues in order to get this old drag car racing down the track once again.

programme.title: Road Trippin' the Wreck Runner!
programme.desc: Freiburger and Dulcich hit the road in the '68 Wreck Runner, a four-speed, 383ci clone made from the scraps of a '68 Road Runner and a '68 Satellite; it only has a few little issues; they hit the road to sort 'em out.

programme.title: Barnfind Firebird vs. Crusher Camaro!
programme.desc: Finnegan and Newbern take the barn-find '67 Firebird on an 800-mile road trip to race Freiburger and Dulcich in the Crusher Camaro.

programme.title: Dirt Track Rally Shootout!
programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan race Dulcich and Newbern in a dirt-track shootout.

programme.title: No-Prep Drag Race Mustangs!
programme.desc: The guys try their hand at no-prep drag racing against Lyle Barnett and his turbocharged 1,500-hp Beer Money Mustang.

programme.title: Two Legends Become One
programme.desc: For years, Pigpen, the junkyard rescued 1950 GMC truck, has sat dormant; the guys awaken a monster by donating the chassis of their own legendary 1985 S-15 in a body swap for the ages, then take on Randy Pobst at Atlanta Motor Speedway.

programme.title: Dirt Track Racing Mini-Honda!
programme.desc: Everyone wants their car to be better, faster, stronger, but a difference is hard to make on a budget; David Newbern and Mike Cotten may not have all the answers, but they're willing to give it a run by mixing affordable upgrades with sweat equity.

programme.title: Crown Victorious
programme.desc: The guys uncover a cop car racing series around the Ford Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor; with a handful of bolt-on upgrades, they turn their former police auction find into a road race ripper around Willow Springs.

programme.title: Baja Bug V-8 Swap!
programme.desc: The guys take on off-road Baja legend Cameron Steele on a brutal desert off-road course with a Baja Bug; they may be outmatched by Cameron's unlimited racing rig, but the addition of a 350 V-8 to their Bug closes a big gap.

programme.title: Lifted Lambo Mud Truck!
programme.desc: The guys take their V-8-powered Pontiac Fiero-based Lamborghini Countach kit car known as the Scamborghini and give it a 6-foot lift to take on an insane wheelie-popping mud truck through what's known as a bounty hole.

programme.title: '57 Chevy Two-Day Turnaround!
programme.desc: The guys take a big-block '57 Bel Air to compete in the autocross at Cruisin' the Coast in Miss.; with a complete overhaul of the suspension in the event's parking lot, the guys find out how much lap time they can shave in a weekend.

programme.title: V-8 Baja Bug Suspension
programme.desc: Off-road legend Cameron Steele warned the guys that a V-8 swap wouldn't cut as much time as a long-travel suspension could; now Newbern and Cotten finally heed his advice, going all-out with major suspension upgrades to their Baja-inspired VW Beetle.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: (2/4) The Doctor and Romana discover that someone is smuggling the dangerous narcotic, Vraxoin.

programme.title: Part 3
programme.desc: (3/4) The Mandrels have escaped from the Eden projection and are attacking the passengers.

programme.title: Part 4
programme.desc: (4/4) Unless the Doctor and Romana act quickly, the villains will escape justice.

programme.title: Part One
programme.desc: (1/4) With the TARDIS disabled, the Doctor is powerless to act when Romana is kidnapped.

programme.title: Part Two
programme.desc: (2/4) The Doctor attempts to repair the TARDIS so that he can come to Romana's rescue.

programme.title: Part Three
programme.desc: (3/4) The Doctor and Romana suspect that the Nimon are a small part of a large invasion.

programme.title: Part Four
programme.desc: (4/4) On Crinoth, Romana discovers the truth behind the Nimon's empty promises.

programme.title: The Dead Planet
programme.desc: (1/7) The travellers venture out on to the surface of a new world.

programme.title: The Survivors
programme.desc: (2/7) The Doctor, Ian and Susan discover that they have exposed to radiation.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: (7/7) The Thals and the time travellers attack the Daleks.

programme.title: The Escape
programme.desc: (3/7) Fearful of a Thal attack, the Daleks force Susan to trick the Thals.

programme.title: The Ambush
programme.desc: (4/7) Pretending to be a Dalek, Ian finds that that he is trapped inside the casing.

programme.title: The Expedition
programme.desc: (5/7) Ian and Barbara join a Thal expedition that will penetrate the Dalek city.

programme.title: The Ordeal
programme.desc: (6/7) The Doctor and Susan are once again taken prisoner by the Daleks.

programme.title: The Edge of Destruction
programme.desc: (1/2) The Doctor and his crew begin to act strangely after a mysterious explosion on the TARDIS.

programme.title: The Brink of Disaster
programme.desc: (2/2) The time travellers are in grave danger as the TARDIS nears total disintegration.

programme.title: The Sea of Death
programme.desc: (1/6) The TARDIS lands on a remote island, surrounded by a sea of acid.

programme.title: The Velvet Web
programme.desc: (2/6) In the city of Morphoton, the Doctor, Barbara, Ian and Susan are welcomed as guests.

programme.title: The Screaming Jungle
programme.desc: (3/6) Ian and Barbara find a temple in the jungle. Inside is Darrius, keeper of one of the keys.

programme.title: The Snows of Terror
programme.desc: (4/6) In a snowy wasteland, Vasor, an unscrupulous trapper, imprisons the travelers.

programme.title: Sentence of Death
programme.desc: (5/6) Arriving in Millennius, Ian is put on trial for murder. The Doctor takes his case.

programme.title: The Keys of Marinus
programme.desc: (6/6) The Doctor solves the murder mystery and finds the final missing key.

programme.title: The Temple of Evil
programme.desc: When Barbara meets the Aztecs they mistake her for a reincarnation of the High Priest.

programme.title: The Warriors of Death
programme.desc: Barbara's interference in Aztec traditions cast doubt over her supposed divinity.

programme.title: The Bride of Sacrifice
programme.desc: Barbara's divine powers are challenged and she humiliates Tlotoxl.

programme.title: The Day of Darkness
programme.desc: Can the Doctor and his companions escape before they are sacrificed to the Sun God?

programme.title: The Strangers in Space
programme.desc: (1/6) The crew onboard a spaceship have been trapped in a state of permanent paralysis.

programme.title: The Unwilling Warriors
programme.desc: (2/6) Communicating through Susan using telepathic powers, the Sensorites contact the Doctor.

programme.title: Hidden Danger
programme.desc: (3/6) The Doctor and his companions uncover a shattering truth on the Sense-Sphere.

programme.title: A Race Against Death
programme.desc: (4/6) Convinced that Ian has actually been poisoned, the Doctor decides to investigate.

programme.title: Kidnap
programme.desc: (5/6) Carol puts herself in danger when she attempts to find the Doctor at the aqueduct.

programme.title: A Desperate Venture
programme.desc: (6/6) The Doctor and Ian discover the identity of the strange creatures that poisoned the water.

programme.title: Planet of Giants
programme.desc: The crew arrive in a place where everything is on a giant scale, the result of the TARDIS doors malfunctioning.

programme.title: Dangerous Journey
programme.desc: The Doctor realizes that the government scientist, Farrow, has been murdered while Barbara inadvertently comes into contact with the poisonous strain of insecticide.

programme.title: Crisis
programme.desc: The Doctor and Susan are reunited with Ian and Barbara. As Barbara's health deteriorates, the crew find the formula for DN6, the pesticide which could now be responsible for killing Barbara.

programme.title: World's End
programme.desc: (1/6) The Doctor and his companions arrive in a London very different from what they remember.

programme.title: The Daleks
programme.desc: (2/6) The Doctor and Ian are captured and taken to the Dalek ship.

programme.title: Day of Reckoning
programme.desc: (3/6) Hiding on board the Dalek spaceship, Ian is taken to the mines of Bedfordshire.

programme.title: The End of Tomorrow

programme.title: The Waking Ally
programme.desc: (5/6) Ian and his friend Larry are chased by the Slyther, protecting the Bedfordshire mines.

programme.title: Flashpoint
programme.desc: (6/6) Barbara realises how to control the Robomen and orders an attack on the Daleks.

programme.title: The Powerful Enemy
programme.desc: (1/2) The Doctor and his companions meet a lonely orphan and a paralyzed man.

programme.title: Desperate Measures
programme.desc: (2/2) The Doctor realizes that Bennett has not been honest with him or with Vicki.

programme.title: The Slave Traders
programme.desc: (1/4) The Doctor is mistaken for a murdered lyre player and targeted by an assassin.

programme.title: All Roads Lead to Rome
programme.desc: (2/4) Barbara is sold as a slave and Ian is to be trained as a gladiator.

programme.title: Conspiracy
programme.desc: (3/4) Poppaea plans to poison Barbara who has become the object of Neros affections.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: (4/4) Inspired by the Doctor, Nero sets Rome ablaze.

programme.title: The Web Planet
programme.desc: The TARDIS lands on a planet that affects its systems. The Doctor and his companions must save the ship, while assisting an oppressed alien race to regain control of their world.

programme.title: The Zarbi
programme.desc: The Doctor, Ian and Vicki have been captured by the Zarbi and taken into a control center.

programme.title: Escape to Danger

programme.title: Crater of Needles

programme.title: Invasion
programme.desc: Returning to the Carsenome with the Menoptra's isop-tope device, the Doctor and Vicki are herded into a chamber where they are enveloped in a web-like substance, what next for the Doctor.

programme.title: The Centre

programme.title: The Space Museum
programme.desc: The Doctor and his companions are horrified to discover they are exhibits in the museum.

programme.title: The Dimensions of Time
programme.desc: The enslaved Xeron race sense an opportunity to topple their Morok invaders.

programme.title: The Search
programme.desc: With the Doctor held captive, his companions try to prevent him becoming an exhibit.

programme.title: The Final Phase
programme.desc: Ian orders the Doctors revival as the Xerons' revolution begins to gather pace.

programme.title: The Executioners
programme.desc: (1/6) Ian and Vicki are trapped by tentacled creatures on the planet Aridius.

programme.title: The Planet of Decision

programme.title: The Meddling Monk

programme.title: A Battle of Wits
programme.desc: (3/4) Steven and Vicki discover an atomic bazooka.

programme.title: Checkmate
programme.desc: (4/4) Discovering the Monks plan, the Doctor is determined to stop him meddling with history.

programme.title: The Steel Sky
programme.desc: (1/4) The TARDIS arrives in what appears to be a jungle on Earth.

programme.title: The Plague

programme.desc: Steve Harvey assumes the hosting duties for this daytime game show in which five members of one family are pitted against five members of another family. Each team's goal is to guess the results of audience survey questions. A player from each team initially faces off, answering the question to earn the chance to either pass or play. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

programme.title: Five Guns West

programme.title: The Gunfight At Dodge City

programme.title: Terror In A Texas Town

programme.title: Gun The Man Down

programme.title: Invitation To A Gunfighter

programme.title: Return Of The Seven

programme.title: Guns Of The Magnificent Seven

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
programme.desc: When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

programme.title: Dances With Wolves
programme.desc: Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell and Graham Greene star is this masterpiece that took home 7 Academy Awards, including Best Picture. Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar (Costner) befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under

programme.title: Posse

programme.title: Wild Bill

programme.title: The Glory Guys

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Vegetarian
programme.desc: Nick ponders on the question of whether or not he could ever be a vegetarian. The answer is a solid "no." However, he has fun trying and in the process discovers some fabulous new dishes which are not exactly vegetarian, but nonetheless are loaded with spectacular flavors. Dishes include: Chilled Cantaloupe Soup / Salmon with Spinach and Pancetta Cream Sauce / Biancomangiare (Sicilian Almond Pudding).

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Inventor
programme.desc: Nick describes about what it takes to be in touch with yourself as a chef and what lessons to look at to further culinary passion. Dishes Include: Salad Lyonnaise with Poached Egg / Pork Schnitzel with Jaeger Sauce / Strawberry Pudding.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Great Outdoorsman
programme.desc: Chef Stellino recalls the joys of camping, or lack therof. Dishes include: Pollo Alla Cacciatore (Chicken Cacciatore) / Pork Chop Alla Milanese / Macedonia Di Frutta (Marinated fruit salad in liquor and sugar).

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - Maine Maple Sunday
programme.desc: Lisa visits a local sugar shack to learn how maple syrup is made during the early spring maple syrup season in Maine. Back at home, she bakes a maple walnut cake, then treats her chickens to some winter treats and shares an easy DIY project for the chicken coop.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - The Chicks are Coming!
programme.desc: It's spring in Maine, so Lisa is planting seeds and getting ready for baby chicks. After making a fun DIY project for her chickens who lay eggs, she shares her best tips and attempts to get one of her hens to raise some baby chicks, then shares a recipe for Scotch Eggs.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - Apple of my Eye
programme.desc: Lisa makes a small basket using wood scraps and wire. Then she takes a trip to a local orchard and bakes an apple pie with some of the apples she's picked. She demonstrates how to make homemade apple cider vinegar, introduces several of her chickens, then makes them some apple treats.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - The Great Pumpkin
programme.desc: It's fall in Maine, so Lisa shares a few tips for planting garlic, then heads to a local family-owned farm to find the perfect pumpkin for her fall decor. After learning some pumpkin growing tips, she chooses a few pumpkins and bakes one of her favorite fall desserts - pumpkin swirl cheesecake - and of course shares some of the pumpkin with her flock.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - Moo Vous Plait
programme.desc: Lisa visits a local cow farm in search of fresh milk to make homemade ice cream, only to find out that the Scottish Highlands at the farm aren't dairy cows. But the second farm she visits does raise dairy cows, so Lisa tries her hand at milking, then shares bowls of homemade blackberry basil ice cream for a few friends to enjoy after a day on the lake.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - An Old-Fashioned New England Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Lisa prepares a holiday meal for friends, but instead of turkey, she decides to highlight some traditional New England Thanksgiving recipes including spiced cranberry sauce, popovers, seafood chowder, and a sweet Indian pudding. And of course she shares some of the scraps and leftovers with her chickens so they can enjoy their own holiday feast.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - Let There be Light
programme.desc: Before Lisa heads south to visit the annual holiday light display at the Coastal Maine Botanical Gardens, she shares a favorite childhood sweet treat. Then after enjoying the festivities, she ends the evening with a traditional creme brulee made with her fresh eggs. She also explains why light is so important in a chicken coop and how to handle the lack of light during the long Maine winters.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Surviving Thanksgiving
programme.desc: We get it. Thanksgiving is the biggest, most intimidating meal of the year for most cooks. You won't have to worry about that because Sara Moulton has you covered! She'll show you how to cook the turkey so it's never dry, how to prep gravy and mashed potatoes ahead so you don't have to do everything at the last minute, plus recipes for three easy and delicious side dishes.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Turkey Day
programme.desc: Pati is preparing an epic Thanksgiving meal like no other because this one has a Yucatecan twist. Trade in your turkey for a citrus brined bird and boxed stuffing for one with chorizo, apple and cornbread. Brussels sprouts get spiced up with habaneros and pork belly. With Pati's family and closest friends around the table, don't expect there to be any leftovers.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking At Home - Turkey - Not-quite-traditional Roast Turkey Dinner
programme.desc: This meal is the holiday favorite that is so good, Julia & Jacques recommend it for any day of the year. Roast Turkey with sausage and cornbread stuffing, gravy made the old-fashioned way, accompanied by creamed onions and a zesty Cranberry-Apple Chutney. The "not-quite" which has to be seen, is the inventive way the turkey is cut-up before cooking, roasted and re-assembled for serving.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Apples
programme.desc: In the orchards of upstate New York, Georgia Pellegrini explores the idea of "uncultivation"--a way of working with nature rather than controlling it. From regenerative apple growing to slow-crafted cider and brandy, she meets makers who transform fruit into something lasting, revealing how time, patience and imperfection shape both flavor and meaning.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Maine
programme.desc: In Maine, Georgia Pellegrini explores the delicate balance between wild ecosystems and the people who steward them. From ancient wild blueberry barrens to regenerative oyster farms and cutting-edge marine research, she follows a network of growers, fishers and scientists working in sync with nature -- revealing how diversity, care and innovation can sustain both food systems and the future.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Surviving Thanksgiving

She'll show you how to cook the turkey so it's never dry, how to prep gravy and mashed potatoes ahead so you don't have to do everything at the last minute, plus recipes for three easy and delicious side dishes.

With Pati's family and closest friends around the table, don't expect there to be any leftovers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Roasting and Baking
programme.desc: The oven is on in Lidia's kitchen, and she is using it for sweet and savory dishes. To start, she makes a springtime crunchy, cheese roasted asparagus dish. Next is a family favorite, baked eggplant with tomatoes, created with cheese and herbs, topped with a baked egg. Then it's time for sweets as she prepares an almond torte with chocolate chips served with a mound of whipped cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Fall's Flavorful Favorites
programme.desc: Lidia creates a seasonal meal that says 'Family Time'. Pork and grapes are a natural combination, and in today's menu she prepares Pork Medallions with Grapes; Baked Fennel with Sage and for dessert, a colorful and perfect cold weather Orange in Marsala for dessert.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Surviving Thanksgiving
programme.desc: We get it. Thanksgiving is the biggest, most intimidating meal of the year for most cooks. You won't have to worry about that because Sara Moulton has you covered! With Pati's family and closest friends around the table, don't expect there to be any leftovers.

programme.title: MIX Cocktail Hour - A Bourbon Thanksgiving
programme.desc: It's a very special MIX Cocktail Hour Thanksgiving Special with host Tamee Harrison, MIX head barman Scott Cushman, and the spirit of holiday cocktail gifting.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Martha Washington Won the War
programme.desc: We all know Martha Washington from her portraits as a dowdy grandmother, but did you know that there is new evidence she was a beautiful and passionate wife befitting her handsome George? And that Martha was the secret weapon that kept troop morale high during the hard winter encampment at Valley Forge? We prepare Martha's authentic Turkey Stew with Oysters and speak with expert Patricia Brady.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Jefferson's Monticello - Part 1
programme.desc: We start a special four-part series cooking in Thomas Jefferson's actual kitchen at Monticello, his Virginia home. Chef Staib prepares Jefferson's favorite exotic dish, Stuffed Cabbage with Fried Asparagus. We also tour Jefferson's gardens, where we learn how important discovering and growing foods was to our third President.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Jefferson's Monticello - Part 2
programme.desc: In this next episode at Monticello, we learn how Thomas Jefferson "liberated" grains of European rice to grow here in America, and tour his legendary Monticello estate, including the Dependencies that housed the beer and wine cellars, and the ice house. Chef Staib also borrows Jefferson' kitchen to prepare Bouilli, a favorite boiled beef dish of Jefferson's, along with Bouillon Potatoes.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Jefferson's Monticello - Part 3
programme.desc: During his years abroad as Minister to France, Jefferson's culinary tastes became refined. In this episode, we get to know James Hemmings, Jefferson's slave cook who accompanied Jefferson to learn the ways of French cuisine. We also meet Jefferson's long-time Monticello cooks, Edith Hern Fossett and Fanny Hern. Chef Staib prepares White Bean and Bacon Soup, Chicken Fricassee, and Herbed Barley.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Jefferson's Monticello - Part 4
programme.desc: We end our tour of Jefferson's Gardens at Monticello as we learn how the President carefully cultivated over 330 vegetable varieties, along with a host of fruits. Chef Staib prepares a tour-de-force final meal in Jefferson's kitchen. Curried Lamb and with Rice Pilaf and Stewed Mushrooms, along with Leni Sorensen, Monticello's expert on the slave cooks who worked there.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Ben Franklin's Genius
programme.desc: From discovering how to harness electricity to inventing reading glasses and publishing the first daily newspaper in America, Ben Franklin's genius was a spark that helped to launch a country. We visit the American Philosophical Society, which he founded, to learn more about this most amazing man. Chef Staib prepares Braised Oxtail, and he toasts Franklin with his authentic Spruce Beer.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Washington's Crossing Pepperpot Soup
programme.desc: Before the Christmas night in 1776 when Washington led his troops to a surprise attack on the British at Trenton, he ordered one of their favorite meals to be ready upon their return, Pepperpot Soup with Cornbread. Chef Staib makes this West-Indies influenced dish again, right at that same spot along the Delaware, with revolutionary troops at his side to celebrate that all important victory.

programme.title: A Taste of History - The Washingtons at Mount Vernon - Part 1
programme.desc: When George Washington wasn't busy governing a fledgling nation, he enjoyed spending time at his family plantation, Mount Vernon. Tour the "Jewel of the Potomac" and join Chef Walter Staib in Washington's very own kitchen as he prepares some of the first President's favorite dishes such as Roasted Beef Marrow, Baked Stuffed Sturgeon, Roasted Root Vegetables and Citrus Vinaigrette.

programme.title: A Taste of History - The Washingtons at Mount Vernon - Part 2
programme.desc: Meet "Martha Washington" as she brings her years with George to life. Always a gracious hostess, "Martha" invites Chef Walter to tea. We also see the Washingtons' personal china and silverware from Mount Vernon. In the kitchen, Chef Walter's menu includes Pickled Herring Bonne Femme, Roasted Stuffed Grouse, Braised Sunchokes and Sweet Potato Biscuits.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Barbecue Takes Flight
programme.desc: Barbecue Takes Flight: What's America's most popular meat? It's Poultry. Americans consume more than 112 pounds per person each year. Today Steven prepares an astonishing array of grilled poultry from brandy brined rotisserie chicken to duck legs flame roasted Peking-style. And with a special guest a Project Fire first: turkey "ribs"-found in St. Louis, and virtually nowhere else.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Bird Meets Smoke
programme.desc: Some of the world's greatest poultry dishes owe their soulful character to wood smoke. Find out how to master the fundamentals of smoking poultry-from curing and brining to smoking in charcoal smokers and pellet grills. Plus, discover how to electrify barbecue sauce with chipotle (smoked jalapeño) chilies.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Fire Birds
programme.desc: Poultry is one of the most versatile meats to cook over fire. From the Republic of Georgia comes tabaka, citrusy butterflied chickens grilled under a press with piquant Rhubarb Tkemali sauce. From Fez, grilled chicken and onion kebabs marinated in Charmoula. Pound cake gets the grill treatment with fresh berry "salsa" and whipped cream. Finally, a smoke-roasted turkey with butter and truffles.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Thanksgiving Comes Early
programme.desc: Don't wait until Thanksgiving to try these new twists on holiday favorites: whiskey-brined turkey smoked over maple wood; bacon-stuffed barbecued onions; smoky creamed corn; fiery jalapeno cranberry salsa; and a smoky bacon-apple crisp for dessert. No oven required! These recipes call for a ceramic smoker, upright barrel smoker, electric smoker, and stovetop smoker.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Turkey
programme.desc: This meal is the holiday favorite that is so good, Julia & Jacques recommend it for any day of the year. Roast Turkey with sausage and cornbread stuffing, gravy made the old-fashioned way, accompanied by creamed onions and a zesty Cranberry-Apple Chutney. The "not-quite" which has to be seen, is the inventive way the turkey is cut-up before cooking, roasted and re-assembled for serving.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Desserts
programme.desc: Jacques and Julia create some very special desserts in this colorful episode. Poires Belle Helene - poached pear perched atop pound cake drizzled with chocolate sauce; sweet creamy rich and delicious Strawberries Sabayon; and Crepes Suzette, classically flambéed and served with orange butter and powdered sugar, as well as a Hungarian inspired torta of layered crepes baked with raspberry jam.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Salads
programme.desc: Jacques dressed in a toga? For the Julia's Caesar Salad, of course! This show has a salad for everyone, from a simple mixed green salad with a garlic vinaigrette, to classic Caesar and Nicoise (with fresh seared tuna) Salads. How about some Potato Salad? Well, Julia and Jacques prepare two: an American style potato salad with home made mayonnaise, and its tart French cousin.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Vegetables
programme.desc: Julia and Jacques prepare artichokes-several ways-including artichoke hearts stuffed with spinach and mushroom Duxelle. Julia demonstrates her secret to ever-green cooked string beans and butter bruised peas. Jacques counters with his aromatic Tomato Provencal.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Beef Stew
programme.desc: Sounds rather ordinary for this celebrated duet...but here, Jacques and Julia demonstrate why Beef Burgundy and Pot Roast have beens favorite "classic" recipes (here and in France) for what seems like "forever," and they put their own signature on it "Swiss cheese mashed potatoes" (for the Beef Burgundy), and "soft ribbon noodles" (fort the Pot Roast).

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Roast Chicken
programme.desc: Perfectly roasted chicken says Julia, is a telltale of a really good cook. Here are three ways to perfectly roasted chicken. Whether whole rack-roasted or trussed and stuffed under the skin with a savory and shallot sauté, or butterflied and roasted with a delicate spice rub, each has a crispy golden brown skin and juicy meat that say "Hmmmm! Great chicken!"

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Soufflés
programme.desc: Julia and Jacques demonstrate the art, and the adventure, of the Soufflé. Julia extends the classic cheese soufflé to super-height...and Jacques creates a light, fluffy, flavorful scallop and cheese soufflé in a large casserole. For dessert, a chocolate soufflé and cream roulade. Twinkies were never this good!

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Charcuterie
programme.desc: Julia and Jacques demonstrate recipes for sausage and paté that are right out of the French countryside. Made from scratch sausage and lentil salad, country paté (2 ways), and, for a finale, a grand truffle infused sausage wrapped in fresh baked brioche (recipe also demonstrated).

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Comfort Food
programme.desc: Poached chicken, chicken pot pie and rustic apple tart dessert. Julia and Jacques show how simple it is to poach a chicken with vegetables, mushrooms and a little white wine, and then take that poaching liquid and use it with the leftover poached chicken for a flaky crusted chicken pot pie. The same simple pastry Julia makes for the pot pie is perfect base for a rustic apple and dried fruit tart.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Potatoes
programme.desc: One Potato, two potato, oh, so many potatoes. Julia and Jacques share their tricks, "trucs" and techniques for perfect baked potatoes, airy mashed potatoes, creamy potato casserole, and delightful lighter-than-air crispy-fried pommes soufflés.

She'll show you how to cook the turkey so it's never dry, how to prep gravy and mashed potatoes ahead so you don't have to do everything at the last minute, plus recipes for three easy and delicious side dishes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Antipasti
programme.desc: Lidia shares several dishes that will work for any party, including a selection of cheese, cured meat, and Giardiniera-style vegetables; an easy and quick sweet & sour zucchini dish and lastly stuffed mushrooms made with a delicious mixture of scallions, red peppers, and fresh parsley. Lastly, there is still time for a delicious salad of poached seafood featuring shrimp, mussels, and calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Braising
programme.desc: Lidia serves up a crispy golden Italian style quiche followed by a fork tender beef braised in Barolo. Her side dish is a braised broccoli rabe with garlic and extra virgin olive oil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Grandma's Favorites
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia honors the Grandmothers of the family. She starts with a delicious and quick Skillet Gratin of Mushrooms and Chicken, one of her mother's favorites. As the chicken is cooking, she heads to the side dish, Celery Potatoes and Tomatoes. Joining her at the end of the show is Lidia's granddaughter, Julia to taste Grandma Rosa's Apple Cake.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Warming Fall Flavors
programme.desc: As fall approaches, the weather chills and summer vegetables lose their vibrancy. Jacques uses the final days of tomatoes and eggplant to make his ratatouille cooked with a pork roast. He follows with comforting dishes with Brussels sprouts, lamb shoulder chops and his wife's Arroz con Pollo. And, because apples are at their peak, he makes Apple Compote.

programme.desc: As fall approaches, the weather chills and summer vegetables lose their vibrancy. Jacques uses the final days of tomatoes and eggplant to make his ratatouille cooked with a pork roast. He follows with comforting dishes with Brussels sprouts, lamb shoulder chops and his wife's Arroz con Pollo. And, because apples are at their peak, he makes Apple Compote.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Turkey
programme.desc: This meal is the holiday favorite that is so good, Julia & Jacques recommend it for any day of the year. Roast Turkey with sausage and cornbread stuffing, gravy made the old-fashioned way, accompanied by creamed onions and a zesty Cranberry-Apple Chutney. The "not-quite" which has to be seen, is the inventive way the turkey is cut-up before cooking, roasted and re-assembled for serving.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Desserts
programme.desc: Jacques and Julia create some very special desserts in this colorful episode. Poires Belle Helene - poached pear perched atop pound cake drizzled with chocolate sauce; sweet creamy rich and delicious Strawberries Sabayon; and Crepes Suzette, classically flambéed and served with orange butter and powdered sugar, as well as a Hungarian inspired torta of layered crepes baked with raspberry jam.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Roast Chicken
programme.desc: Perfectly roasted chicken says Julia, is a telltale of a really good cook. Here are three ways to perfectly roasted chicken. Whether whole rack-roasted or trussed and stuffed under the skin with a savory and shallot sauté, or butterflied and roasted with a delicate spice rub, each has a crispy golden brown skin and juicy meat that say "Hmmmm! Great chicken!"

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Comfort Food
programme.desc: Poached chicken, chicken pot pie and rustic apple tart dessert. Julia and Jacques show how simple it is to poach a chicken with vegetables, mushrooms and a little white wine, and then take that poaching liquid and use it with the leftover poached chicken for a flaky crusted chicken pot pie. The same simple pastry Julia makes for the pot pie is perfect base for a rustic apple and dried fruit tart.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Potatoes
programme.desc: One Potato, two potato, oh, so many potatoes. Julia and Jacques share their tricks, "trucs" and techniques for perfect baked potatoes, airy mashed potatoes, creamy potato casserole, and delightful lighter-than-air crispy-fried pommes soufflés.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Turkey Day
programme.desc: Pati is preparing an epic Thanksgiving meal like no other because this one has a Yucatecan twist. Trade in your turkey for a citrus brined bird and boxed stuffing for one with chorizo, apple and cornbread. Brussels sprouts get spiced up with habaneros and pork belly. With Pati's family and closest friends around the table, don't expect there to be any leftovers.

programme.title: MIX - Beef & Bourbon
programme.desc: Tamee visits LOCK AND KEY SOCIAL DRINKERY & KITCHEN in Downey CA. Bourbon & beef are the pride of this neighborhood hangout where the specialties of the house are a 4O ounce Tomahawk Steak and the Billionaire Cocktail.

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen - Carolina Reaper Cheeseburger, Meatloaf
programme.desc: Carolina Reaper Cheeseburger and Meatloaf

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen - Crispy Pork, Wrapped Chicken

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen - Tomahawk Steak, Deep Fried Steak Sandwich
programme.desc: Tomahawk Steak and Deep Fried Steak Sandwich

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen - Horse Pizzas, Rope Tacos, Cheese & Egg Toast
programme.desc: Horse Pizzas, Rope Tacos and Cheese & Egg Toast

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Philippe Boulot, Anne Kearney, and Michael Maddox
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Dungeness Crab Roll with Carrot Salad, Seared Squab with Rice, and Almond Tuile with Passion Fruit Custard. Restaurants include: The Heathman Hotel Portland, Peristyle in New Orleans, and Le Titi de Paris in Arlington Heights.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Guenter Seeger, Paul Bartolotta, and Gerard Partoens
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Lamb Roulade on Zucchini, Scampi, and Summer Berries with White Chocolate Mousse. Restaurants include: The Dining Room in Atlanta, Spiaggia in Chicago, and The Peabody in Orlando.

programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Green Tomato Gazpacho, Fried Rabbit, and Rich Pistachio Brownie with Ganache. Restaurants include: The Peabody Hotel in Memphis, Yuca Restaurant in Miami Beach, and The Inn at Blackberry Farm in Walland.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Tamara Murphy, Roland Liccioni, and Jea Weitlauf
programme.desc: Recipes: Provencal Fish Soup with Rouille, Daurade with French Green Beans, and Cannoli with Zabaglione Sauce.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Rick Bayless, Nick Apostle, and Kevin Boxx

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Frank Lee, Gary Danko, and Alan Sayers
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Sauteed Shiitake Mushrooms with Foie Gras, Steamed Moroccan-style Salmon Steak, and Chilled Summer Fruit Soup with Sesame Ice Cream. programme.title: Cucina Amore - Bruschetta
programme.desc: Quick and easy, toasted garlic bread topped with chopped tomatoes, basil and garlic followed by pasta.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Baked Swordfish
programme.desc: Swordfish steaks smothered in onions, cheese & rich tomato sauce served with classic Italian risotto.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Onion Glazed Pot Roast
programme.desc: Family favorite, melt-in-the-mouth pot roast and onions in hearty gravy served with creamy mashed potatoes.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Shrimp in the Pot
programme.desc: Tender shrimp cooked in a flavorful sauce of wine, garlic and tomato sauce served with baked tomatoes.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Sausage Stuffing
programme.desc: Flavorful stuffing of spicy sausage, mushrooms, cheese & seasoned bread crumbs fills thick & juicy pork chops.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Roasted Chicken
programme.desc: Flavor-filled chicken roasted with wine, rosemary and sage served with garlicky oven roasted potatoes.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Terrine of Roasted Eggplant
programme.desc: Sweet roasted eggplant with spicy bread crumbs and tangy cheese combine in a melt-in-your-mouth appetizer.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Seafood Pasta
programme.desc: Shrimp, scallops & pasta are especially flavorful cooked in an aluminum foil pouch, and ice cream cake.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - A Meal to Impress
programme.desc: Martin and his guest, Michael Lomonaco, show us how to impress your friends and be the life of any dinner party with these unique dishes.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Dishes for Every Palate
programme.desc: Martin whips up three delectable dishes that are sure to please any discriminating palate. Today it's shrimp, chicken and trout as only Chef Yan can.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Versatile Dishes
programme.desc: Quick & easy means versatility. Martin demonstrates how these three recipes can be enjoyed for both lunch & dinner, on their own, as a side dish or together as a meal.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Cantonese Favourites
programme.desc: Martin and his guest, Sara Moulton, explore the exciting world of Cantonese flavours with these variations on some traditional favourites.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Martin takes us on a culinary adventure through the Pacific Rim with these quick and easy recipes for crab, sea scallops and rice. Top it off with a refreshing Guava Bellini and you can almost feel the balmy breeze!

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Home Cooking
programme.desc: No time? No problem! Martin proves you don't need to spend hours in the kitchen to make a great, home-cooked meal.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - China & Korea
programme.desc: Two culinary powerhouses come together, as Martin and his guest, barbeque master Rick Browne, explore the difference between Korean and Chinese flavours to create these quick and easy dishes.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - A Simple Meal
programme.desc: Martin shows us how a few simple ingredients can add zing to pork chops, rice and vegetable dishes.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Risi
programme.desc: Three new ideas from a simple pot of rice. We'll set up a risotto bar with lots of creative toppings, make a warm vanilla-flavored Rice Pudding with summer fruit, and mix a beautiful Insalata di Riso with asparagus, fava beans, peas, lemon, ham and herbs. Then we'll see the wine country from the Napa Valley Wine Train.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Primavera
programme.desc: Simple dishes show off the flavor of new peas and asparagus. We'll make a Cheater's Chicken Stock (when there's no homemade stock on hand), a bright green Spring Pea Soup, a quick, tender and lemony Peas and Cipolline dish, and Halibut with Asparagus and Salsa Genovese. We'll see the vineyards of the wine country covered in golden mustard blossoms, and drop in on the Mustard Festival.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Mama's Favorites
programme.desc: Foods that warm the heart and soothe the soul. A ten-minute technique for making olives bright and lively, homemade mozzarella, which we serve en carrozza - in a "carriage" of bread dipped in egg and anchovies - and turkey polpettone filled with a center of melting cheese. We'll learn the stories behind the valley's scenic, historic stone walls.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Mama's Favorites
programme.desc: Foods that warm the heart and soothe the soul. A ten-minute technique for making olives bright and lively, homemade mozzarella, which we serve en carrozza - in a "carriage" of bread dipped in egg and anchovies - and turkey polpettone filled with a center of melting cheese. We'll learn the stories behind the valley's scenic, historic stone walls.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Surf or Turf
programme.desc: Discover a lemon marinade and other secrets for preparing artichoke hearts. We'll sear a sea bass and make an artichoke salad with red onions, kalamata olives, lemons, and other Mediterranean flavors. We'll cook baby lamb chops and artichokes and serve them with a creamy, tangy egg-lemon sauce. And we'll cross the hill to see the other food and wine-loving valley, Sonoma.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Zuppe, Zuppe, Zuppe
programme.desc: Soup makes a meal and, with a few techniques, becomes a sauce the next day for fish, poultry or meat. Summer Corn Soup, served warm or cold, makes a beautiful yellow sauce for scallops. Tart apples and sweet butternut squash make a soup that becomes a full-bodied sauce for pork chops. We'll visit a ghost winery and meet some third-generation California winemakers.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Buttering Up
programme.desc: Our favorite pantry secret stays in your freezer. Compound butters are flavored with fresh herbs and spices, rolled into logs, and kept cold to retain all their flavor. We'll make a Garlic Thyme Butter, a Basil Chive Butter for steak, bruschetta or corn, and a Bagna Cauda Butter for fresh clams and pasta. And we'll visit some of the architectural gems of the Napa Valley.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Breakfast in Turlock
programme.desc: A real farmer's breakfast with potato hash, eggs, and Damn Hot Peppers. We'll finish with Verbena Coffee and a refreshing honey zabaglione that you can make ahead and chill or serve warm. We'll drop in on Michael's hometown of Turlock, California.

programme.title: Superfoods with Chef Walter Staib - Beans and Lentils
programme.desc: Beans don't have to be boring! Try them in Minestrone Soup, French Lentil Salad, and Hummus.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: School Dance
programme.desc: A teen (Bobb'e J. Thompson) hopes to impress a girl he likes by winning a spot on his school's hottest dance crew.

programme.title: A Family Matters Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas is anything but ordinary when bickering siblings in a newly blended household magically switch bodies.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon).

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

programme.title: 12 Rounds 3: Lockdown
programme.desc: Framed for a homicide by his fellow officers, a detective (Dean Ambrose) tries to expose the conspiracy to clear his good name.

programme.title: As Good as Dead
programme.desc: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

programme.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programme.desc: Jimmie and his best friend Mont try to reclaim the house built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship and sense of belonging in the place they call home.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: The Women of Brewster Place
programme.desc: A multigenerational story of the lives of several black women who call an inner-city tenement home.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
programme.desc: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
programme.desc: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
programme.desc: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
programme.desc: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.

programme.desc: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband.

programme.desc: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

programme.desc: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

programme.desc: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.
