programme.title: You Can Leave Your Hat On
programme.desc: When Jodi's cooking gives five young men food poisoning, the women of Drovers must convince the Killarney men to put on a strip show.

programme.title: Stripped Bare
programme.desc: Drovers Run is cleared out by thieves while Jodi and Craig take advantage of everybody else's absence from the ranch to enjoy a secret rendezvous in the spa.

programme.title: Blame it on the Moonlight
programme.desc: Claire is irritated over Tess's three homestay guests: they're starting to shear today, and the last thing she needs is tourists getting in the way.

programme.title: Made to be Broken
programme.desc: Claire and Alex's potential clients are being put off by rumours circulated by Peter that, ten years ago, Alex was responsible for crippling a boy, Stefan Van Amstel when he deliberately ran his car off the road.

programme.title: Best of Enemies
programme.desc: Tess meets Sandra Kinsela at the cattle sale yards and likes her instantly, only to discover Claire dislikes her intensely. Their childhood dispute is renewed when a herd of calves is stolen from Drovers Run and Claire is convinced that Sandra is responsible.

programme.title: Wind Change
programme.desc: Tess is on the brink of committing to Nick but she is struggling with the intensity of her feelings for him. Meanwhile, Jodi and Alberto are forced to move back to Drovers Run when they are kicked out of their apartment in town after being unable to pay the rent.

programme.title: No More Mr Nice Guy
programme.desc: On the eve of the Gungellan Show, Claire is presented with repossession papers for Drovers Run. Nick and Tess become estranged after Tess walked out on him, but she tries to explain her actions of the previous night.

programme.title: Future Perfect
programme.desc: Peter offers to stop the repossession of Drovers Run if Claire marries him, but she rejects his proposal. She is injured in a fall during the Stockman's Challenge and the accident reveals her pregnancy. In order to help Claire, Alex steps forward to claim paternity.

programme.title: Fairy Tale, Ending
programme.desc: Claire returns to Drovers Run after her stay in the hospital, but she must deal with the lie she told that Alex is the father of her child when he isn't.

programme.title: Better The Devil You Know
programme.desc: Harry lends Claire his prize bull, which upsets Tess for not being consulted. Jodi returns from her holiday and Alberto proposes to her. With Becky's blessing, a date for the wedding is set, but three weeks is a bit sudden for Meg.

programme.title: The Road Home
programme.desc: Jodi is busy making plans for a huge wedding that is becoming too much for Alberto's liking and Meg's finances. When Alberto informs Jodi that her mother is intending to sell her jewels to pay for the event; Jodi decides a simple, traditional wedding may be better.

programme.title: An Affair to Forget
programme.desc: Tess believes Sally is cheating on Nick when she sees her in town with another man. Jodi's wedding plans go down the drain when Alberto learns about the affair she had while overseas, and Jake tries to help Becky cope with her feelings following Brett's death.

programme.title: Put to the Test
programme.desc: As a pre-Bucks Night prank, Craig and a couple of his mates kidnap Alberto and leave him in the middle of nowhere. When Jodi finds out, she goes ballistic and searches for Alberto with Craig.

programme.title: The Wedding
programme.desc: With last-minute wedding preparations underway, Jodi's father blows in unexpectedly, which creates tensions in the family.

programme.title: Gone to the Dogs
programme.desc: Becky senses the mystery surrounding Jake's past when he convinces her to help him save a prized racehorse from thieves. Sally accidentally leaves a gate open and a herd of sheep damages Tess and Nick's wheat crop.

programme.title: The Ghost of Things to Come
programme.desc: Claire uncovers a long-lost treasure which brings back memories of her mother and unleashes a fear that she will also die in childbirth. Tess organises a fake séance to try to ease Claire's fears and there are some surprising results.

programme.title: A House of Cards
programme.desc: The joy surrounding Harry and Liz's 30th wedding anniversary is shattered when Harry's nagging suspicions about Alex not being the father of Claire's baby explodes into a fit of rage after an innocent remark leads to Liz confessing a long-held secret.

programme.title: Three Little Words
programme.desc: Relations between Alex and his father take another turn for the worse when Alex discovers he has been cut off financially. Nick tries to play peacemaker but both sides are stubborn and his efforts go unappreciated.

programme.title: Repeat Offenders
programme.desc: Anticipation is high as Tess's journalist friend is due to arrive at Drovers Run to write a feature magazine article about life on the land. However, tensions between her and Tess begin to rise as old wounds are reopened and long-forgotten feelings are revisited.

programme.title: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: Becky feels betrayed when she learns Jake's true identity from his father at the auctions. Jodi discovers the real reason Kylie left home when she goes through Kylie's mail. A pending court date for a shoplifting charge is rapidly approaching but Kylie seems willing to ignore it.

programme.title: Jokers to the Right
programme.desc: The charade of being the father of Claire's baby is causing problems for Alex, especially when Sandra Kinsella appears on the scene.

programme.title: Chain Reaction
programme.desc: When Jodi receives a mysterious chain letter, she discards it immediately. The scattered pieces of the letter have barely hit the compost when Becky announces that the cattle are sick. Further misfortune soon strikes Drovers Run, with Terry falling ill and the discovery of a dead sheep.

programme.title: The Awful Truth
programme.desc: Nick and Alex must face the awful truth of their father's new girlfriend while they argue over Harry's proposal for a stock route through Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Tess stubbornly refuses to ask for outside help to shear her alpacas, insisting on doing the job herself.

programme.title: Seeing the Light
programme.desc: Mysterious lights are seen by Claire and Tess over Drovers Run. Tess is determined to believe they are a good omen, but Claire, restless and uneasy in the last stages of pregnancy, insists that trouble awaits.

programme.title: A Slight Interruption
programme.desc: A mob of Emus descends upon Drovers Run, wreaking havoc on everything they encounter. The chaotic situation is just one more stress for Claire who is struggling to balance the demands of motherhood with that of running the ranch.

programme.title: Old Beginnings
programme.desc: Claire is having a naming ceremony for Charlotte Prudence McLeod with her friends and family when Peter arrives. Claire has written to him after the birth, telling him he is a father. Peter is justifiably angry.

programme.title: Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: Determined to prove herself during a Fire Service training weekend, Jodi quickly realises it's going to be far more difficult than she had anticipated. Meanwhile, Meg is dedicating herself to her studies and is thoroughly immersed in 'Pride and Prejudice'.

programme.title: Perfect Match
programme.desc: Becky and Jake join in a business partnership with Claire and Tess; Claire has issues with some of Jake's clients.

programme.title: Let the Best Man Win
programme.desc: Alex and Nick come to the rescue of an attractive woman named Ellie when her car breaks down on a country road. Almost instantly they're pitched into a competition to woo her.

programme.title: Majority Rules
programme.desc: When Drovers Run is quarantined and the future of the stock placed under a cloud, true friends seem few and far between as Claire finally goes head-to-head with her old enemy Sandra Kinsella. Meg and Terry have their eye on a piece of land but are unable to come up with the deposit, until an offer of help comes from an unlikely person.

programme.title: The Ties That Bind
programme.desc: Claire's role as spokesperson for the local farmers' association requires her to visit Melbourne. Alex is insistent that he come along to look after them while also pursuing some Wilgul matters, but the real reason is that he wants to meet his biological father.

programme.title: One Step at a Time
programme.desc: Claire and Alex are still in Melbourne, blissfully in love. At Drovers, Tess and Dave are making plans for their wedding day. When Tess, in the shower, discovers a lump in her breast, she fears she will share her mother's fate and quickly goes into denial, telling no-one.

programme.title: Time Frames
programme.desc: Tess and Dave split up when they realise that he has not yet come to terms with the death of his wife. Meanwhile, prompted by Becky, Claire asks Harry if she can use King Harold in a new breeding program on Drovers.

programme.title: Body Language (aka The Bottom Line)
programme.desc: Drovers Run hosts the Regional Young Farmer of the Year Contest, and Becky is surprised to learn that Jake has entered. He tells her he's going to win her back. They compete neck and neck and slowly Becky is won over by his persistence and charm, and the old spark between them returns.

programme.title: To Catch a Thief
programme.desc: Tess's upcoming operation has thoughts of mortality creeping in, so she begins to write a letter to Charlotte so that her niece can know her, should Tess no longer be around. Meanwhile, Claire reminisces when an old friend turns up unexpectedly.

programme.title: My Noon, My Midnight
programme.desc: Heartbreak hits Drovers Run. Tess anxiously awaits the results of her breast cancer tests, convinced that her time is up, while Alex and Claire decide to move in together.

programme.title: The Long Goodbye
programme.desc: Claire's death has everyone dealing with it in their own way. Tess tries to keep her emotions in check, unable to deal with her grief and burdened by survivor's guilt. Terry, Jodi, and Meg are left with the task of running Drovers Run and dealing with funeral arrangements.

programme.title: Turbulence
programme.desc: Tess and Stevie continue to clash and all the ill-feelings come to the surface when a private investigator turns up. Tess accepts Stevie's explanations at first but gets suspicious when Stevie is caught packing her bags.

programme.title: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: Six months after Claire's death, Tess has thrown herself into her work. She wants to assure Charlotte's future, as well as remain faithful to Claire's dream for Drovers. Bushfires sweep through the area and Tess has to face it alone until Stevie turns up to fight by her side.

programme.title: Double Dealing
programme.desc: Stevie agrees to do a seemingly simple favour for Sandra to repay her for not pressing charges for stealing her plane. To get out of Sandra's scheme, Tess takes a big gamble, confident she can defeat Sandra in a winner takes all poker game.

programme.title: Jack of All Shades
programme.desc: Tess is surprised in the middle of the night by a stranger named Jack Blake who knocks at the door looking for Jack McLeod... his father. Tess's mind is spinning with the possibility of a new member of the family - something she is lacking after Claire's death.

programme.title: Day of Reckoning
programme.desc: Brad Whittaker, the new Stock, and Station agent make a good first impression on the women of Drovers Run, but things quickly go downhill from there. Sandra has a surprising solution when Alex and Nick face a heart-wrenching decision

programme.title: Great Expectations
programme.desc: Stevie's first encounter with fallen rodeo champion Ken Logan occurs when she stops off at his garage for petrol. When Ken later collapses at work, he leaves Stevie with a cryptic message, believing she is his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Game of Chance
programme.desc: When Tess's ideal fantasy world collides with reality, she finds herself being forced to decide between Nick and Dave, the two men who love her.

programme.title: When Sparks Fly
programme.desc: Nick and Tess's relationship, or at least what remains of it, is further tested when she discovers that Nick and Alex have started an intensive farming operation and have dammed off the creek.

programme.title: Show of Love
programme.desc: Alex can't believe it when his first love, Tracy Morrison, shows up at Killarney. She soon makes a very tempting offer to Alex; one that appears to involve more than just a business arrangement.

programme.title: Father's Day
programme.desc: On Charlotte's first birthday, Tess learns she has a fight on her hands when Peter returns wanting full custody of Charlotte. In support, Alex enlists the help of his barrister father Bryce to help Tess in her custody battle.

programme.title: Flesh and Blood
programme.desc: An old abandoned well on Drovers Run holds a forgotten secret for Tess, forcing her to re-evaluate her stance in the custody battle with Peter, and leading her to a difficult decision about Charlotte's future. Meanwhile, Harry and Sandra have a surprise for Alex and Nick.

programme.title: Fool For Love
programme.desc: Stevie's ex-husband arrives at Drovers Run with some surprising news: their divorce never went through and he's here to win her back. Meanwhile, Jodi's fundraising for the CFS gets a boost when she meets new recruit Dylan, and Dave and Nick continue to butt heads over Tess.

programme.title: Make or Break
programme.desc: When Tess's truck breaks down on the way to the sale, a stranger named Bree offers to help. Tess sends Jodi and Bree on to the sale with her cattle, but they end up being kidnapped and Tess must enlist the aid of Nick, Stevie, and Alex on her search.

programme.title: Second Chance
programme.desc: Meg's glamorous sister, Celia Rivers, arrives at Drovers Run. They have a falling out over their disparate lives and Celia heads into the bush in a huff and gets lost. The Drovers women, with Nick and Alex, set out in search of her.

programme.title: Call Me Kate
programme.desc: Jodi battles with what seems like the biggest decision of her life after her old friend Kate Manfredi arrives at the ranch. Tess hires Kate on a three-month probation period because they need all the help they can get at Drovers Run.

programme.title: Desperate and Dateless
programme.desc: Heading to the Bachelor and Spinsters' Ball, the girls from Drovers Run are ready for a big night out. On the way, they pass Dave at a roadside field and newcomer Kate is immediately smitten.

programme.title: Magnetic Attraction
programme.desc: When Stevie's 13-year-old daughter Rose arrives unannounced, life at Drovers Run is thrown into turmoil for everyone, and Stevie is faced with revealing the biggest secret of her life.

programme.title: Every Breath You Take
programme.desc: The weekend of Stevie and Alex's rodeo school has finally arrived and they are excited with the prospect of turning their fresh-faced students into rodeo stars.

programme.title: My Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Stevie and Kane meet under less-than-perfect circumstances when they are brought together by a minor car accident at the truck stop. Despite the awkwardness of their introduction, the charismatic Kane makes a huge impression on Stevie.

programme.title: Saturn Returns
programme.desc: Tess's birthday forces her to take a long, hard look at herself, but she "sees" more than she bargained for and unwittingly creates some midsummer night's madness. Sandra and Harry ask Nick to father a child for them.

programme.title: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Kane's relationships with Stevie and Alex strains their friendship. They are each aiming for Kane's attention: Alex as a mate, Stevie as a lover; but they have no idea that Kane is using them both for his own advantage.

programme.title: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Tess decides to turn traditional courtship on its head and ask Nick to marry her, but it doesn't take long for the rest of the household to find out what she has in mind. Then, Dave makes a discovery that threatens to derail the proposal permanently.

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Vin Riley has come looking for Stevie and, more specifically, for the opals he believes are rightfully his. She decides to leave with Kane and the other women are stunned at her sudden decision. Stevie hasn't told them about Vin, so they can't help feeling hurt as she has chosen a life with Kane so quickly.

programme.title: Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: Feeling that she's been given an omen, Tess becomes increasingly afraid, for Nick, for Charlotte, even for the safety of the pregnant ewes, which she insists be brought in to the house paddock for lambing.

programme.title: Where There's Fire
programme.desc: Just as romance starts blossoming between Jodi and Luke, her position in the Country Fire Service is compromised when suspicion falls on Luke over a series of arson attacks.

programme.title: Trembling on the Brink
programme.desc: After an earth tremor, the cattle are skittish and the bore has dried up on Drovers Run. Tess worries that it is a sign before her wedding to Nick. In the interests of harmony and good omens, Tess decides to invite Sandra to her hens night, something that makes Sandra suspicious.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Carnival of Souls
programme.desc: The stars of MST3K bring their comedic riffing treatment to Carnival Of Souls! Mike, Bill and Kevin load into the car, their pockets jingling with fresh souls and spend a few hours at the Carnival!

programme.title: The Bride and the Beast
programme.desc: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 50's horror classic about a lovely woman attracted to beasts.

programme.title: Live: Santa and the Ice Cream Bunny
programme.desc: One of the strangest, most baffling Christmas movies ever made, Santa and The Ice Cream Bunny defies logic, reason, and we believe several laws of physics. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike

programme.title: Miami Connection
programme.desc: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy martial arts classic where Rock and Roll meets Tae Kwon Do! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike,

programme.title: RiffTrax: The Magic Sword

programme.title: La boda
programme.desc: Don Justo le obsequia a Plutarco unas argollas de matrimonio, pero las pierde. Plácido reprocha a su familia, su comportamiento en la boda de Plutarco y Gaby. En la luna de miel, a Plutarco le ocurre un accidente.

programme.title: El papá de la nena
programme.desc: Los López preparan una fiesta sorpresa para La Nena. Carlos, el papá de La Nena reaparece inesperadamente y le cuenta cómo ha sido su vida.

programme.title: Martina y Ricky
programme.desc: Martina tiene su primer novio, pero las cosas se salen de control cuando se inventa una vida que no tiene y a su vez, él también tiene un secreto que no se imaginan.

programme.title: Cambio de cuerpos
programme.desc: Al tratar de arreglar la antena de la televisión, un rayo cae sobre los López, provocando que todos cambien de personalidad. Renata le pide ayuda a una curandera y Plácido descubre que todo era un sueño.

programme.title: Cambio de hábitos
programme.desc: A Renata se le ocurre desintoxicar a su familia, así que les informa que cambiarán sus hábitos alimenticios. Don Arnoldo escucha que La Nena ya tiene novio y aprovecha para chantajearla con comida.

programme.title: Los cinco puntos
programme.desc: Plácido sigue las recomendaciones de las cinco cosas que un padre debe enseñarle a su vástago para que llegue hacer un gran hijo.

programme.title: El secreto
programme.desc: Martina escucha que La Nena tiene novio y la chantajea con decirle a la familia si no obedece sus órdenes. Cansada de los abusos decide hablar con la familia.

programme.title: El novio
programme.desc: Lichita lleva semanas sin hablarle a la Nena porque tiene novio y le exige que termine su relación. Renata propone que hagan una comida para que puedan conocer al novio de la Nena.

programme.title: Prueba de embarazo
programme.desc: Nena averigua que ella está embarazada.

programme.title: Votación
programme.desc: Adolfo se niega a ayudar con la manutención del hogar de la familia López y se lleva a La Nena a vivir a una comuna. La familia al extrañar a La Nena propone un acuerdo.

programme.title: La nueva dueña
programme.desc: Los López se preocupan porque la nueva dueña del edificio correrá a las familias que excedan de cuatro integrantes. Plácido le explica el porqué son 10.

programme.title: Mala suerte
programme.desc: La dueña del edificio comunica a los López que subirá la renta, pero Plácido por andar apostando, no tiene dinero para pagar. Los López consiguen dinero como pueden.

programme.title: Limitados
programme.desc: Plácido implementa un plan de austeridad en su casa para ahorrar, pero todo lo juega en sorteos. De pronto se entera de que se ganó un automóvil, pero no tiene teléfono para hacer la llamada y reclamarlo.

programme.title: Orígenes
programme.desc: Licha interroga a Adolfo y por fin se entera de dónde viene el novio de La Nena. Mientras tanto Martina hace una obra de caridad, convirtiendo a Tecla en una chica agradable.

programme.title: La casa del millón
programme.desc: Esteban Arce contacta a Plácido para que concurse por una enorme casa libre de impuestos. Los López tendrán que contestar a cinco preguntas, sin embargo, como en la última se tardan, pierden el premio. Aun así, reciben una sorpresa.

programme.title: El regreso
programme.desc: La familia López se queda sin hogar por un incendio. A causa de la desgracia, deben remodelar y volver a empezar. La policía arresta a Plácido por comprar muebles robados.

programme.title: Los muebles
programme.desc: Plácido regresa a su casa después de haber sido arrestado por la compra de muebles robados. Gaby y Plutarco logran conseguir muebles para la casa, también de dudosa procedencia.

programme.title: A trabajar todos
programme.desc: Plácido está preocupado a causa del desbalance económico que han sufrido por el incendio. Durante una reunión familiar, Plácido establece nuevas reglas y les exige a todos conseguir un trabajo.

programme.title: La venta del edificio
programme.desc: El administrador del edificio notifica a la familia López la venta del edificio donde viven, por lo que deben desalojar el departamento en menos de 24 horas, ya que un nuevo supermercado será construido ahí.

programme.title: Ahí va el agua
programme.desc: La familia López es notificada de que se les cortará el servicio del agua en su departamento. Los miembros de la familia intentan averiguar quién es el responsable de que les hayan retirado el servicio del agua.

programme.title: Tome su turno
programme.desc: Plácido expresa ante su familia su sentir acerca de la falta de intimidad que existe en su hogar. La nueva dinámica para poder vivir en casa de los López es aportar dinero, de lo contrario deben tomar su turno para poder residir ahí.

programme.title: El embarazo no deseado
programme.desc: La familia López se reúne con Tecla para que confiese la verdad sobre su embarazo. Tecla admite que lo hizo porque le gustó y reitera que lo volvería hacer. Tecla confiesa que fue con Adolfo y que fueron tres veces.

programme.desc: The Vietnam War's enemy, 'Charlie,' used guerrilla tactics, spreading terror and causing division in the U.S.

programme.title: 1933: The Fall of the Weimar Republic
programme.desc: The Weimar Republic comes to bear for many the humiliation of World War I and the blame for all its hardships; issues such as hyperinflation and the Great Depression drive many Germans into the arms of radical and extremist political parties.

programme.title: Hitler's Henchmen
programme.desc: Hitler's disturbed henchmen, driven by loyalty, committed atrocities, hiding genocide behind propaganda.

programme.title: As It Happened: Guadalcanal
programme.desc: US Marines' first Pacific War attack leads to a six-month battle against the Japanese, captured through lost photos and footage.

programme.title: 19 Years in Vietnam: Beans, Bullets and Bandaids
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was a costly conflict requiring strategic logistics to supply soldiers with essentials like "beans, bullets, and bandaids."

programme.title: Ukraine 2022: Attack on Freedom
programme.desc: Russia's invasion of Ukraine on February 24th, 2022, shocked the world. Despite Putin's claims, Ukraine's spirit endures. President Zelenskyy inspired resilience, and sanctions were imposed on Russia.

programme.title: Military Mayhem In Vietnam II
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was a long, costly, and divisive conflict that pitted North Vietnam against South Vietnam and its principal ally, the United States. The Vietcong, familiar with the jungle terrain, used it to their advantage, engaging in hit-and-run guerrilla warfare against inexperienced American soldiers, many of whom were young conscripts.

programme.title: Nazi Manhunt
programme.desc: The war is over, and the atrocities have been discovered. Thousands of Nazi officers attempt to flee the country, heading towards South America, believing they will find sympathy and evade justice. The allied forces, Britain, France, the United States, and Russia, all agreed to prosecute any living Nazi party officials for the crimes they had committed.

programme.title: The Korean War: No Longer Forgotten Part I
programme.desc: The Korean War, underestimated yet impactful, forced rapid military advancements amid a fierce ideological battle.

programme.title: As It Happened: Saipan
programme.desc: In June 1944, US forces landed on Saipan, marking their first step on Japanese soil. The battle was brutal, lasting three weeks. Reconnaissance photos and firsthand accounts provide unique insights.

programme.title: Führerbunker: Adolf Hitler's Final Days
programme.desc: As Germany falls in WWII, Hitler hides in the Führerbunker, abandoning his people. These are his final days.

programme.title: Aerial Assault Vietnam
programme.desc: Decades after it ended, the Vietnam War might seem like a distant memory. It was the longest war in American history and the only one from which the USA did not emerge victorious. A greater tonnage of bombs was dropped than in WWII. The war saw helicopters come into their own, transporting troops and supporting air power. For every pilot, there were dozens of support staff. The aerial bombardment of Vietnam remains one of the most staggering sustained attacks in history.

programme.title: Victory at Last: WWII is Over
programme.desc: Germany's defeat led to celebrations in the UK and North America. In London, crowds gathered at Buckingham Palace, where King George VI, Queen Elizabeth, and Winston Churchill appeared.

programme.title: Hitler's Best Kept Secret: The Eva Braun Tapes
programme.desc: Eva Braun, Hitler's mistress, documented life among Hitler's inner circle. The film reveals the Eva Braun tapes.

programme.title: On the Front Line: WWII Britain
programme.desc: World War II, a continuation of unresolved WWI disputes, resulted in 60 million deaths. Britain's front line efforts were pivotal in winning the war.

programme.title: Field of Operations: Balkans
programme.desc: Examining the early months of 1941 in the Balkans when Italy's offensive had stalled and a Greek counter-offensive pushed into Albania.

programme.title: D-Day Deceptions
programme.desc: It was the greatest secret of World War Two... the time and place of the D-Day invasion.

programme.title: Secret Submarines in WWII
programme.desc: From silent one-man midget subs to U-boats on secret missions, both sides used secret submersibles of all shapes and sizes to conduct clandestine warfare in the war.

programme.title: Nazi Gold
programme.desc: It was a tremendous booty, prized by Hitler as much as territory.

programme.title: Women Spies in World War II
programme.desc: They were unlikely heroes who fought behind enemy lines in every theater of World War Two.

programme.title: The French Resistance
programme.desc: Nazi Germanys invasion of France inflicted humiliation on the French.

programme.title: Cold War: Nixon's Secrets
programme.desc: The story behind Richard Nixon's resounding triumphs and crushing defeats.

programme.title: War in the Sky: The Story of the Royal Air Force
programme.desc: The RAF's journey from WWI to the Cold War, evolving from defense to a tactical force in major conflicts.

programme.title: As It Happened: Pearl Harbour
programme.desc: Reconstructing the 1941 Pearl Harbour attack with aerial photos and firsthand accounts, this film offers a unique view.

programme.title: D-Day: The Day That Won the War
programme.desc: On 6th June 1944, Operation Overlord, the Normandy landings, marked a pivotal moment in WWII, leading to a decisive victory for the Allies.

programme.title: The Verdict
programme.desc: A duty-conscious corrections officer falls for a younger inmate, helps him escape, leading to a search and media frenzy.

programme.title: Military Mayhem In Vietnam
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was a long, costly, and divisive conflict between North Vietnam and South Vietnam, with the US as a principal ally. The Vietcong used guerrilla tactics in the jungle, challenging young American soldiers. This war led to significant developments in US military strategies and technologies, as they adapted to the harsh conditions of jungle warfare alongside South Vietnamese forces.

programme.title: The Korean War: No Longer Forgotten Part II
programme.desc: Continue the journey through Korea's timeline, exploring hardships, victories, and the war's conclusion in Part II.

programme.title: Hitler's Fatal Mistake: The Fall of the Third Reich
programme.desc: With the declaration of war, Hitler's break with Stalin was a fatal mistake, leading to the Third Reich's fall.

programme.title: Military Mayhem In Vietnam III
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was a long, costly conflict between North Vietnam and South Vietnam, allied with the U.S. The Vietcong used jungle cover for guerrilla warfare against inexperienced American soldiers. It was a 360-degree war with attacks from all angles, where territory changed hands regularly and political loyalties were often unclear.

programme.title: The Battle Above: True Stories from WWII Pilots
programme.desc: Experience real accounts from WWII pilots as they share harrowing stories from aerial combat, revealing truths more powerful than fiction.

programme.title: Strike Missions: Balkans
programme.desc: An exhilarating breakdown of some of history's most decisive battles, featuring expert analysis and eyewitness accounts. The Balkan Campaign was the invasion of Greece and the Balkan states by the Axis powers during World War II. By June 1st, 1941, all of Albania, Yugoslavia, and Greece were under Axis control. Greece was placed under triple occupation, and Yugoslavia was dissolved and occupied. Germany gained a significant strategic advantage with direct access to the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Vietnam War: Tales from Nam
programme.desc: This documentary offers an intimate look at the Vietnam War, a relentless conflict from 1955 to 1975.

programme.title: Field of Operations: Guadalcanal
programme.desc: Operation Watchtower marked the first major Allied land offensive against Japan on Guadalcanal from August 1942 to February 1943.

programme.title: The Fall of the Third Reich
programme.desc: Arguably the most pivotal event in modern history, World War II saw mankind forced to evolve and accelerate for the sake of their own survival. The dramatic battle between Hitler and the Allies played out across every continent. This exciting series looks back across some of the most defining moments of WWII brought to a whole new life now in colour. The Battle of Britain was won, but not by Hitler. Hitler had lost the battle. He had lost 2,375 German planes and their crews.

programme.title: Nazis on Trial: Nuremberg in Colour
programme.desc: In 1945, Nuremberg becomes the site of justice as the Allies establish a tribunal to prosecute Nazi war crimes and dictatorship atrocities.

programme.title: Vietnam: Ho Chi Minh's Revolution
programme.desc: Uncovering the secrets behind Ho Chi Minh's control of Vietnam and his success in expelling Japanese, French and U.S. forces during his lengthy rule.

programme.title: Miss Paisley's Cat
programme.desc: A lonely woman (Dorothy Stickney) believes she has murdered the man (Fred Graham) who killed her cat.

programme.title: Night of the Execution
programme.desc: A prosecutor (Pat Hingle) considering a run for Congress is told that he may have convicted an innocent man.

programme.title: Together
programme.desc: A man (Joseph Cotten) is trapped in an office with the body of his lover (Christine White) whom he just murdered.

programme.title: Sylvia
programme.desc: A domineering father (John McIntire) tries to run his adult daughter's (Ann Todd) life. With Philip Reed.

programme.title: The Motive
programme.desc: A man tries to prove to his friend that a murderer can escape the police if they can't find a motive.

programme.title: Miss Bracegirdle Does Her Duty
programme.desc: An elderly maid (Mildred Natwick) leaves the parsonage in search of excitement and adventure in Paris.

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: A physically small husband (Martin Balsam) goes in pursuit of a 200-pound wife-stealing salesman (Leif Erickson). With Norma Crane.

programme.title: On the Nose
programme.desc: A woman (Jan Sterling) has problems staying away from the racetrack, and it threatens her marriage. With Karl Swenson.

programme.title: Guest for Breakfast
programme.desc: A couple begins their nightly argument when they are suddenly interrupted by a wanted murderer who keeps them hostage.

programme.title: Return of the Hero
programme.desc: A soldier (Jacques Bergerac) returning home with a crippled comrade (Marcel Dalio) falls in love with a beautiful girl.

programme.title: Right Kind of House
programme.desc: A woman (Jeanette Nolan) questions a man's (Robert Emhardt) motive for wanting to purchase her house.

programme.title: Foghorn
programme.desc: A woman (Barbara Bel Geddes) falls in love with another man (Michael Rennie) at her engagement party.

programme.title: Flight to the East
programme.desc: A war correspondent's (Gary Merrill) stories about the post-war trail of an Arab leader suddenly change.

programme.title: Bull in a China Shop
programme.desc: A quartet of elderly women (Estelle Winwood, Ellen Corby, Ida Moore, Elizabeth Patterson) try to gain the attention of a handsome detective (Dennis Morgan).

programme.title: Isabel
programme.desc: After serving a prison sentence, a man (Bradford Dillman) courts the woman (Barbara Barrie) whose testimony convicted him.

programme.title: Body in the Barn
programme.desc: A man (Peter Lind Hayes) mysteriously disappears after hinting of marital troubles to a curious neighbor (Lillian Gish).

programme.title: Return of Verge Likens
programme.desc: A man (Peter Fonda) is determined to get even with the politician who murdered his father in cold blood.

programme.title: Change of Address
programme.desc: A couple moves into a beach house and uncovers a secret about the former owners. With Arthur Kennedy, Tisha Sterling.

programme.title: Water's Edge
programme.desc: A released convict (John Cassavetes) contacts his former cellmate's wife (Ann Sothern) in order to find some hidden loot.

programme.title: The Life Work of Juan Diaz
programme.desc: A Mexican peasant woman struggles to fulfill the promise she made to her dying husband.

programme.title: See the Monkey Dance
programme.desc: A businessman (Roddy McDowall) meets a stranger (Efrem Zimbalist Jr.) claiming to be his lover's husband.

programme.title: Disappearing Trick
programme.desc: A curious man investigates his tennis partner, only to discover that her supposedly dead husband is very much alive and well.

programme.title: Fatal Figures
programme.desc: A meek bookkeeper (John McGiver) is dissatisfied with his dull and boring existence. With Vivian Nathan.

programme.title: Death Sentence
programme.desc: A worrier (James Best) becomes fearful when an old friend (Steve Brodie) shows an interest in his wife (Katharine Bard).

programme.title: Festive Season
programme.desc: A lawyer (Edmon Ryan) spends Christmas Eve trying to reconcile a feuding brother (Richard Waring) and sister (Carmen Mathews).

programme.title: Listen, Listen ... !
programme.desc: A man tries to convince the authorities that he knows who committed the latest murder in a series of strangulations, but no one will listen to him.

programme.title: Post-Mortem
programme.desc: A woman (Joanna Moore) learns that a winning sweepstakes ticket is in the suit her former husband was buried in. With Steve Forrest and James Gregory.

programme.title: The Crocodile Case
programme.desc: A crocodile valise becomes a vital clue in tracking down a murderer (Denholm Elliott).

programme.title: The Safe Place
programme.desc: A bank teller (Robert H. Harris) invents a seemingly foolproof plan to come up with a lot of quick cash. With Jerry Paris and Philip Pine.

programme.title: The Canary Sedan
programme.desc: While traveling in chauffeured car, a woman (Jessica Tandy) with psychic powers hears a voice telling a tragic love story.

programme.title: Impromptu Murder
programme.desc: A lawyer, soon to become mayor, extends an invitation to a woman who once accused him of embezzlement.

programme.title: Little White Frock
programme.desc: An old, unemployed actor (Herbert Marshall) uses an even older ploy to get a part in a play. With Tom Helmore and Julia Adams.

programme.title: Don't Interrupt
programme.desc: A couple (Biff McGuire, Cloris Leachman) on a train promise their son money if he doesn't interrupt a cowboy's (Chill Wills) story.

programme.title: The Jokester
programme.desc: A morgue attendant becomes hysterical when a practical joker pulls the ultimate prank and pretends to be a corpse.

programme.title: Crooked Road
programme.desc: A couple (Richard Kiley, Pat Breslin) falls prey to a crooked policeman (Walter Matthau) and corrupt town officials.

programme.title: $2,000,000 Defense
programme.desc: Desperate for an acquittal, a man (Leslie Nielsen) makes a lucrative deal with his defense lawyer (Barry Sullivan).

programme.title: Design for Loving
programme.desc: A man (Norman Lloyd) plots to get away from his wife (Marian Seldes) for a while without her knowing.

programme.title: Man With a Problem
programme.desc: A man (Gary Merrill) on the ledge of a New York City hotel threatens suicide after his wife's (Elizabeth Montgomery) death.

programme.title: Safety of the Witness
programme.desc: A gun shop owner (Art Carney) witnesses the murder of a state witness by two gangsters. With Mary Scott.

programme.title: Murder Me Twice
programme.desc: Hypnosis figures in the case of a woman (Phyllis Thaxter) on trial for the murder of her husband. With Tom Helmore.

programme.title: Tea Time
programme.desc: A mistress confronts her rich lover's wife, hoping to convince the woman to give her husband a divorce.

programme.title: And the Desert Shall Blossom
programme.desc: A sheriff (Ben Johnson) worries about two elderly hermits (William Demarest, Roscoe Ates) with an escaped killer on the loose.

programme.title: Mrs. Herman & Mrs. Fenimore
programme.desc: A woman (Doro Merande) plots the murder of her penny-pinching uncle with the help of her actress boarder (Mary Astor).

programme.title: Six People, No Music
programme.desc: A mortician (John McGiver) is torn when a dead man (Howard Smith) revives to make his own funeral plans.

programme.title: Morning After
programme.desc: A mother (Jeanette Nolan) gets involved when she discovers her daughter is seeing a married man (Robert Alda).

programme.title: A Personal Matter
programme.desc: A killer (Joe Maross) escapes to an isolated construction site where he suspects a new engineer (Wayne Morris).

programme.title: Out There, Darkness
programme.desc: A rich woman refuses to lend money to the man who walks her dog when he requests a loan, claiming to need the money to help his girlfriend.

programme.title: Total Loss
programme.desc: A woman (Nancy Gates) enlists her boyfriend's (Ralph Meeker) help to torch her struggling business for the insurance.

programme.title: The Last Dark Step
programme.desc: A man (Robert Horton) tries to get away from one woman (Fay Spain) so he can marry another (Joyce Meadows).

programme.title: Morning of the Bride
programme.desc: A woman (Barbara Bel Geddes) grows suspicious when her fiancé (Don Dubbins) postpones meetings with his mother.

programme.title: The Diamond Necklace
programme.desc: A man is told he has to retire from his job at the jewelry store where he has worked most of his life.

programme.title: Relative Value
programme.desc: A young man (Denholm Elliott) schemes to speed up his inheritance of his rich uncle's (Torin Thatcher) estate.

programme.title: The Right Price
programme.desc: A burglar bargains with his victims when he discovers robbery will not be as profitable as collecting on a life insurance policy.

programme.title: I'll Take Care of You
programme.desc: A used car salesman (Ralph Meeker) is driven to murder by his big-spending wife. With Russell Collins and Ida Moore.

programme.title: The Avon Emeralds
programme.desc: A detective (Roger Moore) trails an elegant woman (Hazel Court) suspected of smuggling an emerald necklace.

programme.title: The Kind Waitress
programme.desc: A waitress (Olive Deering) plots murder after learning she has been included in a wealthy patron's will.

programme.title: Cheap Is Cheap
programme.desc: A miserly man (Dennis Day) searches for the cheapest method of murdering his spendthrift wife.

programme.title: The Waxwork
programme.desc: A reporter gets permission from the owner of a wax museum to spend the night in the museum section devoted to murderers.

programme.title: Lonely Place
programme.desc: Farmers (Pat Buttram, Teresa Wright) find the price of cheap labor is paid in blood. With Bruce Dern.

programme.title: The McGregor Affair
programme.desc: A man and his alcoholic wife do their bit for medical science.

programme.title: Misadventure
programme.desc: The old adage of honor among thieves is disproved when a philandering housewife and her suitor scheme to murder her wealthy husband.

programme.title: Triumph
programme.desc: A missionary couple's arrival in India leads a jealous wife to murder.

programme.title: Memo From Purgatory
programme.desc: A writer (James Caan) joins a gang to gather material for a book. With Walter Koenig.

programme.title: Consider Her Ways
programme.desc: A reaction to an experimental drug causes a doctor (Barbara Barrie) to murder. With Ellen Corby.

programme.title: The Crimson Witness
programme.desc: A playboy resorts to murder after losing his secretary, wife and job.

programme.title: The Impossible Dream
programme.desc: A smitten woman (Carmen Mathews) sees the chance for her dream to come true when she witnesses a murder. With Franchot Tone and Mary Astor.

programme.title: Banquo's Chair
programme.desc: A Scotland Yard inspector (John Williams) arranges a unique ruse to capture a killer. With Hilda Plowright and Kenneth Haigh.

programme.title: A Night With the Boys
programme.desc: Fearing his pregnant wife's (Joyce Meadows) displeasure, a man (John Smith) fakes being mugged to cover poker losses.

programme.title: Your Witness
programme.desc: A woman, dissatisfied in her marriage to a philandering attorney, decides to take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Human Interest Story
programme.desc: A man declaring he is from Mars (Arthur Hill) is interviewed by a newspaper reporter (Steve McQueen).

programme.title: The Dusty Drawer
programme.desc: A man (Dick York) seeks revenge on a bank clerk (Philip Coolidge) who once stole some money from him.

programme.title: A True Account
programme.desc: A woman (Jane Greer) consults an attorney (Robert Webber) about her husband (Kent Smith), whom she believes is a murderer.

programme.title: Touché

programme.title: A Rough Draft
programme.desc: A video game designer is stripped of his identity and recruited by a mysterious force to be the gatekeeper of a multi-dimensional portal.

programme.title: You Never Know
programme.desc: Immersed in a world filled with crime, drugs and betrayal, a group of friends have a tough time dealing with the daily pressures of life. With the support of one another, they come up with a plan to overcome their reality.

programme.title: The Knock Knock Man
programme.desc: A group of teens dare each other to summon a mysterious figure from an old urban legend. What was supposed to be a harmless game turns deadly when one of them breaks an unspoken rule, unleashing the terrifying entity into the real world.

programme.title: Ashens and the Quest for the Gamechild
programme.desc: Ashens goes on an epic and hilarious quest to find a knockoff Gameboy with a dark past. A bona fide cult classic featuring Star Wars and Harry Potter's Warwick Davis.

programme.title: Festival of Trees
programme.desc: Jacquie's future as a designer could rest on winning the annual "Festival of Trees" competition. But coming up with the perfect design means she will have to remember what Christmas is really all about.

programme.title: Lawrence: After Arabia
programme.desc: Was a motorcycle crash an accident or attempt at assassination by the British Secret Service? "Lawrence: After Arabia" tells the story of the last years of the life of the 20th century hero, T.E. Lawrence - Lawrence of Arabia.

programme.title: A Time For Heaven
programme.desc: Inspired by the incredible true story about a tenacious nurse, who helped people that had reached the end of their lives come to terms with God and heaven, & was assigned an unexpected patient. Creator Craig McMahon of A Box of Faith & Before All Others.

programme.title: Amber Road
programme.desc: The Amber Road is a place in the digital universe where anything can be bought, sold, and traded: a place where a person can fulfill their darkest desire or unleash their deepest depravity.

programme.title: Nosferatu - A Symphony of Horror
programme.desc: Summoned to a bloodthirsty vampire's faraway castle, a young land clerk embarks on a harrowing journey into the unknown as his innocent wife falls under the spell of a terrifying shadow in her dreams.

programme.title: Southeast 67
programme.desc: Spanning 20 years, Southeast 67 follows a group of African American students from Washington, D.C. who were promised college scholarships in 1988 at the age of twelve, yet struggled with survival in a neighborhood devastated by the crack epidemic.

programme.title: Hunter
programme.desc: Lt. Ramsey Hunter's life changes when three cases hit him simultaneously: a rogue cop killer, a beautiful runaway serial killer, and his corrupt police captain blackmailing him. But only one of the cases leads him to an ending of universal truth.

programme.title: Forty Winks
programme.desc: A struggling hypnotist in New York city is blackmailed into being the world's first hypnotist hitman after a mysterious woman finds out his degree is fake.

programme.title: Asperger's Are Us
programme.desc: In this coming-of-age documentary, four friends on the Autism spectrum who have bonded through humor and performed as the comedy troupe "Asperger's Are Us" will prepare for one final, ambitious show before going their separate ways.

programme.title: The Last Laugh
programme.desc: Outrageously funny and thought-provoking, THE LAST LAUGH upends comedy's ultimate taboo by asking legends like Mel Brooks if you can joke about the Holocaust, and what else-9/11, AIDS, racism-is off-limits in a society that prizes free speech.

programme.title: Cycles
programme.desc: An apprehensive young man moves into university halls, and the sudden feeling of isolation forces him into an argument with his older brother about identity, love, and the repression of dreams.

programme.title: Betting on the Bride
programme.desc: A womanizer bets that he can get someone to accept his marriage proposal after just 30 days of dating. What he doesn't know is that the woman he targets has serious commitment issues.

programme.title: Run Robot Run!
programme.desc: Kent Weston lives in the not-too-distant future. He is more organized than a day planner and more regimented than a Marine when His goals of dating his pretty co-worker Allison are thrown into disarray with the arrival of Adam, an all-too-human robot.

programme.title: Sister
programme.desc: Sister brings the timely topic of youth and psychotropic drug prescription to the forefront with insight and grace. Reid Scott delivers a nuanced performance as the estranged brother forced into caring for his troubled adolescent sister (Grace Kaufman).

programme.title: Rites of Passage
programme.desc: Feature length drama made collaboratively with a group of young people who dive below the surface of their often tough exteriors to reveal what's going on inside.

programme.title: Ashens and the Polybius Heist
programme.desc: A heist like no other! A motley crew of misfits hunts down an infamous 80's arcade game that can supposedly control people's minds in this chart-topping feel-good British comedy.

programme.title: Get the Girl
programme.desc: When a strange girl appears do you help, or mind your business? A retired hitman and his trainee get pulled into the shit when they decide to save a girl who escapes from trafficking. Sometimes you gotta do bad things to bad people.

programme.title: A Rough Draft
programme.desc: A video game designer is stripped of his identity and recruited by a mysterious force to be the gatekeeper of a multi-dimensional portal.

programme.title: Awaken
programme.desc: Cafe owner Alex's love life is ignited when Rachel walks through his doors. What begins as a shot of love quickly spins into a mystery spanning space and time when Alex discovers the woman of his dreams may only exist in his dreams.

programme.title: Rain Beau's End
programme.desc: When a progressive lesbian couple adopts a boy with a misunderstood genetic condition that was thought to predispose boys to violence and criminality, they must come to grips with their hardline stance on acceptance and toxic masculinity.

programme.title: Slant
programme.desc: Melbourne. 1999. Christmas time! In this darkly comic thriller, a rogue journalist unearths the sordid secrets of an infamous missing socialite for the scoop of a lifetime while unwittingly dredging up his family trauma.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: In this disaster movie, Americans and Soviets must put aside their differences to save civilization from a huge meteor bearing down on the planet. Paul Bradley (Sean Connery) enlists the expertise of fellow scientist Alexei Dubov (Brian Keith), who is joined by his beautiful assistant, Tatiana Donskaya (Natalie Wood). Although Paul and Tatiana are attracted to each other, they wisely focus on taking out the meteor, which may still cause massive destruction even if it is partially damaged.

programme.title: Cosmic Contact
programme.desc: Three college students try to create a device capable of reaching beyond the boundaries of the known universe. Unfortunately for them, they succeed....

programme.title: The Knock Knock Man
programme.desc: A group of teens dare each other to summon a mysterious figure from an old urban legend. What was supposed to be a harmless game turns deadly when one of them breaks an unspoken rule, unleashing the terrifying entity into the real world.

programme.title: All I Want Is You
programme.desc: After holding her man down on a long 4-year bid, Chloe is ready to risk it all when another woman tries to steal her man.

programme.title: Nochebuena
programme.desc: A return home on Christmas Eve transports Junior back to a familiar life of old traditions, lots of coquito, and the one that got away.

programme.title: Christmas with a View
programme.desc: Thunder Mountain Ski Resort hired celebrity chef Shane Roarke as its new head chef for Christmas. Clara isn't very excited, but their paths continue to cross. Will their shared passion for cooking unite them, or will secrets keep them apart?

programme.title: Devil Inside Me
programme.desc: John Drenner Jr. unknowingly unleashes a demon after finding a satanic bible in an abandoned shack. Plagued by violent attacks and nightmares, he spirals into depression. Just as the entity threatens to claim his life, he finds hope in a young woman who helps him seek deliverance. With time running out, exorcist Bill Bean must act fast to drive out the demon before it's too late.

programme.title: Trapped in Terror
programme.desc: Taylor Jones reconnects with her estranged mother, Joyce, unaware of the darkness she brings. When Taylor finds Joyce practicing black magic in her daughter's room, she cuts ties-but it may be too late. Isabelle soon has an invisible friend, then grows terrified to be alone. As the haunting escalates, a paranormal team uncovers a tragic past in the attic, trapping tormented souls forever.

programme.title: Ghost Soldier
programme.desc: It's said that every photograph steals a piece of a soul. What happens when the subject is dead? Lisa becomes obsessed with a photo of her boyfriend's brother, killed in Vietnam. As her fixation deepens, she experiences waking visions of the soldier and believes the picture has a life of its own. When her daughters report supernatural encounters, Lisa realizes the spirit is taking control.

programme.title: Provoking Evil
programme.desc: Sam Baltrusis' séance performance leaves him possessed and desperate for safety. A Shaman battles the spirit, so Sam can regain control of his life.

programme.title: The Well to Hell
programme.desc: Mark Corvo rents out rooms in his childhood home, dismissing strange noises as quirks of an old house. But when a tenant, Ashley, dabbles in dark arts, sinister activity intensifies. A paranormal team confirms a portal has been opened. Mark, an empath, is targeted by dark forces and nearly dies after being pushed from his roof. After recovering, he learns to manage his gift and protect his home.

programme.title: Grave Awakenings
programme.desc: When ghosts confront Zoe Dei, she makes the harrowing discovery that her home harbors a paranormal portal which has awakened her dormant ability as psychic medium, forcing her to learn how to live with her newfound ability to see the dead.

programme.title: Gateway to Hell
programme.desc: In life, people can be tormented by their own crimes. The same may be true in death. In Wilder, Kentucky, a nightclub stands by the Licking River, said to draw murderers and Satanists. Club owner Bobby Mackey dismisses the legends-until his wife and an employee are attacked by unseen forces. Beneath the club, an old slaughterhouse well harbors an ancient evil, waiting to claim its next victims.

programme.title: The Haunted Cabinet
programme.desc: After James Hilton and his girlfriend Sandy bring an antique cabinet into their home, they capture actual video evidence proving it's haunted. Sandy fears the entity from the cabinet is taking James over and turns to paranormal investigators for aid.

programme.title: Ghost Inferno
programme.desc: Kim and Craig settle into their dream home in Bagley, Iowa, but eerie encounters shake their peace. Kim senses an intruder, and her daughter befriends a strange man-one no one else can see. When the unseen entity turns violent, a paranormal investigator confirms the presence of a vengeful spirit. Desperate to protect their family, they turn to a demonologist to drive out the ghost.

programme.title: The Apartment
programme.desc: Newlyweds Bill and Myrisa Spencer move into a renovated apartment, eager for a fresh start. But ghostly figures soon roam the halls, and their dream home turns into a nightmare. Unable to break their lease, they endure the hauntings-until a violent attack on Bill forces them to seek help. With local ghost hunters, they uncover the building's dark past and the entities that still linger.

programme.title: Face of Evil
programme.desc: Joy expects a fun girls' trip to a haunted plantation, but after returning home, a sinister spirit torments her children. When she sees its face in a trip photo, she realizes the entity is attached to her-not the plantation. As the spirit grows more aggressive, a determined paranormal investigator helps Joy uncover a terrifying past connection and fight to save her family.

programme.title: Ashes to Evil
programme.desc: Amelia and Calvin Braddy move into a Tennessee apartment, unaware it was once the site of a deadly fire. Amelia senses a presence, believing the spirits of lost children haunt their home. But when the activity turns violent, they realize a darker force is at play-one targeting their family. Desperate for safety, they seek paranormal investigators before it's too late.

programme.title: Norman the Doll
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator, Stephen Lancaster, doesn't believe in haunted objects until he captures proof the doll he recently acquired is haunted. Fearing he is in over his head, he attempts to get rid of it, but the doll has other plans.

programme.title: Ghosts of War
programme.desc: When Dennis Pongratz discovers his late father's WWII memorabilia, including a Nazi armband, eerie phenomena erupt in his home. A vengeful soldier's spirit seeks havoc, while another tries to stop it. As their home becomes a battleground between good and evil, Dennis and his wife Debbie must find a way to end the terror before it consumes them.

programme.title: Nightmare in the Attic
programme.desc: In 1983, the Fox family moves into a historic Arkansas home, but their daughter Mary quickly becomes the target of an unseen evil. An angry ghost and a demon haunt her dreams and waking life, hinting at the home's dark past. As the attacks intensify, the family turns to a psychic, who confirms their worst fear-Mary is in grave danger.

programme.title: House of Nightmares
programme.desc: When Tracey Berrios experiences paranormal activity inside her new home, she suspects spirits tied to the house's history. But after something evil attacks Tracey, she fears for the safety of her family and turns to paranormal investigators for help.

programme.title: Nightmare in Bridgeport
programme.desc: When his mother's house is haunted by a demon, Connecticut paranormal investigator Bob Baker calls in colleagues and a Bishop for help. But when they fail to cleanse the home, it's up to Bob to do the job, using experience from his own 'haunted' past.

programme.title: Demon Child
programme.desc: Some believe ghosts are human spirits seeking peace, while others say they are inhuman entities that feed on fear. Jan's lonely son Cody seems happy with his imaginary friend-until his behavior turns violent. When Cody reveals his friend lives in a red box in a cemetery, Jan seeks help from a Native American shaman. Through ancient rituals, she battles a force far more sinister than a lost soul.

programme.title: Ghost Fury
programme.desc: Alicia and Scott Cain's daughter befriends spirits of two boys who died in a fire, but their presence brings terrifying consequences. When Alicia and her older daughter encounter a blood-soaked apparition, they uncover a brutal murder tied to their home. Paranormal investigators and a priest intervene, but will they be able to free the family from the grip of these vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Where Demons Dwell
programme.desc: The Bible tells of a man possessed by a legion of demons. In Stamford, Connecticut, 12-year-old David has nightmares of a demonic old man flying toward his home. His terror grows daily. His mother is unsure how to respond-until David is physically attacked by an unseen force. Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren discover demons within him. They must act before he is lost to darkness.

programme.title: Haunted Past
programme.desc: As Deborah Utley begins experiencing paranormal events in her home, she turns to her faith for protection. But when her children are targeted by the entity she seeks the aid of paranormal investigators to end the cycle of terror.

programme.title: The Haunting of Summerwind
programme.desc: On the shores of West Bay Lake, Wisconsin, a mansion known as Summerwind stands between the living and the dead. Ginger falls in love with the house despite warnings and moves in with her family. As she restores it, a supernatural force pushes her husband toward madness. With their family unraveling, Ginger and her children fear the house will consume them all.

programme.title: The Forgotten
programme.desc: April and Matt buy a Victorian home in Salt Lake City, eager to restore it. But an unseen force detests change. Renovations stall, voices whisper, and April's son sees movement in his closet. Then, a dark entity appears, determined to drive them out. A medium warns that the house holds tormented children's spirits-and if they don't fight back, they too will become forgotten.

programme.title: Eternal Grief
programme.desc: After moving into a rural Indiana home, Jennifer Patterson hears voices and smells strange scents, suspecting the deceased former owner still lingers. Hoping to coexist, she stays-until the activity turns violent after her boyfriend moves in. Fearing for their safety, the couple seeks help from paranormal experts to uncover the dark truth behind their haunting.

programme.title: The Dark Side
programme.desc: America is full of forgotten cemeteries, some buried beneath new homes. Bobby Wilcott buys a historic manor in Indiana, hoping renovations will strengthen his marriage. But strange occurrences strain their bond-doors won't stay shut, lights flicker, and unease grows. Paranormal experts Ed and Lorraine Warren confirm the worst: a demonic presence is feeding on their fear.

programme.title: Dangerous Game
programme.desc: Carl, Keith, and Cynthia use a spirit board to contact a ghost in their home. At first, it seems harmless, but as violent activity increases, Keith senses danger. Carl, obsessed with the entity, ignores the warnings-until Cynthia is attacked. Realizing they've unleashed something sinister, the brothers call in a paranormal investigator to stop the terrifying presence before it's too late.

programme.title: Sallie's House
programme.desc: Deb and Tony are excited to start their life together in Atchison, Kansas. With their first child on the way, they settle into a charming home, hopeful for the future. After their son is born, his toys move on their own. Deb believes he has a ghostly playmate-until Tony suffers whispers, ghostly footsteps, and bloody wounds. A psychic warns that a darker force is using the spirit to wreak havoc.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: During renovations, Debbie Guy notices strange activity in her historic Pennsylvania home. After a guest dabbles in black magic, the disturbances turn violent. A ritual sacrifice unleashes a dark force that torments the household. A pastor's blessing fails, and paranormal investigators face their toughest case yet as they battle an evil entity that refuses to be controlled.

programme.title: Dark Forest
programme.desc: Time slowly erases reminders of the past. Old roads are abandoned, and their destinations forgotten. When Clara's family moves to rural Hinsdale, NY, they expect peace but find eerie disturbances. Ritualistic chanting echoes from the woods, and neighbors whisper of roaming ghosts. A psychic warns that spirits are drawn to their home-and to a gruesome secret hidden in the crawlspace.

programme.title: A Haunting in Connecticut
programme.desc: With the help of a psychic and an exorcist, the Parker family battles evil spirits that have invaded their home... and the lives of their children.

programme.title: A Haunting in Georgia
programme.desc: The parents of four-year-old Heidi Wyrick are terrified to learn that their daughter's 'imaginary playmate' is the ghost of a man who once lived- and died- in their suburban Atlanta neighborhood.

programme.title: Halloween Special
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar.

programme.title: The Barn
programme.desc: Something Strange is haunting the remains of a colliery in Cheshire and Ghost Dimension head in to uncover the truth behind the activity!

programme.title: Hotel of Horror
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension head to Halewood and investigate the Wellington Hotel. Believed to be a hive of paranormal activity. Will they uncover what is haunting this public house?

programme.title: Haunted Theme Park - Part 1
programme.desc: What could be haunting an abandoned theme park in Lancashire? Ghost Dimension seek out paranormal activity in Camelot and they are in for a ride!

programme.title: Jack the Ripper
programme.desc: Bex and Sean head to Sefton and investigate a police station connected to the murderous Jack The Ripper. Was James Maybrick really the Ripper? Did his wife poison him? Is he haunting this old police station? These are the questions Ghost Dimension investigate tonight.

programme.title: The Barn
programme.desc: Something Strange is haunting the remains of a colliery in Cheshire and Ghost Dimension head in to uncover the truth behind the activity!

programme.title: WW2 Hospital Haunting
programme.desc: Built in the early 1900's and now used as offices, a former world war 2 hospital has become the new home for something supernatural. Strange voices, eerie footsteps and the sounds of painful screams have all been reported. What will be uncovered tonight?

programme.title: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 2
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension Team are ready for act II at the New Mills Arts Theatre. With so much apparent activity happening at this unassuming theatre the team just couldn't leave when so much more seemed to be promised. And more there was. Has one of the team been singled out as a cry for help from spirit takes hold and has everyone reeling from what they witness?

programme.title: Halloween Special
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar.

programme.title: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 1
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team travel to Derbyshire to investigate the New Mills Arts Theatre. This quirky little building has played host to many famous acts and world renowned plays but has a little known secret that it's allegedly Haunted. With unexplained voices coming from the auditorium and shadows witnessed on the stage, The activity will get so intense it will leave the team in a spin!

programme.title: Haunted Secrets of The Carlton
programme.desc: The team explore The Carlton, a location with a dark and mysterious past. As they investigate reports of strange noises, shadowy figures, and unexplained activity, they delve deeper into the eerie history surrounding the building. Will the spirits haunting The Carlton reveal their secrets, or will the team leave with more questions than answers?

programme.title: Loud Ghosts of the Hall
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension continue their investigation into Champness Hall and come face to face with paranormal activity that is caught on camera and seek out the paranormal entities haunting the location.

programme.title: The Haunting of the Forgotten Chapel
programme.desc: In this episode, the team heads to an abandoned chapel, where strange paranormal events have been reported for decades. From eerie knocks on the doors to footsteps echoing around them, the investigators experience chilling encounters as they try to communicate with the spirits that seem to haunt this site.

programme.title: Poltergeist Haunting The Station Hotel - Part 2
programme.desc: Sean continues his investigation at The Station Hotel and it appears his presence is not welcomed by the spirits. This is one experience of the paranormal that leaves a mark in Sean's memory forever.

programme.title: Poltergeist Haunting The Station Hotel - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to Ashton-Under-Lyne to investigate poltergeist activity claims in a truly local pub. It's believed that it's not just the locals that return to haunt here. Sean comes face to face with the activity in a night he will never forget.

programme.title: Haunting of The Sad Cavalier at The Ring O Bells - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to Middleton, Manchester to investigate claims that a sad cavalier named Edward is haunting this location. Ring O Bells has also been used for druid rituals. Will he be able to summon any spirits tonight?

programme.title: Haunted Escape Room at Moviescape - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to a haunted escape room attraction and although the sets are dressed to scare, something more sinister seems to be lurking here. Will Sean escape unscathed tonight? Items from the Enfield haunting and Amityville haunting reside here, could they be causing havoc?

programme.title: Lock Keepers Haunting at Lock 91
programme.desc: Sean heads to Manchester to investigate a lock keepers cottage that was built in 1804 and it appears that the spirits are still watching over the building and terrifying its customers.

programme.title: Ghosts of The Asylum
programme.desc: Paul and Sean visit one very haunted Asylum in Manchester and come to face with ghostly souls that are haunting the building. The Asylum housed the criminally insane and it would appear, as the building closed, some of them never left!

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: The New York Times labeled Bramber in Southern England, the most haunted village. From Bramber Castle's ruins, delve into the tragic tales: starved noble children, medieval lovers' memories, a ghost-solving murder, a lover's accidental killing, and a Victorian author's unfulfilled death wish haunting his hometown.

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: The New York Times labeled Bramber in Southern England, the most haunted village. From Bramber Castle's ruins, delve into the tragic tales: starved noble children, medieval lovers' memories, a ghost-solving murder, a lover's accidental killing, and a Victorian author's unfulfilled death wish haunting his hometown.

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: The New York Times labeled Bramber in Southern England, the most haunted village. From Bramber Castle's ruins, delve into the tragic tales: starved noble children, medieval lovers' memories, a ghost-solving murder, a lover's accidental killing, and a Victorian author's unfulfilled death wish haunting his hometown.

programme.title: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Legend Trippers
programme.desc: A Halloween dare leads high school friends Nick, Krystian, and Jon to an old cemetery in Green Lake, Wisconsin. Seeking a rumored haunted mausoleum, they become separated in the darkness. As they sense an eerie presence stalking them, their skepticism turns to terror. They must escape before the vengeful spirits of the graveyard awaken-and ensure they never leave.

programme.title: C.O.R.N: A Field of Screams
programme.desc: Stranded in a rural area, 2 teens make friends with locals on Halloween but soon run into a cult called C.O.R.N. (Collective Order of Recreational Necrophilanthropists) that have chosen this area to perform human taxidermy.

programme.title: Barcelona
programme.desc: A tale about Yanks abroad, focusing on two American cousins in Barcelona.

programme.title: Hearts in Atlantis
programme.desc: A man recalls his childhood friendship with a clairvoyant stranger.

programme.title: Mama's Boy
programme.desc: A 29-year-old slacker (Jon Heder) who still lives with his mother (Diane Keaton) takes action when a self-help guru (Jeff Daniels) threatens his perfect world.

programme.title: The Adventures of Pluto Nash
programme.desc: "Pluto Nash" is an action comedy set on the moon in the year 2087, starring Eddie Murphy as the title character, an audacious nightclub owner who finds himself in hot water when he refuses to sell his club to the local mob. The lunar gangsters are helping the mysterious Rex Crater mastermind a plan to take over the moon.

programme.title: The Majestic
programme.desc: Rising Hollywood screenwriter Peter Appleton (Jim Carrey) is blacklisted in the early 1950s Red Scare. Following a drunken car accident, he wakes with amnesia near the small town of Lawson, Calif., where the residents mistake him for Luke Trimble, a local boy declared missing in action during World War II. As Peter helps Luke's father (Martin Landau) and high school sweetheart (Laurie Holden) reopen the town's sole movie theater, questions arise about his true identity and motivations.

programme.title: Men Don't Leave
programme.desc: A woman is thrown into turmoil when her husband dies in an accident.

programme.title: Before Sunrise
programme.desc: Two strangers spend an unforgettable day together in Vienna.

programme.title: Private Benjamin
programme.desc: A widow finds herself in the Women's Army Corps.

programme.title: Black Beauty
programme.desc: A horse narrates his life story in this adaptation of the beloved book.

programme.title: Honeymoon in Vegas
programme.desc: A Las Vegas gambler wins a Hawaii fling with a private eye's bride-to-be.

programme.title: Corrina, Corrina
programme.desc: A family devastated by grief meets a woman who helps heal the loss.

programme.title: 16 Blocks
programme.desc: A world-weary cop must outwit rogue officers planning to kill a witness.

programme.title: Mr. Wonderful
programme.desc: An electrical worker is eager for his ex-wife to get remarried.

programme.title: Disorderlies
programme.desc: Winslow Lowry (Anthony Geary) is a greedy man determined to get his hands on the fortune of his ailing and very wealthy uncle, Albert Dennison (Ralph Bellamy). As a way to hasten Uncle Albert's death, Winslow puts him in the care of three hapless orderlies -- Buffy, Markie and Kool, also known as the Fat Boys (The Fat Boys) -- but their jolly dispositions actually make the elderly man feel better. When Winslow steps up his devious efforts, can the trio stop him?

programme.title: Message in a Bottle
programme.desc: A lonely woman's discovery of a man's letter in a bottle leads to love.

programme.title: Big Girls Don't Cry ... They Get Even
programme.desc: Fed up with her dysfunctional family, Laura (Hillary Wolf) runs away from her stepsiblings, half-siblings, divorced parents and stepparents just before the family takes a trip to Hawaii, supposedly as a celebration for her forgotten birthday. Whether hiding out with Josh (Dan Futterman), the one stepbrother Laura likes, or hitchhiking with quirky strangers, Laura is determined to escape her family -- even as her family seeks to find her and their own equilibrium.

programme.title: Guilty by Suspicion
programme.desc: McCarthyism in the 1950s prevents a Hollywood director from working.

programme.title: Suburban Commando
programme.desc: Problems with his rocket compel space-traveling vigilante Shep Ramsey (Hulk Hogan) to spend some time on Earth. Plunking himself down in the middle of suburbia, he rents a room from Charlie (Christopher Lloyd) and Jenny Wilcox (Shelley Duvall). Shep attempts to acclimate himself -- he skateboards, he accosts a mail carrier -- but he's destined to be a fish out of water. But when his outer space enemies arrive and pick a fight with his new friends, Shep is ready to prove his mettle.

programme.title: Ready To Rumble
programme.desc: Gordie Boggs (David Arquette) and Sean Dawkins (Scott Caan) are best friends who operate a sewage truck and idolize pro wrestler Jimmy King (Oliver Platt). After Diamond Dallas Page (Diamond Dallas Page) dethrones their hero, Gordie and Sean embark on a mission to help King get his title back. When they finally track him down, however, they discover that King is not too keen on recapturing his former glory. Can the boys find a way to motivate the faded champ?

programme.title: El Cantante
programme.desc: This biopic explores the life of innovative salsa musician Hector Lavoe.

programme.title: Ghosts of Mississippi
programme.desc: A district attorney reopens the case against the murderer of Medgar Evers.

programme.title: Strange Brew
programme.desc: In their quest for free beer, bumbling Canadian brothers Bob (Rick Moranis) and Doug McKenzie (Dave Thomas) wind up working at the Elsinore Brewery. The hapless lads uncover a sinister mind-control plot spearheaded by Brewmeister Smith (Max von Sydow) and must stop the scheme, which also involves Uncle Claude (Paul Dooley), a member of the Elsinore family. As Bob and Doug try to prevent Smith from taking over the world, they also manage to drink plenty of their favorite sudsy beverage.

programme.title: Graffiti Bridge
programme.desc: The Kid (Prince) and his rock-club rival (Morris Day) disagree about music in a sequel to the 1984 film "Purple Rain."

programme.title: Surf Ninjas
programme.desc: Brothers Johnny (Ernie Reyes Jr.) and Adam (Nicolas Cowan) are coasting through a fun surfer existence in Los Angeles when they are suddenly accosted by a band of ninjas. A mysterious warrior comes to their aid, later telling the brothers that they are the royal heirs to the throne of Patusan, an embattled island under the rule of a tyrannical leader (Leslie Nielsen). After discovering their untapped ninja skills, Johnny and Adam agree to travel to Patusan to overthrow the current monarchy.

programme.title: Fathers' Day
programme.desc: Jack (Billy Crystal) is a straitlaced lawyer with a loving wife (Julia Louis-Dreyfus). Dale (Robin Williams) is suicidal about his stalled career as an artist. The only thing they have in common is Colette (Nastassja Kinski), with whom they both had an affair years ago. Unbeknownst to the two men, she had a son, Scott (Charlie Hofheimer), who is now missing. After she tells Jack and Dale that one of them could be the father, the pair set out to find Scott and prove who the real father is.

programme.title: I Am Sam
programme.desc: A man with an intellectual disability fights for custody of his daughter.

programme.title: Cannonball Run II
programme.desc: The usual suspects return for a new breakneck, ocean-to-ocean free for all!

programme.title: Arthur (1981)
programme.desc: A drunken playboy decides to give up his inheritance for true love.
