programme.title: Paranormal Pioneers
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Gloucester, Massachusetts to investigate Hammond Castle. They are joined by Josh Gates to find out if the original owners and paranormal pioneers, John and Irene Hammond haunt their property. Are the Hammonds able to talk to the living, as they once were able to do with the dead? What does a disembodied voice say that leads TAPS to believe the Hammonds might still be here?

programme.title: Higher Dead-ucation
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Bowling Green, Kentucky to investigate Western Kentucky University. This University was established in 1906 and has 20,000 students attending. Tamela Smith is the client, and has called TAPS in to figure out if some of the stories that have been passed down over the decades are folklore or truth. There are three main stories that surround the school.

programme.title: Due Date with Death
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Rochester, New York to investigate the Rochester Public Library's 15 years of claims. There's reason to believe that two deaths associated with the building could be behind the activity. The library wants to go public with the phenomena but only if accurate. Can TAPS find the answer they are looking for and finally let the public in on this library's long-held secret?

programme.title: Haunted Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS returns to Hartford, Connecticut to investigate the Mark Twain House. With their previous investigation marred by malfunctioning equipment, TAPS is being called back to look into new and frightening claims that could finally uncover who is residing there. Will Samuel Clemens' favorite holiday initiate an appearance from the famous author? Or will his three children try to reach out to TAPS?

programme.title: Hollywood Horror Stories
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hollywood, California to investigate the infamous Black Dahlia murder at the historic Sowden House. Aspiring actress, Elizabeth Short was nicknamed the Black Dahlia after her brutal murder and the leading suspect of that horrific crime was never convicted. Two people have called in TAPS; the first being the main murder suspects own son, Steve Hodel.

programme.title: Ghost Mission
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to San Juan Capistrano, California to investigate the San Juan Capistrano Mission. This mission has been in the community for 236 years dating back to the Spanish Colonial. An earthquake in 1812 buried 40 people in the rubble; including a teen age girl named Magdalena. The legend goes that she was dating a boy her father disapproved of, and had to do penance at the alter. As she walked up to confess, the earthquake began and she was buried alive.

programme.title: Prescription for Fear
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Bartonville, Illinois, to investigate Peoria Asylum. The owners are renovating this building and have noticed a lot of paranormal activity since they started their restorations. Built in 1898 and opened in 1902, it is said that 16,000 people died there, from multiple reasons, including, patients killing patients and suicide. The asylum's records hold two key figures; Dr.

programme.title: Permanent Residents
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cortland, New York to investigate The 1890 House. Industrialist, Chester Wickwire built this home for his family, and even though they have long passed, it's believed by some that the family may still reside here. Michelle, the caretaker, is concerned that the spirits may follow her home. Do the Wickwire's still live in their former home and if so, can TAPS help put Michelle's mind at ease that they mean her no harm?

programme.title: All Ghosts on Deck
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the oldest operating steamboat in the United States. The boat was built in 1914 and has been used for everything from dances to gambling. Its former Captain Winters was legendary for being somewhat shady. It's claimed that he killed a deckhand named Floyd during an argument when he sent him to do work on the paddle wheel and then ordered full steam ahead, which killed Floyd.

programme.title: Ghosts From Hale
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Coventry, Connecticut to investigate the Nathan Hale Homestead. Nathan Hale was an American Patriot who fought in the Revolutionary War and was executed by hanging by the British for being a spy. He was left outside hanging for days to send a message. He was then dumped in an unmarked grave. Now our client, Bev, believes he has come back to his childhood home. His house was built in 1776 and in the 1940's was turned into a museum.

programme.title: Scream Park
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Sylvan Beach Park in Sylvan Beach, New York to investigate a theme park originally built in the 1890's. Sylvan Beach Park used to be referred to as the Coney Island of Central New York, with its famous hotels, lakeside attractions, and amusement rides. Now Sylvan Beach holds a haunted history and TAPS has been asked to investigate, much to the unease of some of the employees who fear the investigation will agitate the spirits further.

programme.title: The Ghost Hasn't Left the Building
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate the Shreveport Auditorium, a place that is famous for introducing Elvis to the world. Shreveport Auditorium opened in 1929 and is considered a national landmark. The auditorium's stage has been graced by such stars as Hank Williams and Johnny Cash and is known as the first place Elvis preformed professionally. A statue of Elvis was erected after he passed and that's when the phenomena is said to have begun.

programme.title: Ghost Friends Forever
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Little Rock, Arkansas to investigate a personal case at the Jones House and their bungalow next door. Robberies, fires, assault, and murder have all taken place in the old bungalow, dating back to 1898, when Ed Cornish had his wife and two children die 16 hours apart. Then in 2005 Bonnie Wallace, the Jones' neighbor, was murdered by an acquaintance in the bungalow and her husband, Paul died shortly after from illness.

programme.title: Vintage Spirits
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Liberty, Missouri to investigate the Belvoir Winery; a property that has four buildings that are being renovated to become a retirement facility and winery. These buildings were at one time an orphanage, an old folks home, a hospital, and a nursing home and have seen over 10,000 deaths through the years.

programme.title: Hoover Damned
programme.desc: In 1931, Boulder City was built to accommodate the thousands of Hoover Dam workers and their families who inundated the area. Around the same time, the Boulder City Hospital was constructed mainly to care for the injured and dying Hoover Dam workers. Because of dangerous working conditions and hardships, over 100 men died building the Dam, with many of them ending up at the Boulder City Hospital.

programme.title: Something in the Water
programme.desc: The Elms Resort & Spa in Excelsior Springs, Missouri was built in the 1880's to accommodate the thousands of visitors flocking to the area, which had rapidly gained a reputation of having mineral springs with magical healing powers. The first Elms Resort was opened in 1888 and burned down in 1898. They opened a new hotel in 1912 (which has recently been renovated).

programme.title: Undying Love
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Monticello, Arkansas to investigate The Allen Mansion, built in 1906 by a wealthy businessman named Joe Allen. He lived there with his wife and three daughters. One of Joe Allen's daughters, Ladell is believed to have committed suicide in the mansion at the age of 54 years because of her divorce and later losing her son to pneumonia.

programme.title: The Coroner's Case
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate two buildings that may share the same paranormal activity. The client, Grayson owns the 1800's era Rendall Building, which is across the street from the second building with activity, the Caddo Parish Courthouse. They are thought to be connected because it's believed that the The Rendall building's basement once acted as a cold storage facility for those who were hanged at the Courthouse.

programme.title: Shock Island
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Scott Township, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennsylvania Asylum and Testing Lab. This building was originally used as a poor house in the late 1800's and became a mental institution in 1915, followed by an animal testing facility. TAPS will have their hands full as they take on claims of threatening shadows and people being physically accosted.

programme.title: Hyde and Seek
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hyde Hall in Cooperstown, NY to investigate a cursed family home. George Clark started building Hyde Hall in 1817 with the intension of it being a showplace for Clarke's agricultural empire and to remind him of his childhood in England. George died in 1835 on the southern porch before completion and his son, George Jr., took over the property. This was followed by a contentious relationship between George Jr. and his mother.

programme.title: Orphans of Gettysburg
programme.desc: In 1863, the Battle of Gettysburg spanned 3 days and was the bloodiest conflict of the Civil War. 97,000 Union Soldiers and 75,000 Confederate Soldiers fought resulting in 51,000 casualties and one civilian fatality in a town that normally only has a population of 2,400. On the 150th Anniversary of the Battle, TAPS is called to Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, by one of Jason's good friends, Mark Nesbitt.

programme.title: Phantom Fleet
programme.desc: The Buffalo Naval and Military Park has called upon TAPS to investigate three vessels that all saw gunfire and bloodshed during their time of service. The ships that will be investigated are a cruiser named USS Little Rock (the largest), a destroyer named USS The Sullivans, and a submarine named USS Croaker, (the smallest). USS Little Rock has reported deaths on it.

programme.title: Don't Forget About Us
programme.desc: Octagon Hall was built by Andrew Jackson Caldwell in 1847. Andrew and his wife, Elizabeth helped Confederate Soldiers during the Civil War by setting up a hospital room, where many of the soldiers died. They also built tunnels and passageways where the Confederate Soldiers could hide from the Union Soldiers. Andrew's wife and son died of Typhoid Fever during the war and his daughter, Mary Elizabeth, died when her dress caught on fire in the kitchen and she burned to death.

programme.title: Family Plot
programme.desc: TAPS has been called to Lucas, Ohio by playwright Mark Jordan to investigate the property on which one of the most gruesome events took place in 1896, The Ceely Rose Murders. Ceely killed her father, brother and lastly, her mother with rat poison because she believed they were keeping her from the love of her life, Guy Berry. Ceely was 23 years at the time, but had a mental capacity of an 8 year old. Mark wrote a play about these murders, which he performs in a barn on the property.

programme.title: Dead Presidents
programme.desc: Belle Grove Plantation sits in King George, Virginia. It is now a bed and breakfast, but the plantation played an important role in American History. James Madison, the 4th president, was born here, and John Wilkes Booth crossed through the property after he assassinated President Lincoln. The armed contingent searching for Booth stayed at Belle Grove Plantation the night before they caught and killed him.

programme.title: Nine Men's Missery
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home as they investigate the Cumberland Library & Monastery in Cumberland, Rhode Island. A massacre that occurred in the spring of 1676 may have been the first of several events to cause the paranormal activity that exists today.

programme.title: An Officer and An Apparition
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to Brunswick, Georgia to investigate Brunswick Old City Hall. Chief Tobe Green has asked the team to investigate reports of paranormal activity that has gone on for years. Construction began in 1889 and by 1890 the top floor was used as the municipal court. In 1890, Officer Robert L. Massey was shot and killed here while trying to arrest a man who was found guilty for a minor offense. Unexplained activity has been reported ever since.

programme.title: A Textbook Case
programme.desc: TAPS investigates the abandoned Elizabeth V. Edwards Elementary School in Barnegat, New Jersey. Built in 1930, this was first Barnegat High School until a larger one was built in 1957, turning this into an elementary school. In 1975 the school was renamed Elizabeth V. Edwards. Elizabeth was someone who dedicated her entire life to the education of Barnegat's young people. She passed away in 1965. The school was shut down in 2004.

programme.title: Grant is Back
programme.desc: Client, Rebecca Jordan Gleason has called TAPS back to Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum, in Weston, West Virginia, at a time when they are celebrating their 150th anniversary and Ghost Hunters, their 200th episode. TAPS was here in 2008 and found great evidence. Their parting words to Rebecca were for her to not do anything to stir up more paranormal activity...but that advice was not heeded and the activity has increased.

programme.title: Phantoms of the Opera
programme.desc: The prestigious Cincinnati Music Hall has welcomed famous composers and entertainers ranging from Igor Stravinsky and Richard Straus to Ella Fitzgerald and Bruce Springsteen. But it's the "the dead" that have shined a light on this historical building. In 1878 the central hall was first constructed and a year later the north and south halls were added to accommodate the industrial exhibitions that were so popular at the time.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates five different locations along one of the most haunted streets in America! Main Street in St. Charles, Missouri was built on top of a cemetery, which at one time housed hundreds of bodies. As St. Charles grew, it became inconvenient to have a cemetery in the middle of the city and in 1850 it was decided that bodies should be moved to another area. However, not all of them were removed and buildings were constructed over them.

programme.title: A Fright at the Opera
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Carthage, Missouri to investigate the Burlingame & Chaffee Opera House. The building has multiple floors and has had various uses over the decades, starting in 1878 when the second floor was an Opera House, the lower level, a hardware store and the basement a mortuary. In the early 1900's the building was sold to Charles E. Turner who owned a carriage and harness company.

programme.title: There Ghosts the Neighborhood
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Joplin, Missouri to investigate the Holly Hill Estate. The property is comprised of two houses with very different histories. The first house is called Willow Vista, which was built in 1916 and was a private club with ties to the mob. Over the years it was also believed to have been a speakeasy and a brothel. In 1958, a doctor named Donald Patterson bought the Willa Vista and made it into a family home.

programme.title: The Plot Thickens
programme.desc: TAPS stay close to home as they investigate two neighboring buildings: Stadium Theatre and Stadium Building in Woonsocket, Rhode Island. Original owner, Arthur Darman constructed the building and the theatre in 1926. His vision for the theatre was to bring live entertainment to those who couldn't afford to travel to New York. The adjacent building was a community hub, which featured doctors' offices, law firms, dentists, and insurance agencies.

programme.title: Barrels of Boos
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lawrenceburg, Kentucky to investigate The Wild Turkey Distillery. Guest investigator, Kristen Luman, as well as two familiar faces, Dustin and KJ join the team. The descendent of the founding family, Olivia Ripy, calls the team in to investigate. Her family started making whiskey as far back as 1869 and in 1935, her grandparents went into business as the Ripy Brothers.

programme.title: Too Many Apparaitions in the Kitchen
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hyde Park, New York to investigate the Culinary Institute of America. Built in the early 1900's the building was originally a seminary for young men looking to become Jesuit priests. It was shut down in 1969 due to diminishing enrollment. The Culinary Institute took over the building two years later.

programme.title: Fortress of Phantoms
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home on this investigation as they travel to Newport, Rhode Island to investigate Fort Adams, the largest coastal fortress ever constructed on US soil. This is the second fort built on the site. The original structure was built in 1799 and stood through 1812. The fort was rebuilt from 1824-1857 and could hold 468 cannons, where as the first could only hold 20. Many deaths were reported but had nothing to do with battle but rather, murder, suicide, and illness.

programme.title: Darker Learning
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Bennington, Vermont to investigate Southern Vermont College. Edward Everett was a wealthy man who built his mansion on these grounds between 1911-1914. He was married twice and had 5 children. When he died in 1929 his estimated worth was between $40-$50 million. The legend that students have passed down through the years is that Edward's first wife, Amy, committed suicide, and didn't die of poor health, which was reported.

programme.title: Innocent Until Proven Dead
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the Conrad-Caldwell Castle, the masterpiece built by well-known architect, Arthur Loomis. The house took 3 years to complete and was the symbol of success for the original owner, Theophilus Conrad and his wife, who started out as poor immigrants before working their way up to being wealthy industrialists. The couple lived in this home for ten years, before Mr. Conrad died of a heart attack on the basement stairs.

programme.title: 1st Edition Apparition
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Lenox, Massachusetts to investigate The Mount, a location they first visited in 2008. Built in 1902, the Mount was designed and built for Pulitzer Prize winning author, Edith Wharton and her husband, Teddy. When their marriage started to fall apart in 1911, the couple moved out and eventually divorced. This renowned property is where Edith wrote many of her best sellers, and had famous friends visit, including Henry James.

programme.title: Rockets Red Scare
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Boston, Massachusetts to investigate the USS Constitution, the oldest commissioned warship still afloat in the world and one that also never lost a battle. She was built in 1794 and decommissioned in 1855, then placed in permanent commission in 1940. Today she holds a crew of 60, but at a peak time, during the War of 1812, she had 450-500 people aboard: including 60 marines, 350-400 sailors, and 50 officers/ship boys.

programme.title: Houghton Hears A Who?
programme.desc: TAPS travels to North Adams, Massachusetts to investigate Houghton Mansion. It was built in 1897 for North Adams' first Mayor, A.C Houghton. Constructed on the foundation of a previous home, The Houghton Mansion was used for the family and fundraisers. The hauntings are said to have begun in 1914 after a tragic car accident took the lives of A.C Houghton and his daughter. His chauffer was driving and was so overcome with guilt that he took his own life the next day. A week later Mr.

programme.title: Last Will and Evidence
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Glen Spey, New York to investigate Burn Brae Mansion, which was formerly the summer home of Margaret and Charles Elkin. It was constructed in the early 1900's by Margaret, who was one of seven MacKenzie siblings to build a grand estate in Glen Spey with the money given to her by her father. Several of Charles and Margaret's children passed away young, and their coachman, William attempted suicide on the property, and later died.

programme.title: All Aboard the Ghost Train
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out by two clients to investigate the Midwest Railway Preservation Society in Cleveland, Ohio. Built in 1907, this rail yard had over 400 people working there 24/7. Some of the jobs were very dangerous with a number of injuries and deaths taking place over the years, with the brakeman being one of the most dangerous. Sometimes people fell off the tops of the trains and died.

programme.title: Ghost Guards
programme.desc: On the season premiere of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cleveland, Ohio to investigate Grays Armory. It was built in 1893 to house the men's only Grays militia force, a force that was to protect the city of Cleveland from any unrest, as there was no National Guard at that point in time. The gray color was chosen to honor the New York grey's for being victorious during the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: Phantom for the First Course
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Detroit, Michigan to investigate The Whitney. Originally built in 1890 by lumber baron David Whitney, it was used as a private residence for him and his second wife, Sarah, along with his four children. At the time the house was built he was the wealthiest man in Detroit, and spared no expense in his home, including adding the first personal use elevator, and $400,000 worth of furnishings from two trips to Europe. Mr.

programme.title: Children in the Attic
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Toledo, Ohio to investigate the Toledo Yacht Club. Susan Hurst has called the guys in to investigate the club, which first opened in 1865. A fire destroyed it in 1906 and it was rebuilt in 1908. It became well known during the prohibition era, as bootleggers used the docks to smuggle Canadian booze across Lake Erie.

programme.title: Paranormal Pirates
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Steve's hometown of New Bedford, Massachusetts to investigate Fort Taber-Fort Rodman. In the 1770's New Bedford was home to many Colony Pirates and in 1778 the Navy launched a raid on New Bedford on the same spot the fort sits today. Three colonists were killed and New Bedford was burned to the ground.

programme.title: Fighting Spirit
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS stays local as they investigate the Varnum Memorial Armory in East Greenwich, Rhode Island. The armory was built in 1913 by the Varnum Continentals, Inc., a group that works to preserve the Rhode Island military history, and was to be used as a clubhouse and meeting hall for them. There are no reported deaths on the property, but they did hold wakes for soldiers that died during WWI and WWII.

programme.title: Public Poltergeist Number 1
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called in to investigate Old Lake County Jail, in Crown Pint, Indiana. Originally built in 1882, the jail had 10 cells plus the attached sheriff house, which was required by Indiana law to have the Sheriff reside next to or in front of the jail. The prison went through two expansions, the first in 1908 and the second in 1928. At its peak the jail could hold 150 prisoners.

programme.title: Angel of Death
programme.desc: TAPS is called to Valparaiso, Indiana to investigate the Inn at Aberdeen. The house dates back to the 1850's and was purchased by the Ritter family, who were thought to be involved in the Underground Railroad. The house changed ownership over the years until the client, John, purchased it in 1995. Since then reports of paranormal activity have been accumulating.

programme.title: Overdue for Death
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS stays close to home by investigating the Westerly Library, in Westerly, Rhode Island. In 1892 Steven and Harriett Wilcox agreed to fund an in memoriam library in horror of Civil War soldiers. The library was completed in 1894, but unfortunately Mr. Wilcox did not live long enough to see it completed. The library has grown to over 50,000 square feet and has been designated as Rhode Island's first literary landmark.

programme.title: Give Me Liberty or Give Me Corpses
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Haunting of the Garde
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out to the Garde Arts Center in New London, Connecticut. The Center is the former site of the Williams Family Mansion, built in1831 by Thomas Wheeler Williams. Mr. Williams was a congressman and part of the whaling community; in a city know as the "Whaling City." Thomas Wheeler Williams married twice having a total of 9 children. Tragically 5 of Thomas's children died under the age of 22yrs.

programme.title: Dudley Dead Wright
programme.desc: TAPS is called to Cornwall Bridge, Connecticut to investigate the Vogel Residence. Their client, Robin Vogel, is afraid that the Curse Of Dudleytown has spread to her home and has asked TAPS to help. Dudleytown was an abandoned settlement that dates back to the 1740's. Many people believe the settlement was cursed due to the fact that many inhabitants died a violent death or went insane. The Vogel Residence was originally built in 1780 with an addition put on in 1830.

programme.title: Manor of Mystery
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Wilmington, Delaware to investigate Rockwood Museum. They are joined by two of their paranormal friends: actors Rachel Nichols, and Jonathan Sadowski. The original owner of the mansion was Joseph Shipley. He was born into a wealthy family in Wilmington, but made his own money as a merchant banker in Liverpool, England. He built Rockwood Mansion in 1854 to resemble his Liverpool home, Wyncote.

programme.title: Brenda's Story / Altoona Tandrum
programme.desc: We are introduced to Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson, co-founders and lead investigators for The Atlantic Paranormal Society (TAPS). Their Technical Manager, Brian Harnois, tells them of an interesting case. The home they are to investigate is in Altoona, PA which is several hours away, but because of the dramatic nature of the case they decide to make the long drive. They investigate reports of poltergeist activity in a home with a very young girl who seems to see the spirits.

programme.title: I.C. Mishler / Mishler Theatre
programme.desc: The team investigates the historic Mishler Theatre and the Altoona Railroaders Memorial Museum. At the theater, the owner and employees have seen the late owner walking into the wall where his old office used to be, sitting in the seats, and have heard him walking on the catwalk above the stage. At the museum, the spirit of a railroad worker has been seen. Despite some orb activity in the theater, neither site presents any good evidence of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Lighthouse Inn and John Stone Tarvern / The Lighthouse Inn
programme.desc: The team investigates The Lighthouse Inn in New London, Conn., which is reported to be haunted by the ghost of a bride who fell down a flight of stairs on her wedding day in 1930. Drops in temperature are recorded, and Steve feels someone touch him on his back when no one else is nearby. They then travel to Ashland, Mass. to a pub called Stone's Public House, formerly The Railroad House. Here, a little girl died after being hit by a train.

programme.title: Race Rock Lighthouse
programme.desc: At the request of the US Coast Guard, TAPS goes to Long Island Sound to investigate the Race Rock Lighthouse. The lighthouse is now automated, but the Coast Guard officers who come to do maintenance and inspection have reported strange occurrences and are nervous about going to the site. The commanding officers hope to disprove the rumors. The team's cameras pick up strange orb activity and a fog which the investigators do not remember from the time of the video.

The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how "less is more" when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance's creator Totem.

Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can sup

programme.title: Panoz Racing & Chasing Chevys
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don't tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8's; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man's life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: Retrofitting a Psycho Mercury
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool '50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting's trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: Beetles, Bugs, and Buses, Oh My!
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW's, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6 - time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

programme.title: 68 GTX vs Echo Bomber
programme.desc: New Season, New Carz! With SEMA in their rear-view mirror, the ghouls begin the final assembly of a 1969 Plymouth GTX in Seafoam Turquoise. And when help comes up short-handed, Mark enlists what he likes to call his "Echo Bomber."

programme.title: Pilot Takes Flight
programme.desc: It's the 100th Episode! Join Mark and Royal and watch the never-before-aired Pilot featuring some of the first Mopar restorations the original ghouls tackled over ten-years ago.

programme.title: Surveying The Will To Work
programme.desc: It's a hectic day at the Graveyard. Dave jumps from car to car, installing and assembling what he can, Will struggles to keep focused on one project at a time, and Mark makes progress on his A100 build with the hopes of revealing at SEMA 2018!

programme.title: What's Next?
programme.desc: Professional wrestler, actor, and former professional football player known for his time in the WWE and WCW as Goldberg returns to the Graveyard! This time, he brings the ghouls two brand new projects - one of which includes installing a brand-new 392 Crate Hemi in his modern Dodge Truck.

programme.title: Performance with a Touch of Luxury
programme.desc: The Ghouls say goodbye to the 1970 Superbird equipped with a Hellcat Crate Hemi by taking it out for one last drive. Then it's all hands on deck to get the beautiful second-generation Plymouth GTX in Seafoam Turquoise finished in time for the owner to see it for the first time since his father drove it.

programme.title: Dissecting a Daytona
programme.desc: With a Plymouth GTX finished, the ghoulz refocus their efforts on the 1969 Dodge Daytona. With the owner wanting a full restoration, Mark and the Ghouls begin the tedious disassembly. Because of the car's pristine condition, they take extra effort to document and preserve as much as they can.

programme.title: Exorcize a Demon
programme.desc: The unsung heroes of the body shop begin the restoration on one of the most requested renovations ever: a 1971 Dodge Demon. With several panels needing replacement, Mark and George show the intricate process of grafting an entire front-clip from another vehicle to replace the rusted and damaged original.

programme.title: Frankenstein's Work
programme.desc: It's crunch time at Graveyard Carz, Mark and his cousin Dougie fire up the engine for our Turbine Bronze Charger while Dave assembles its firewall in preparation to install the drivetrain.

programme.title: Look to the West for B5 Blue
programme.desc: Dave is ready to wrap up the 1970 Challenger R/T SE but is waiting for parts. Meanwhile, Mark's A100 build continues, and after a long and tedious body-work and paint phase, Will is ready to deliver Dave the 1969 B5 Blue Plymouth GTX.

programme.title: A Challenger Reflected
programme.desc: The Ghoulz have finished the 1970 Challenger R/T SE. As they take it out for the first test drive in over 15 years, Mark and the team reflect on the trials and challenges throughout the restoration process.

programme.title: Mark, Dougie, Allysa, Oh My!
programme.desc: Mark, Dougie, and Allysa team up to kick things into high-gear around the shop. They begin the restoration of a Challenger T/A, Will paints a 1968 GTX in B7 Blue, Allysa learns how dashes are assembled, and they install the drivetrain for the ultra rare, 1 of 2, 1970 Hemi Convertible Coronet R/T.

programme.title: Shaking the Magic 8-Ball
programme.desc: Mark pulls back the curtain on the next four Mopar's in desperate need of resurrection while also showcasing the fans favorite moments from Seasons 8 and 9.

programme.title: Rapping Up the Dash
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls are back, and they are ready to get to work! With a call in from the owner of the super rare 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet Hemi Convertible, Mark has to work fast to reach a looming deadline. At the same time, Will primes the body of our 1969 Daytona, bringing it one step closer to being back on the road.

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: While Mark is on a road test of the just completed 1968 Charger, its owner surprises the shop by arriving in person! While the owner waits, Will completes the paint on a beautiful 1970 Challenger in B5 blue. Finally, with Mark returned the owner receives his restored Charger and cooks a meal for the Ghouls as thanks!

programme.title: Upshift Creek
programme.desc: It's time to hit the casino! Mark has been invited to a massive car show at the Little Creek Casino but before he can go there are a few things that need to be finished first. Mark and Doug disassemble the Phoenix 'Cuda, a car that survived a massive garage fire. At the car show, Allysa and Will interact with fans and find their "pick of the show."

programme.title: It's A Duster Buster
programme.desc: Mark has once again taken Allysa under his wing and is teaching her the finer points of installing a grill and headlights on our 1972 Duster, meanwhile George is in the body shop attaching a tricky quarter panel to a 1969 'Cuda which Mark has to check off the list...military style? Finally, the Duster gets it's drive train and is finally reunited with its engine.

programme.title: Carbituary: Charger
programme.desc: Who better to explain the history and discuss the changes, year to year, of the Dodge Charger, than the Master of Mopar himself, Mark Worman. In this special episode of Graveyard Carz, Mark will show you unique differences, surprising insights, and cool features on multiple years of the same car: the Dodge Charger.

programme.title: 1.5 Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: The focus has shifted, with parts having arrived at the shop it's time to install the Grill, Bumper, Dash and Interior of our 1968 Turbine Bronze Charger. Mark and the Ghouls work their magic on the Charger until a familiar face shows up. With Royal there, Mark shifts the crew back to the 1 of 2 1970 Coronet and finishes the interior. Then, it's time for a test drive!

programme.title: Slammed S-10
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno put an S-10 on bags to give the truck a more improved look with better handling.

programme.title: UTV Chase Truck
programme.desc: The guys outfit a UTV Chase Truck to make sure their Race UTV can make it to the finish line.

programme.title: Patina C-10

programme.title: Modern Scrambler

The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.desc: Two gardeners, each living on their own, are hoping Monty can help them. In Blackpool, Alex dreams of turning her boring backyard into a magical enchanted forest. Also in Bristol, Ross has taken on a very over-grown allotment.

programme.title: Spring
programme.desc: It is spring at Kew and after a long, dark winter, nature is coming back to life. Raymond makes his sublime version of rhubarb and custard and Kate finds out how a 12-year-old slave enabled vanilla to become the world's most popular flavour.

programme.title: Summer
programme.desc: Summer has arrived at Kew and everything in Raymond Blanc and Kate Humble's garden is blooming. Butterflies and bees abound and there are new crops to tend, harvest and cook with. Everyone loves a carrot, particularly the carrot fly, so Raymond must protect his crop to ensure he has a good supply for his summer carrot stew.

programme.title: Autumn
programme.desc: It's autumn at Kew and the vegetable garden is set to produce a bumper harvest. Raymond Blanc and Kate Humble grow some autumnal favourites and cook them up. Kate finds out why the tomato was once considered to be a deadly poison.

programme.title: Winter
programme.desc: The end of the year at Kew is fast approaching, winter is setting in, but some crops positively love the cold and Raymond learns how brassicas cope in this frosty season. Kate visits Kew's Millennium Seed Bank.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: The roses are in full bloom at Longmeadow as Monty tackles some emergency pruning needed on one of his favourite crab apples. Adam Frost travels to the Birmingham Botanical Gardens to discover more about the huge restoration project taking place.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Gardening show packed with good ideas, tips, advice from experts and timely reminders.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: In a special programme, Gardeners' World comes from the RHS Hampton Court Palace Garden Festival. Nick Bailey and Rachel de Thame share highlights of the show gardens and floral marquee to inspire us all to get growing!

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: The team are in Cheshire, at the biggest horticultural event in the north, the RHS Flower Show Tatton Park.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is getting the garden holiday-ready as he tackles some of the jobs to do before going away this summer. He also plants phlox in the Cottage Garden, harvests potatoes and sows seeds for late summer salads.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the garden starts to hit its mid summer peak, Monty prunes his philadelphus and takes cuttings. He also cuts back delphiniums, checks up on his strawberries, and planning ahead for autumn colour, plants nerine bulbs.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost gets on with a few timely tasks at home in his garden, and he also shares his top tips on how to build a green roof on a log store. Meanwhile, Arit Anderson travels to Hertfordshire to visit a nurseryman who is bucking the trend in the world of houseplants, and Joe Swift meets a garden designer in Derbyshire who has converted a derelict space into a test bed for her planting schemes.

programme.title: Bristol Fishponds
programme.desc: The team has been called in to create a garden for a young family to unwind in after work. Zoe and Jonny are dedicated charity workers, who want and need a sanctuary spot to relax away from their emotionally challenging work.

programme.title: Southsea
programme.desc: The team is in sunny Southsea on the south coast, near Portsmouth. Christine has lived in her home for many decades and it used to boast a beautiful garden, planted and lovingly tended by Christine's now late husband.

programme.title: Melton Mowbray
programme.desc: In Melton Mowbray, in the East Midlands, Allison and Anthony would love a beautiful garden for the family to enjoy but until now their priority has been fully focused on their adopted son Leo, meaning their garden has suffered somewhat.

programme.title: Milton Keynes
programme.desc: The team are in Milton Keynes, to create a colourful, social space for Vinay and Raunak. Vinay loves to cook, and hosting barbecues and knocking up his signature mojitos are what makes him happy. He is after a garden where he can do that in style.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As Monty brings in the summer harvest, he gives advice on what to sow to keep the crops coming up to the end of Autumn. Carol Klein visits a woman who is losing her eyesight and gives her recommendations of plants that will be a feast for her senses.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty refreshes a container of overgrown herbs, plants alpines and revisits the shrub and perennial cuttings he took a few weeks ago. Arit Anderson meets a designer who is placing sustainability and the environment at the heart of her gardens.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: This time there's plenty to do to prepare for the season to come, and Monty Don is clearing out spent crops and mulching his asparagus. Joe Swift's been to visit keen gardeners, Wayne and Geraldine Hemingway, to see how they combine sustainability with their designer-style. Carol Klein's exploring the history of the rose at Coughton Court, one of our best rose gardens and Monty plants a new rose of his own. What happens when you have to downsize and leave your much-loved garden?

programme.title: Bury & Hackney
programme.desc: Monty Don visits two sets of ambitious gardeners, each facing challenges on a very different scale. One is a tiny urban courtyard in Hackney and the other is an outdoor area for a community.

programme.title: Essex & Ipswich
programme.desc: Monty meets two sets of gardeners who have unimaginable ambitions for their outdoor spaces. In Essex Denise has never ventured beyond the decking area behind her house. Meanwhile in Ipswich, a father and daughter plan to build a terraced allotment.

programme.title: Stockport & Tufnell Park
programme.desc: Monty comes to the rescue of two couples in need of help transforming their rubble filled back gardens into havens of peace and tranquillity. They are in serious need of help and advice, but can Monty set them on the right track?

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the south-west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gives his top tips for filling gaps in the summer borders, using an array of plants to extend the season and take the garden into the autumn and beyond. Rachel de Thame explores a garden in Devon which has been transformed from a pig farm into a colourful paradise, and Frances Tophill discovers the surprising medicinal and homoeopathic properties of some of Britain's favourite garden plants.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is thinking ahead to the next year and makes a start on adding foxtail lilies to his borders, Rachel de Thame delves into the extraordinary world of bees, and Arit Anderson visits a green oasis where texture and form take centre stage.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty continues his preparations for the next year by getting some daffodils in the ground. He gives his summer-fruiting raspberries a prune, plants a fragrant honeysuckle on the Mound, and offers up some advice on how best to deal with that gardeners' nemesis, bindweed. Plus, Frances Tophill visits pioneering horticulturist Josh Sparkes at his experimental plot in Devon to uncover some sustainable food production secrets, and Nick Bailey reveals his beautiful new border at home.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Arit Anderson and Adam Frost explore the secret behind the enduring charm of East Ruston Old Vicarage. Carol Klein promotes an efficient gardening technique. Rekha Mistry focuses on her new vegetable patch.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Planning ahead for next year, Monty plants camassias and cyclamen for a spring display and sows hardy annuals into his cut flower beds, whilst in the veg garden he plants out strawberries.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gives his tips on how to keep lawns looking their best throughout autumn. Rachel de Thame visits National Collection of asters in Worcester. Adam Frost discovers how the derelict garden of Peckover House in Cambridgeshire was restored.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill explains how to help tackle the decline of butterflies and pollinators in gardens. Carol Klein visits a garden brimming with late summer colour, and Joe Swift meets a couple who have transformed their urban space into a green oasis.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With autumn well and truly under way, Monty shares his tips on how to get more for your money when buying perennials. Planning ahead for a vibrant spring display, he also creates a bulb lasagne in a pot and harvests his pumpkins.

programme.title: Rome
programme.desc: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Florence
programme.desc: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

programme.title: The South
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty shows how to harvest and store potatoes. He also adds late summer colour to the cottage garden and prunes shrub roses. Carol Klein travels to Norfolk to meet Adrian Bloom, a member of a horticultural dynasty.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don tackles the perennial problem of what to grow in the shade beneath a tree, Carol Klein has a look at the crocosmia, and we meet a gardener in Derbyshire who has spent a lifetime growing and showing gladioli.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With autumn well under way, some plants in the garden need to be brought in under cover. Monty Don makes a start by insulating his greenhouse to provide a winter home for all sorts of tender plants and gives his tips and techniques for ensuring their survival until next year. Carol Klein visits the garden of a tropical plant enthusiast to find out how he protects some of his exotic specimens.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty's dividing his Pulmonaria and gives advice on frost-protection, Joe visits a tropical oasis outside Bristol, and Carol looks at Rowans from around the world.

programme.title: Blackpool/Cumbria
programme.desc: Two gardeners, each living on their own, are hoping Monty can help them. In Blackpool, Alex dreams of turning her boring backyard into a magical enchanted forest. Also in Bristol, Ross has taken on a very over-grown allotment.

programme.title: Leyton
programme.desc: In Leyton, Tariq and Sairah want to turn their dumping ground of a backyard into a sumptuous award-winning garden, suitable for entertaining friends and family. Both have competitive jobs in the banking sector and are used to winning at work but when it comes to gardening, they don't know where to begin.

programme.title: Cadeby and Sussex
programme.desc: One couple battle to turn a clay-clogged building site in Sussex into a piece of Portugal. Another tackle a forest of overgrowth in their new back garden in Cadeby. They are determined to create a productive space, something they have always wanted.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

programme.title: Solihull
programme.desc: The team help Richard and Darren create a slice of New York's 'High Line' garden in Solihull. The garden has famously turned a disused train line into a thriving garden, mixing contemporary paving, grass planting and historical leftover train tracks.

programme.title: Appleton
programme.desc: In Warrington, the team answer an SOS from ten-year-old Oliver, their youngest applicant ever. Bike-mad Oliver wants something that no one else has ever asked the designers for: a BMX track in his back garden.

programme.title: Leamington Spa
programme.desc: The team are in Leamington Spa to help Robert and Gemma and their young daughter Darcey. The family want a place where Darcey can come out and play without fear of falling into nettles or injuring herself on the uneven and broken patio.

programme.title: Swindon
programme.desc: In Swindon, busy working couple Nicola and Anthony moved to their new house a year ago. They regard it as their forever dream home, but the garden is letting them down, and they hope to bring some Mediterranean glamour to it.

programme.title: Petersfield
programme.desc: Jeannie and Norman have spent their retirement making the most of their long garden in Petersfield, Hampshire, but they want to turn an area at the back into a secluded, calm, Japanese-inspired 'garden within a garden' just for them.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It's apple harvest time, so Monty collects some of his windfalls to juice, plants a shrub in the Cottage Garden and pots up amaryllis bulbs for Christmas.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill is back at Powderham Castle in Devon, where she puts the finishing touches to a new herb bed. She prepares the vegetable beds for winter, planning for spring colour by planting tulip bulbs.

programme.title: El hombre es como el oso: cuanto más feo, más hermoso
programme.desc: Paco es un chico de 16 años que siempre ha vivido opacado por Aldo, su hermano mayor de 18 años, quien es muy atractivo, atlético y conquistador. Cuando Fernanda llega a su escuela y se interesa en él, Paco no lo puede creer.

programme.title: Es mejor agitarse en la duda, que descansar en el error
programme.desc: Lulú tiene su primera vez con Humberto y, al ser abandonada por él, se da cuenta de que su exnovio no es el amor de su vida.

programme.title: Para hacer una casa o domar a un potro, mejor que lo haga otro
programme.desc: La vida tranquila de una familia de tres mujeres cambia cuando Rita informa a sus hijas que Ramiro, su novio, irá a vivir con ellas. El hombre es un patán que las maltrata; esto pondrá en peligro la unión que hay entre ellas.

programme.title: El que limpio juega, limpio se queda
programme.desc: La madre de un joven soborna al entrenador de su hijo para que no pierda su beca. El joven comienza a imitar las acciones de su madre y soborna a su maestro para obtener ganancias. Una maestra tratará de recuperar los valores dentro de la escuela.

programme.title: A mucho amor, mucho perdón
programme.desc: Julián y Diana son dos adolescentes en busca del amor que casualmente se conocen en el café "El Dicho". Pero Leonardo, el padre de Julián, tuvo otra familia, lo cual desata un gran conflicto.

programme.title: Acciones son amores, no besos y apachurrones
programme.desc: Sin pensar en que podría afectar a toda su familia, Manuel aceptará hacer ciertas cosas ilegales por amor.

programme.title: Quien por malos caminos anda, malos abrojos halla
programme.desc: Una joven y su padre sufren un asalto y al intentar proteger a su hija él le dispara al ladrón. Los hijos del ladrón deciden vengarse del asesino de su padre, pero el hermano menor no está de acuerdo a lo que se dedica su familia.

programme.title: En casa del pobre, el que no trabaja no come
programme.desc: Una joven descubre lo mucho que su mamá sufre y hace para mantener un hogar cuando sufre un infarto y ella debe encargarse de los quehaceres de la casa.

programme.title: Pelillos a la mar y lo pasado olvidar
programme.desc: Una joven sufre porque su papá no tiene tiempo para estar con ella y cancela sus vacaciones juntos. Entonces decide escaparse con su amiga a la playa, pero los celos harán que las cosas se compliquen entre ellas.

programme.title: Ir contra la corriente no es de hombre prudente
programme.desc: Joaquín está obsesionado con que Alex dirija la empresa familiar sin tener en cuenta sus verdaderas aspiraciones en la vida.

programme.title: A Dios rogando y con el mazo dando
programme.desc: Ximena y Diego se gustan, pero él es un chavo que solo gusta de mucha diversión y nada de estudio. Es por ello que ella no quiere andar con él y Diego tiene que decidir entre ser responsable o seguir en el libertinaje.

programme.title: No es lo mismo, pero es igual
programme.desc: Un niño sufre por la separación de sus padres y sus continuas discusiones comienzan a tener fuertes repercusiones en su vida. La abuela del niño decide intervenir para darle una mejor vida al pequeño y pretende pelear su patria potestad.

programme.title: Quien envidioso vive, desesperado muere
programme.desc: Fabián siempre ha envidiado a su primo Marco. Esta envidia se hace evidente cuando Eduardo, un cazatalentos futbolístico, elige a Marco. Fabián no puede superar el hecho de no ser el elegido e intenta matar a Marco empujándolo a la barranca.

programme.title: A donde el corazón se inclina, el pie camina
programme.desc: Una joven comienza una nueva etapa en la preparatoria y se dará cuenta de que no comparte los gustos superficiales de sus amigas. Al romper su amistad, las chicas entran en una guerra de memes.

programme.title: Si quieres conocer a Inés, vive con ella un mes

programme.title: Es bueno el encaje, pero no tan ancho
programme.desc: Los abuelos de Tommy descubren, muy a su pesar, que el pequeño y su madre tienen el síndrome de Asperger.

programme.desc: La pobre de María padece una grave enfermedad. Sin embargo, en su corazón no existe lugar para el dolor.

programme.desc: Los padres de Sofía la sobreprotegen y simulan ser intachables, pero ella descubrirá su doble moral después de quedar embarazada.

programme.title: DeLorean

programme.title: Corvette

programme.title: Batmobile
programme.desc: Hollywood gives audiences plenty of hero cars they can drive home, Knight Rider, the DeLorean, even Herbie, but the Batmobile is always out of reach; of all its incarnations, no other machine redefined the movie car more than the 1989 Batmobile.

programme.title: Hummer
programme.desc: As the American military outgrows the Jeep, it needs something strong, tough, more versatile, and the Humvee is the answer; from Desert Storm to Rodeo Drive, it became America's vehicle of choice, courtesy of its big fan, Arnold Schwarzenegger.

programme.title: Dune Buggy
programme.desc: A garage-built experiment turns a cultural icon, the Meyers Manx dune buggy, which makes car building accessible to the masses; its success unleashes a flood of copycats that nearly wiped out the very garage that started it all.

programme.title: Wait, That's Factory?
programme.desc: As people spend more time in cars, drivers crave the comforts of home; factory options like glove-box cocktail bars promise just that, though not all are created equal; join Jeff Dunham for a ride through the wacky world of factory options!

programme.desc: Jim Gaffigan performs in Canada and has some very strong opinions on poutine, Saskatchewan, health care and the pronunciation of the city of Regina.

programme.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Aloha Fluffy
programme.desc: The comic discusses his crazy world of family, friends, and world travels.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
programme.desc: Previously unseen stand-up comedy by Jeff Dunham; sketches that include popular characters; Brad Paisley performs; special appearances by comic Chris Parnell and former UFC champion Chuck Liddell.

programme.title: Jim Gaffigan: Quality Time
programme.desc: The comic uses his signature everyman humor to deal with the unthinkable; filmed at the State Theatre in Minneapolis.

programme.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
programme.desc: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

programme.title: Bill Squire: Bam Bam
programme.desc: Performing in his hometown of Cleveland, comedian Bill Squire looks at his role as a parent as well as the experiences with his parents that lead to this moment.

programme.title: Margaret Cho: psyCHO
programme.desc: The comic tackles off-limits issues including Boko Haram, racism and her own sexuality.

programme.title: Anjelah Johnson: The Homecoming Show
programme.desc: Stand-up comedian Anjelah Johnson returns to San Jose, Calif., for a special performance.

programme.title: Gina Yashere: Laughing To America
programme.desc: Gina Yashere takes the stage to perform her unapologetically hilarious stand-up routine.

programme.title: Andy Sandford: &y S&ford
programme.desc: Andy Sandford dives into the absurd side of life, tackling pharmacists losing their jobs, full-sized houses on the move, and clowns on the edge. Smart, dry, and brutally funny-this is stand-up for people who notice how weird the world really is.

programme.title: Bill Hicks: Reflections
programme.desc: Comedy Dynamics sits down with Bill Hicks' brother, Steve, who tells old stories, squashes old rumors and reveals the brother and son behind the late comedian. Told amidst old and rare footage of Bill.

programme.title: Bill Hicks: One Night Stand
programme.desc: Bill Hicks offers his unique take on smoking cigarettes, smoking pot, drinking, sex, advertising and music.

programme.title: Chris Porter: Ugly and Angry
programme.desc: Chris Porter of Last Comic Standing performs his comedy routine in Kansas City.

programme.title: Dennis Miller: America 180
programme.desc: Dennis Miller shares his opinion on today's America, including the current state of the nation, the failures of Obama's healthcare initiative and the antics of our top leaders.

programme.title: Dennis Miller: Fake News, Real Jokes
programme.desc: Dennis Miller's critical assessment of the current climate, from fake news to selfies.

programme.title: Jay Mohr: Altamont
programme.desc: Comic Jay Mohr tackles subjects ranging from unexpected visitors to bringing up children and working with Chris Farley on "Saturday Night Live."

programme.title: Kevin Nealon: Whelmed but Not Overly
programme.desc: The comic performs in Denver; topics include the fears, insecurities and doubts of parenthood.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
programme.desc: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
programme.desc: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos
programme.desc: A live concert performance that leans heavily on four favorite characters; cranky old man Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, the mischievous purple whatsit and Peanut.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
programme.desc: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
programme.desc: In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.

programme.title: Chris Porter: A Man From Kansas
programme.desc: Chris Porter discusses everything from hipsters ruining food, to being a man, to playing beer pong with celebrities, in his 3rd one-hour special.

programme.title: Josh Blue: Sticky Change
programme.desc: The comic performs.

programme.title: King of the Lost World
programme.desc: In this modern adaptation of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's classic tale, a jetliner crashes into a land inhabited by mysterious creatures, including a giant ape.

programme.title: Doomsday Meteor
programme.desc: A meteor bigger than the moon has less than a week until planetary impact. Scientists land on the asteroid, mounting it with rockets in an attempt to push its orbit away from Earth.

programme.title: Avengers Grimm: Time Wars
programme.desc: Unhappy being ruler of the Underworld, Rumpelstiltskin frees himself and goes into hiding, making plans to take over Earth. As the Avengers Grimm fight to stop him, they quickly discover it's not where Rumpelstiltskin is hiding, but when.

programme.title: Intermedio
programme.desc: Under the border leading into Mexico, within a labyrinth of caves, a deadly presence haunts all who enter.

programme.title: Halloween Night
programme.desc: Halloween Night, 1982, an inmate of a maximum security facility escapes after murdering two guards. Upon returning to the house where he was born, he goes on a killing spree that will make him Southern California's greatest mass murderer.

programme.title: Down the Mississippi
programme.desc: Our Heroes try to cross the Mississippi but are involved in a boating accident. 10K is rescued by Sketchy and Skeezy and they offer to take him in if he'll help them out with their latest scam.

programme.title: 100 Below Zero
programme.desc: When a chain of volcanic eruptions rips through Europe, the enormous ash cloud blocks out the sun, plunging the continent into a new ice age. An American couple must find their kids and get them out of Paris before it freezes over.

programme.title: Age of Ice
programme.desc: Massive earthquakes open the Arabian tectonic plate, resulting in unstable weather and fatal freezing temperatures. Attempting to reach safety, a family must battle the rapidly cooling temperatures that usher in a new Ice Age

programme.title: 2010 Moby Dick
programme.desc: A modern adaptation of the classic novel of the captain of a high tech submarine and his obsessive quest to destroy the enormous prehistoric whale that maimed him.

programme.title: Aquarium of the Dead
programme.desc: Workers at an aquarium off the coast of southern California find themselves surrounded by undead marine life after a mysterious virus sweeps through the building. Only steps from an ocean inlet, the workers must fight to stop the creatures before they escape into the sea and infect the entire planet.

programme.title: Death Valley: The Revenge of Bloody Bill
programme.desc: Rising from the dead as a demon from Hell, Bloody Bill preys on all who enter his ghost town. Now a group of college students must find a way to destroy the monster or be doomed to serve in his army of living dead.

programme.title: Shark Terror
programme.desc: After falling overboard during a cruise, a young woman washes ashore - injured, stranded and stalked by sharks - as her desperate mother races to find her.

programme.title: Megalodon: The Frenzy
programme.desc: The stakes have never been higher when a "frenzy" of five Megalodons, spawn of the original, terrorizes the open ocean.

programme.title: Ape X Mecha Ape: New World Order
programme.desc: After an attempt on Abraham the giant ape's life, a journalist uncovers a global plot to awaken an ancient creature. Humanity's last hope is an uneasy alliance between Abraham and Mecha Ape MkII to stop the threat and save the Earth.

programme.title: Crisis of Faith
programme.desc: Warren's inability to stop the mayhem causes a crisis of faith in the whole group. Surrounded by Zombies in an abandoned church, their faith is restored after encountering a mysterious stranger who turns out to be something much more.

programme.title: War of the Worlds 2: The Next Wave
programme.desc: Two years after a devastating alien invasion, George Herbert (C. Thomas Howell), a scientist working for the U.S. Army, discovers that the extraterrestrials are planning to attack the planet again, this time by constructing a space-time hole between Earth and Mars. But Herbert is distracted when the Martians abduct his son. As the nations of the world come together to conduct a mission to Mars and defend their planet from another invasion, Herbert fights to get his child back.

programme.title: San Andreas Quake
programme.desc: When a discredited L.A. Seismologist warns of an impending 12.7 earthquake, no one takes her seriously. Now on her own, she races desperately to get her family to safety before the earthquake breaks Los Angeles apart from the mainland.

programme.title: Day the Earth Stopped, The
programme.desc: Hundreds of massive intergalactic robots appear in all of the major world capitals with an ultimatum: Prove the value of human civilization or be destroyed.

programme.title: Mega Python vs Gatoroid
programme.desc: When a species of giant python invades Florida, park rangers breed mutant alligators to counter the threat.

programme.title: Rozwell
programme.desc: Mysterious things are starting to happen as our Heroes drive through RoZwell, New Mexico. Bright lights in the sky and the appearance of a slightly 'spacey' woman, Bernadette, lead the team on an adventure in search of zombie aliens.

programme.title: Mega Shark Vs Crocosaurus
programme.desc: The massive prehistoric shark has survived the last battle, and the world is again threatened when a new, more dangerous foe is discovered in the jungles of Africa.

programme.title: Dragon Crusaders
programme.desc: A group of fugitive Knights Templar attacks a pirate ship and they are cursed to turn into hideous monsters. To fight the curse and ultimately save they world, they must defeat the wizard-dragon who is determined to destroy it.

programme.title: San Andreas Quake
programme.desc: When a discredited L.A. Seismologist warns of an impending 12.7 earthquake, no one takes her seriously. Now on her own, she races desperately to get her family to safety before the earthquake breaks Los Angeles apart from the mainland.

programme.title: Killers 2: The Beast
programme.desc: Trapped in a maximum security insane asylum, a girl must escape not only the psychological demons which inhabit her own mind, but also a band of killers determined to silence her forever.

programme.title: 6 Headed Shark Attack
programme.desc: What is supposed to be a marriage boot camp on a remote island turns into the ultimate test for survival when a 6-headed shark starts attacking the beach. Trapped with minimal weapons, they discover that no one is safe in the water or on land.

programme.title: Morgan Killer Doll
programme.desc: When a lifelike doll begins killing people linked to a dead woman's past, the remaining survivors must risk their lives to uncover the doll's true nature-before they become her next victims.

programme.title: Haunting of Whaley House
programme.desc: When a tour guide breaks into America's Most Haunted House, a bit of amateur ghost hunting with friends turns into more horror than they could have ever imagined.

programme.title: Triassic World
programme.desc: Dinosaurs are back, used as the perfect animals to grow human organs for transplants. But in doing so, scientists have made them all but indestructible, leaving humans scrambling to fight back when the creatures escape a research lab.

programme.title: Alien Origin
programme.desc: Recently discovered footage from a lost military expedition exposes the horrifying truth about the genesis of life on earth.

programme.title: Corporate Retreat
programme.desc: Our Heroes find themselves with a group of white-collar survivors and someone tries to kill Murphy. Suddenly faced with a possible killer in their midst, our Heroes play a dangerous game of "Clue"-with zombies!

programme.title: 100 Million BC
programme.desc: During the 1940s, government scientist Dr. Frank Reno (Michael Gross) lost a platoon of American soldiers in a botched time-travel experiment. When a rescue team transports the survivors -- including Reno's brother, Erik (Christopher Atkins) -- from prehistoric times to 2008, they unwittingly allow an uninvited guest to follow them. Now, a desperate group of modern Navy SEALs and their World War II-era counterparts must stop a vicious Tyrannosaurus rex from ravaging the streets of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Martian Land
programme.desc: In the future, mankind lives on Mars in cities protected by force fields. When a massive sandstorm destroys Mars New York, the city of Mars Los Angeles has to find a way to stop the storm before it wipes them out.

programme.title: The Fast and The Fierce
programme.desc: When terrorists plant a bomb on a commercial flight, the passengers aboard the plane must fight to keep the plane in the air and all the passengers alive: the bomb is rigged to detonate whenever the plane dips below 800 feet.

programme.title: 2010: Moby Dick
programme.desc: A modern adaptation of the classic novel of the captain of a high tech submarine and his obsessive quest to destroy the enormous prehistoric whale that maimed him.

programme.title: King Of The Lost World
programme.desc: In this modern adaptation of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's classic tale, a jetliner crashes into a land inhabited by mysterious creatures, including a giant ape.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: Murphy is captured by an overly enthusiastic and slightly unbalanced zombie fan, "The Collector." Murphy must match wits with the Collector if he's to survive, much less escape.
