programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: In this episode, Peter is mystified by the contents of Khufu the cat's stomach after his owner is concerned that he has totally lost his appetite. Peter performs surgery on the cat but when he opens its stomach, he gets the shock of his life!

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: In the Malawi Special, we follow Anthony and vet Riaz Rhemu as they rescue a roadside stray and go undercover to investigate the illegal puppy trade. They also help out at an open-air surgery on World Spay Day and vaccinate an astounding number of dogs against rabies.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Two brothers are worried about their cow, who is foaming at the mouth. Peter also has a daunting visit to the Greens' farm. Dusty the cat has an injury, but won't be easy to help. An animal lover finds a pigeon with a deformed leg.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Kris Walker visits a property and finds Missy, one of the most matted dogs we've ever seen on the show. Inspector Keira Benham is concerned when she finds two dogs living in hazardous conditions. Can Rex and Tyson's owner clean up her act or is it too little too late? And it's d-day for Ted. Find out if the rescue Spaniel has what it takes to become a fully-fledged police sniffer dog.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: As night falls, Matt rushes out to help a young farmer's pregnant sheep whose life is in danger. Peter treats Jean Green's trusty old rescue dog Reuben, who's couch bound with arthritis.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Following the comings and goings at the World's most famous vets - James Herriot's old practice, Skeldale Veterinary Centre in Thirsk, North Yorkshire now run by former Herriot trainee, Peter Wright and partner, Julian Norton. In this episode Julian goes head to head with Hilda the Highland Cow - battling to remove a large lump from between her horns.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: A newborn lamb is brought to the hospital after being found abandoned by the roadside. The lamb arrived in a bag for life, but Matt and David have their work cut out to save his life.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: The RSPCA are called to the aid of elderly crossbreed, Ben. In Lancashire, a couple must improve their living conditions or face losing their beloved Bichon Frise. We catch up with Molly. On Valentine's Day, Cardiologist Chris Linney tries to fix the tiny Terrier's broken heart. And see the incredible transformation of Zeus, a Dogue de Bordeaux is given a second chance.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Peter treats two wild owls brought into his practice. Shona rushes to the aid of a horse that has trodden on a nail. Julian has to learn sign language in order to communicate with a deaf dachshund that requires surgery.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Will 3-year old Ollie and his family find a forever friend in staffy puppy Tiger? Can Frankie the pup help Simon overcome a childhood dog attack trauma? And will Jaran be Liz and Scott's first dog?

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian Norton is called out to examine an alpaca, new vet Helen Blackburn performs an emergency caesarean on a beagle and Peter tries to save the eyesight of Whisper the lamb.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Single Dad Rinesh and his two girls are looking for a puppy. Newlyweds Heidi and Steve are excited to rescue a fur baby and sisters Sally and Megan met a nervous dog with a traumatic history.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Melissa is looking to begin her journey as a first-time dog owner, and carer for the elderly Jillian hopes for a furry companion who will enjoy the social side of her job.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Ashcroft-Schulz family are excited to adopt a rescue dog, but son Arlo is nervous. Hamilton mother of eight Jo wants a furry friend and newlyweds Hannah and Lynda meet a Swiss Shepherd.

programme.title: Forest Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking place in the forests of the world. We see grizzly bear cubs, baby gibbons and owl chicks among the many babies featured who live in the forest.

programme.title: More Spring Babies
programme.desc: Coyote pups enjoy a romp, baby fox cubs spend time attacking mum's tail, and beavers have fun in the water.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: What do comedy icon Denise Scott, Australian Survivor champion Mark Wales and his Survivor wife Sam, and tennis legend Mark Philippoussis have in common? They're all looking for the perfect pooch.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Farmer Rob rushes into the Grace Lane practice with a struggling pregnant ewe belonging to his son, William. Julian and Anne deal with a lump on an alpaca's lip. Shona and Martin remove a tumour from a Springer Spaniel's rib-cage.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter heads to a local farm to try and save a sheep and her unborn lambs. A little pug has a broken leg and Julian meets Lucy the overweight llama.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian rushes to a dramatic emergency at Jackie Barlow's alpaca farm, where a new mum desperately needs his help. But rural North Yorkshire isn't always the ideal place to drive when time is of the essence, and Julian gets stuck behind not one, but two tractors.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: There's a royal appointment at Cannon Hall Farm as Matt helps a goat with a broken leg in front of a high-profile onlooker - Her Royal Highness Princess Anne. Julian treats a tiny tortoise and has to check if Nigel's cows are pregnant.

programme.title: Snow Babies
programme.desc: This day takes place in some of the coldest regions on the planet. Polar bear cubs, penguin chicks, fox kits, and elk calves are among the many animals featured.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: A special episode focusing on births and babies. Julian heads to a local farm where a cow is struggling in labour. And with bringing new life into the world such a vital part of a vet's job, Julian's also hoping to assist in the birth of a career.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter Wright treats a pet sheep with flystrike, resulting in maggots living in its ear. The Huddersfield team perform spinal surgery on a French bulldog. Julian Norton meets pet pig Pumba that has hay netting tangled around its teeth.

programme.title: At Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmas but life never stops at the practice! At John Swales' farm one of his prize-winning Limousins is struggling to give birth. The calf won't budge and the lives of both mum and baby are at risk. Can Peter save them both or is he too late?

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Collette and her son Cailean are fanatical ferret fanciers and have 39 at their home! But their prize-winning, champion ferret favourite, Teddy, has a problem. They've spotted a lump and Collette fears the worst. Can Peter save Teddy?

programme.title: More Autumn Babies
programme.desc: Our day is being spent hanging around with more of autumn's babies. Goofy panda cubs, meerkats, and a show-off baby jaguar are some of the babies featuring this time.

programme.title: African Savanna Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking us on to the vast African Savanna. With its endless grass plains, leafy acacias and tropical climate its one of the richest environments on Earth, supporting millions of animals. Among them we see featured baby elephants, lion cubs, and wildebeest calves.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: In the middle of a storm an an alpaca gave birth to a cria. Peter gets the call to see if he has more than just a chill. Julian introduces us to their rabbit Luna, but she has to learn to share as they take in a new stray Boris. In order to welcome him into the family Boris will need to be castrated.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: When the RSPCA receives a report that a couple who are banned from keeping animals have got new dogs, Inspector Clare Wilson is quick to act. But, when she arrives at the property, it looks like the job is going to be slightly bigger than first anticipated...

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Emily hopes that bringing a dog into their home will offer a calming influence to her Neurodiverse son Jacob. And will Digger the Jack Russell prove worthy of being emotional support for young Harper?

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian returns to Jacki Barlow's alpaca farm to investigate a worrying lump in the mouth of one of the animals. Peter carries out dental surgery on a Yorkshire terrier and Julian examines a pygmy-goat.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Julian heads to the historic Harewood House near Leeds to check on some goats who are moving to a new enclosure. But catching them isn't going to be easy. In fact, it proves quite painful!

programme.title: Summer Babies
programme.desc: This time we see the baby animals in the summer. Among the animals featured are tigers, orangutans, and green sea turtle hatchlings.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A labrador needs surgery after eating the sock her puppies were playing with, and Peter must find another way to feed a foal that is unable to ingest its mother's milk. A cockatoo fights back when the vets attempt to file down its overgrown beak, two emergencies occur at the same farm in the middle of lambing season, and a newborn calf is running a fever, leaving the owners fearful of pneumonia.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian operates on a French Bulldog that has injured one of his 3 legs. Matt Smith rushes to a farm to try and save a ewe and her unborn lamb. Elsewhere, Peter and Shona have some donkey work to do at the Greens' farm to solve a problem.

programme.title: Spring Babies
programme.desc: The changing of seasons means changes for Earth's creatures. Spring is one of the greatest changes from the cool of winter to the blooming of the land. We spend time with the youngsters born at this time of the year. Red deer, reindeer, goats and baby lynx are among those featured.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Radio DJ Bree and her partner Sophia are looking for a bestie for their terrier, Whitney Houston. Barry and his daughter Lily are looking for a calm companion to join their family.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Family of five the Bascals are looking for a new buddy for their dog, while Karina and her son Alex meet a bonded pair of Jack Russell Chihuahua brothers.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Janine and her two girls are looking for a dog to join their girl squad while the Sulinom family have been waiting over 20 years to adopt a puppy.

programme.title: Pet Babies
programme.desc: We spend time hanging about with our favourite pets. Featuring puppies, kittens and baby rabbits among more exotic animals we keep for pets.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian visits house pig Pigley Scott, who has had a horse tread on his trotter. Father and son farmers are worried about Roger, their prize bull, who has a large lump on his neck that may be a tumour.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter Wright treats two kittens that have been dumped in a bag and set on fire. Shona performs an emergency Caesarean to try and save a cow and her calf. Julian hopes to help a dog suffering from a rare spinal condition.

programme.title: Urban Babies
programme.desc: A day in the life of the extremely cute baby animals that we encounter in our everyday lives.

programme.title: More Urban Babies
programme.desc: We are back in the towns and cities to visit babies who brighten our lives, some more unusual than you might imagine... Kangaroo joey, raccoon kits and fruit-bat babies.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Will it be a love affair when Elaine is paired with fellow single girl Hayley the blue Staffy? Plus, a family have the pick of two dogs, Rusty the kelpie and Lightning the Australian terrier cross.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian Norton and Peter Wright work together to try to save a working sheepdog. They are also both needed at a local farm, where a cow is in agony.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian Norton receives an emergency call from alpaca breeder Jackie, whose prize-winning female Cinderella is having a difficult labour. Peter Wright has to castrate Larry the chinchilla who is responsible for a population explosion.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: It's a landmark day at the hospital in Huddersfield, as Shona and the team use a new electro chemotherapy treatment on a pet pygmy goat's cancerous tumour. Peter heads into surgery with an elderly Lhasa apso who's been suffering with a painful eye problem.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Peter Wright receives an emergency call from his favourite farming clients, Steve and Jean Green, whose poorly calf Treacle has collapsed and remains in a weak condition. There is also food for thought for a pair of alpacas, who have been binge eating after breaking into their food store.

programme.title: More Baby Animals From Africa
programme.desc: The wild youngsters of Africa are the focus. A pair of cheeky Lion cubs head out on an adventurous prowl, go bobbing for greens with an adorable Pygmy Hippo, plus cruise along with some playful Camels, named mini ships of the desert.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Favourite stories and unseen footage from the veterinary documentary series. New scenes include Dave the baby emu, Dougie the pugnacious parrot, Bobby the police sniffer dog and highlights of a hectic lambing season.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter treats a lamb that was born with a life-threatening cyst full of spinal fluid on its head, which will require delicate and painstaking surgery to safely remove. Julian is called out in the middle of the night to save a cow that has experienced dangerous complications while giving birth, a pig is resistant to being castrated, and a dog swallows a bottle of e-cigarette liquid.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: When a baby alpaca's life hangs in the balance, Julian performs an emergency blood plasma transfusion on the front lawn of the Thirsk practice. Peter meets a cat with an unusual backstory, but who now has a serious eye problem.

programme.title: Beach Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking place alongside some of the beaches of the world, checking out the non-stop action both on shore and further out to sea.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Matt rushes to a local cattle farm to help Tilly the cow give birth. Mike and Rebecca have an amorous pony, who needs an appointment with Peter and Julian operates on a young girl's poorly guinea pig, but he is shocked by what he finds.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Inspector Anthony Pulfer gets a report of a starving dog in need of his help, but he gets a nasty sense of Déjà vu when he arrives at the address. A year earlier, Anthony had visited the property to investigate a complaint about a Staffie that wasn't being properly cared for...

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian's patients include a horse with infected hooves, while Peter Wright is worried about a pedigree cat that is in labour and also has to deal with an angry monitor lizard. The two vets find time to attend the Great Yorkshire Show.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian heads to the Taylors' farm where there's a double sheep emergency - a new mum and an expectant mum have both prolapsed. Peter meets Katie Perry - a superstar of a collie who requires emergency surgery.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: A young Ewe is struggling to birth, her not so little lamb has his head stuck which puts both their lives in jeopardy. If Peter pulls him out, it could kill mum, but a caesarean will take too long for the baby. They must make a difficult decision.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Australia and New Zealand

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2
programme.desc: In this animated film, Charlie Barkin (Charlie Sheen) is finding life in dog heaven a little dull. Even after his best pal, Itchy (Dom DeLuise), arrives in town, Charlie still longs to go back to Earth. When Charlie's old nemesis, Carface (Ernest Borgnine), steals the horn used by the archangel Gabriel, Charlie and Itchy quickly volunteer to retrieve it. Back on the planet, while scrambling to outwit Carface and get the horn, Charlie meets an alluring pooch named Anabelle (Bebe Neuwirth).

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Washed-up stuntman Luo can barely make ends meet, let alone take care of his beloved stunt horse, Red Hare. Luo reluctantly seeks help from his estranged daughter and her lawyer boyfriend when notified the horse may be auctioned off to pay his debts. Luo and Red Hare become an overnight media sensation when their fight with debt collectors goes viral.

programme.title: The DUFF
programme.desc: Frumpy high-school senior Bianca (Mae Whitman) has a rude awakening when she learns that her classmates secretly know her as the DUFF -- designated ugly fat friend -- to her prettier and more popular pals. Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

programme.title: The Secret of NIMH
programme.desc: Mrs. Brisby (Elizabeth Hartman), a widowed mouse, must move her children out of their home in a field before the local farmer starts plowing. Unable to leave because her son is ill, Mrs. Brisby seeks the help of nearby rats, who have heightened intelligence after being the subjects of scientific experiments. She receives an unexpected gift from the elder rat, Nicodemus (Derek Jacobi). Soon Mrs. Brisby is caught in a conflict among the rats, jeopardizing her mission to save her family.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

programme.title: Domino: Battle of the Bones

Charlie sets out to take his revenge on Carface by means of an elaborate plan that involves an orphan girl, Anne-Marie. Charlie sets out to take his revenge on Carface by means of an elaborate plan that involves an orphan girl, Anne-Marie. But as the plan progresses, Charlie discovers that Anne-Marie is being exploited by Carface. Charlie must decide whether to change his mission from one of revenge to one of rescue.

programme.title: An All Dogs Christmas Carol
programme.desc: In this animated adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic book, Christmas is coming, and pooch pals Itchy (Dom DeLuise), Charlie Barkin (Steve Weber) and Sasha (Sheena Easton) decide to raise enough cash for injured pup Timmy to get a much-needed operation. Unfortunately, mean-spirited canines Carface (Ernest Borgnine) and Killer (Charles Nelson Reilly) rob the kindhearted dogs before they can give Timmy his present, prompting Charlie and the gang to concoct a ghostly plan to retrieve their money.

programme.desc: Mrs. Brisby (Elizabeth Hartman), a widowed mouse, must move her children out of their home in a field before the local farmer starts plowing. Unable to leave because her son is ill, Mrs. Brisby seeks the help of nearby rats, who have heightened intelligence after being the subjects of scientific experiments. She receives an unexpected gift from the elder rat, Nicodemus (Derek Jacobi). Soon Mrs. Brisby is caught in a conflict among the rats, jeopardizing her mission to save her family.

programme.title: The BFG
programme.desc: Ten-year-old Sophie is in for the adventure of a lifetime when she meets the Big Friendly Giant. Naturally scared at first, the young girl soon realizes that the 24-foot behemoth is actually quite gentle and charming. As their friendship grows, Sophie's presence attracts the unwanted attention of Bloodbottler, Fleshlumpeater and other giants. After traveling to London, Sophie and the BFG must convince Queen Victoria to help them get rid of all the bad giants once and for all.

programme.desc: Juliancito y su amigo están hartos del trato de sus papás, por lo que deciden irse a vivir a una isla y hacer creer a sus familias que están muertos para darles una lección.

programme.desc: En un gran hotel hay de todo, una telefonista ninfómana, un recepcionista jugador y un elevadorista inescrupuloso.

programme.desc: Un abogado americano cumple su amenaza de acabar con la familia de un hacendado cuando este le niega sus tierras.

programme.title: Morgana
programme.desc: El suicidio de una mujer demente a finales del siglo XIX tiene consecuencias terribles en la época actual. El miedo y el horror se apoderan especialmente de una jovencita en una pesadilla que parece llevarla directamente a su propia muerte.

programme.title: Tiempo de lobos
programme.desc: Los dos hijos de un campesino vuelven de trabajar como braceros y él les reprocha que no le ayuden en el campo.

programme.title: Mansión del Terror
programme.desc: Las extrañas vidas de dos personas son unidas por el amor, pero un mal recuerdo y algunos traumas transformaron todo en una cruel pesadilla.

programme.title: El Mofles en Acapulco
programme.desc: Dos bellas mujeres intentan seducir a un pobre empleado costero para que sea el receptor de un cargamento de droga.

programme.title: Mujeres de medianoche
programme.desc: Después de que una prostituta es asesinada, el novio de esta se entera de la doble vida que ella llevaba.

programme.title: Yako, Cazador de Malditos
programme.desc: Yako tiene que vengarse del hombre que asesinó a su esposa embarazada.

programme.title: Malverde, la leyenda
programme.desc: En el norte de México, un famoso bandolero se gana a la gente al repartir parte del producto de sus robos entre la población.

programme.title: El Hechizo del Pantano
programme.desc: Un niño juega en el bosque con una chiquilla y cuando su padre se entera descubren que ella murió años atrás.

programme.title: El tesoro del amazonas
programme.desc: Un aventurero y sus amigos compiten contra un ex-nazi y otras personas que buscan un tesoro de diamantes en la selva sudamericana.

programme.title: La historia de un gángster
programme.desc: La historia de un delincuente que sale de prisión antes de tiempo por buena conducta, pero este vuelve a meterse en problemas y retoma la vida criminal.

programme.title: La piel de la muerte
programme.desc: Dos mujeres huérfanas protegen un tesoro escondido al que todo el mundo anda buscando en el desierto.

programme.title: Los desalmados
programme.desc: Dos cazarrecompensas se convierten en fieles y buenos amigos, a pesar de los problemas debido a sus profesiones.

programme.title: Ancient Olympia - Gods, Games, and Temples
programme.desc: Investigating the practices and culture of the original Olympic Games at sites including the palaestra, the stadium and the Temple of Hera; the heat and drama of the contests; the mindset of the competitors; athletic competition as worship.

programme.title: Westward the Course of Empire
programme.desc: Some of the ways people think about the American West; how this vast, fascinating region comes into being; how it is shaped by centuries of myth-making; what about westward expansion fascinates every generation of Americans.

programme.title: The West in the Colonial Era
programme.desc: Understanding the mark left on the American West by its earliest colonists; the Spaniards, who introduce horses; the French, who develop a complex trade system; the English, who have little interest in colonizing the west of the Appalachians.

programme.title: Venturing Beyond the Appalachians
programme.desc: After the Revolutionary War, the land between the Appalachians and the Mississippi becomes part of the new republic; how the territory is organized; the Northwest Ordinance of 1787 creates a new set of rules that clashes with old realities.

programme.title: Discoveries of Lewis and Clark
programme.desc: The journey of the two explorers who map the Louisiana Purchase between 1804 and 1806; how Lewis and Clark fit into the tradition of explorers looking for a water route to the Pacific; the political and geographic history of the Louisiana Purchase.

programme.title: The Interconnected Earth
programme.desc: An overview of the unifying idea of Earth system science; this approach views Earth as an integrated network comprising the lithosphere, hydrosphere, atmosphere and biosphere; sampling the complex interactions between these realms.

programme.title: The Vast Depths of Earth Time
programme.desc: Pondering how the great antiquity of Earth is discovered; the observations that lead to the concept of deep time; in the process, they develop the tools that can read the story in rocks; ending with an analogy that puts human time into perspective.

programme.title: Fossil Clocks
programme.desc: Delving into biostratigraphy, the study of fossil sequences in rock strata; its discovery solves the problem of correlating sedimentary strata from different regions; this leads to the geological timescale, initiating a revolution in Earth science.

programme.title: Paleontologists as Detectives
programme.desc: How paleontologists interpret fossils to reconstruct the traits and environments of extinct life forms; some of the pitfalls of the field; these include cultural biases that can lead to doubtful conclusions, such as that of the Tyrannosaurus rex.

programme.title: Rethinking the Persian Empire
programme.desc: Cyrus, Darius and Xerxes; these Persian kings are sometimes stereotyped as one-dimensional despots in Greek histories; the truth about the Achaemenid Persian Empire; an empire that stretches from Egypt and Asia Minor, all the way to the Indus Valley.

programme.title: Questioning the Sources
programme.desc: Greek historians provide valuable information about the Persian Empire; the Greek perspective is often negatively biased; archaeology uncovers inscriptions, administrative tablets and other documents that let the Persians speak for themselves.

programme.title: The World before Cyrus
programme.desc: The ancient world before the Persian Empire; in the centuries leading up to the Persian Empire, the Assyrians are the major international power; the Assyrian kingdom collapses; it leaves a power vacuum in the region; the stage set for new power.

programme.title: Cyrus and Cambyses - Founders of the Empire
programme.desc: Cyrus, the first great king of the Persian Empire, expands the empire through pragmatic leadership; he uses local customs and traditions and thereby gains legitimacy over Central Asia and Babylon; his son Cambyses expands the empire into Egypt.

programme.title: Darius I - Creator of the Imperial System
programme.desc: Whether Darius, the son-in-law of Cyrus, is a legitimate king; After Cambyses dies, Darius establishes himself as an unwavering leader; Darius creates a royal genealogy and a Persian identity; he then turns to building infrastructure.

programme.title: Persian Capitals and Royal Palaces
programme.desc: The five Persian capitals; Pasargadae, Ecbatana, Babylon, Susa and Persepolis; built in strategic, fortified locations, these cities are major symbols of power for the great kings; exploring the great hall at Persepolis, which holds 10,000 guests.

programme.title: The Great King - Images and Realities
programme.desc: Seeing beyond the outside stereotypes of Persian kings as tyrants; seeing what the kings themselves have to say; in sculpted reliefs and carvings on royal tombs, the words and images of Darius and Xerxes show Persian values of harmonious cooperation.

programme.title: Royal Roads and Provinces
programme.desc: A trip into the western provinces; the empire's diverse local customs; the Persian Empire is famous for its roads and bridges; how its express messenger system allows information to travel quickly; the king keeps tabs on every corner of the empire.

programme.title: Taking On the Other Side of History
programme.desc: The past comes alive when considering the imaginary lives of ordinary people; these include the citizens, soldiers and slaves who live on the other side of history; asking questions that many textbooks never ask.

programme.title: Being Paleolithic
programme.desc: Taking a look at the lives of human ancestors; picturing oneself as a Neanderthal, whose life is dominated by the environment; discovering the significance of the human mind, language and art in the Old Stone Age.

programme.title: Living in Mesopotamia
programme.desc: Stepping into the world's earliest permanent settlement; why the development of agriculture is a revolution; the invention of writing; the creation of laws; an increase in trade; technological innovations such as the wheel.

programme.title: Being Egyptian
programme.desc: What it is like to be an ancient Egyptian; exploring everyday life during the New Kingdom era; the richness of the Nile; the conservatism and stability of the society; relics that survive across millennia, such as hieroglyphics, papyri and art.

programme.title: The Importance of the West
programme.desc: An overview of the past 500 years of European history and culture; the system of government; economic structures; science and technology; the literature, art and music.

programme.title: Geography Is Destiny
programme.desc: How the physical realities of Europe and the Atlantic world shaped its destiny; geography and climate affecting patterns of population, immigration, diplomacy, war, and political and cultural divisions.

programme.title: Culture Is Destiny
programme.desc: The Great Chain of Being, which assumed an ordered, hierarchical universe in which humans were placed in a particular rank by God; Europe emerging from the Middle Ages; how the concept was challenged and strained by various forces.

programme.title: Renaissance Humanism - 1350 - 1650
programme.desc: A revived interest in the literary and historical works of classical Greece and Rome; new ideas about the qualifications of a gentleman, the role of women and the expectations of a prince; a resulting emphasis on literacy and education.

programme.desc: Dr. Haynes takes on Jenny Wilder as his final patient when an accident leaves her partially paralyzed.

programme.title: Sins of the Fathers
programme.desc: A visit from Sarah Carter's arrogant and demanding father creates havoc with their simple family life.

programme.title: The Older Brothers
programme.desc: Isaiah is mistakenly identified as a member of the Younger Brothers gang when he disrupts a robbery that is taking place.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time
programme.desc: After Laura wins a writing contest, she meets a publisher who encourages her to put more drama into her stories.

programme.title: Home Again
programme.desc: Charles decides to bring Albert back to Walnut Grove after police arrest him for theft in Chicago.

programme.title: Home Again
programme.desc: Charles discovers a morphine addiction is causing Albert's anger.

programme.title: A Child With No Name
programme.desc: Laura holds Dr Baker responsible for her newborn son's sudden, mysterious death. The doctor sees a chance to restore his reputation when little Rose falls ill with smallpox.

programme.title: The Last Summer
programme.desc: Sarah gets angry when Jason spends all of his free time with a wealthy, childless neighbor.

programme.title: For the Love of Blanche
programme.desc: Mr. Edwards swears to find a home for a dying man's girl, not knowing she is a baby orangutan.

programme.title: May I Have This Dance?
programme.desc: Mrs Oleson reacts angrily to the news that her 16-year-old son, Willie, is engaged. She tries to prevent the wedding until Willie defies her.

programme.title: Hello and Goodbye
programme.desc: Matthew meets the father who abandoned him; a famous author stays at the Wilder boarding house.

programme.title: Little House: Bless All the Dear Children
programme.desc: Almanzo and Laura Ingalls Wilder's baby girl is kidnapped by a frontier woman whose baby has died.

programme.title: Little House: Look Back to Yesterday
programme.desc: Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) stops in Walnut Grove to see the Wilders with his dying son, Albert (Matthew Labyorteaux).

programme.title: Little House: The Last Farewell
programme.desc: Charles and Caroline Ingalls (Michael Landon, Karen Grassle) return to Walnut Grove and lead opposition to a land-grabber.

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: The Ingalls family leaves the little house in the Big Woods and heads West.

programme.title: A Harvest of Friends
programme.desc: After promising to fix a store's roof and stack sacks of grain, Charles falls out of a tree.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: Laura and Mary are concerned that other students won't accept them on their first day of school; Nellie Oleson snubs them for their homespun dresses.

programme.title: The 100-Mile Walk
programme.desc: After a hailstorm devastates his crops, Charles learns of blasting work available in a faraway quarry.

programme.title: Mr. Edwards' Homecoming
programme.desc: When Charles brings an old friend home to dinner, Caroline decides the man would be a perfect match for Widow Snider.

programme.title: The Love of Johnny Johnson
programme.desc: Laura becomes enamored by a new student, but he expresses more interest in Mary, which breaks her heart.

programme.title: If I Should Wake Before I Die
programme.desc: Charles helps a woman stage her own wake to ensure her distant children's attendance.

programme.title: Town Party, Country Party
programme.desc: Laura befriends a lonely, crippled girl (Kim Richards) sheltered by her father.

programme.title: Ma's Holiday
programme.desc: Caroline reluctantly leaves the children with a babysitter when Charles invites her on a 6-day trip to Mankato.

programme.title: School Mom
programme.desc: Substitute-teacher Caroline deals with a boy (Dirk Blocker) ridiculed for his limited literacy.

programme.title: The Raccoon
programme.desc: After Laura's pet raccoon bites her and the dog, Charles and Caroline discover it is rabid.

programme.title: The Voice of Tinker Jones
programme.desc: A mute coppersmith (Chuck McCann) plans to end a controversy over a proposed church bell.

programme.title: The Award
programme.desc: Burning the midnight oil preparing for a school contest, Mary causes a fire, and Caroline orders her to withdraw.

programme.title: The Lord Is My Shepherd
programme.desc: Feeling rejected, Laura does not pray for the recovery of her sickly newborn brother.

programme.title: The Lord Is My Shepherd
programme.desc: A mountain man (Ernest Borgnine) helps Laura deal with guilt over the baby's death.

programme.title: Christmas at Plum Creek
programme.desc: The Ingalls struggle with limited funds as they decide on Christmas gifts.

programme.title: Family Quarrel
programme.desc: The Olesons separate after arguing about the quality of the Ingalls' eggs.

programme.title: Doctor's Lady
programme.desc: Doc Baker falls in love treating Mrs. Oleson's niece for an injured arm.

programme.title: The Circus Man
programme.desc: A traveling showman (Red Buttons) hawks a supposedly medicinal powder from India.

programme.title: Plague
programme.desc: Doc Baker drafts Charles to help townspeople quarantined during a typhus outbreak.

programme.title: Child of Pain
programme.desc: Caroline volunteers Charles to keep a round-the-clock watch on a drunken, abusive father.

programme.title: Money Crop

programme.title: Survival

programme.title: To See the World

programme.title: Founder's Day

programme.title: The Richest Man in Walnut Grove
programme.desc: When a company that owes money to Charles becomes bankrupt, Charlies ends up deep in debt and puts a lot of financial strain on the family.

programme.title: Four Eyes

programme.title: Ebenezer Sprague
programme.desc: Laura Ingalls is stunned to learn that her fishing friend is Walnut Grove's new banker; she gets upset when he accuses her of befriending him to secure a loan.

programme.title: The Big Inning

But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Everlasting

programme.title: Home Run

programme.title: Best Man

programme.title: 74 Epiphanies

programme.title: Fite Nite
programme.desc: The rookie cops duke it out for a cause at "Fite Nite."

programme.title: Signals Crossed

programme.title: Broad Daylight
programme.desc: During a home invasion, Andy is left alone and confronted with a hiding thief who is armed and very volatile.

programme.title: Bullet Proof
programme.desc: A fatal traffic collision reveals a shocking truth, and Andy's romance with Det. Callaghan gets complicated.

programme.title: Hot & Bothered
programme.desc: A heat wave has wreaked havoc on the city, multiplied by growing fears of a serial rapist on the loose.

programme.title: Honour Roll
programme.desc: Andy and Chris investigate a nightclub beating, but all clues point to a cop.

programme.title: Girlfriend of the Year

programme.title: Big Nickel
programme.desc: A botched prisoner transport has Andy and Swarek in a cat-and-mouse game to catch the fugitive.

programme.title: To Serve or Protect
programme.desc: Andy's ex-cop father has confessed that he may have committed a crime during an alcohol-induced blackout.

programme.title: Judgment Day
programme.desc: It's time for performance assessments for the rookies as they find out the fate of their careers.

programme.title: Takedown
programme.desc: When an arrest compromises a drug bust, Andy steps up to salvage the bust by going undercover with Swarek.

programme.title: Butterflies
programme.desc: Andy's world explodes when a student is killed in a shooting, and a bullet hits Andy, lodging in her vest.

programme.title: Might Have Been
programme.desc: Andy and Gail go undercover as cocktail waitresses to clean up a drug-infested club.

programme.title: Bad Moon Rising
programme.desc: As a full moon hangs over the city, the rookies are unnerved by a series of strange occurrences.

programme.title: Heart & Sparks
programme.desc: As 15 Division recovers from the shooting of Callaghan, a series of arsons culminates in a laundromat fire.

programme.title: Stung
programme.desc: Using a car dealership, 15 Division runs a sting operation to crack down on suspects with outstanding warrants

programme.title: In Plain View
programme.desc: When an informant is murdered, 15 Division sets its sights on finding a weak link in the East Jameson gang.

programme.title: Monster

programme.title: On the Double

programme.title: God's Good Grace
programme.desc: While Swarek is brutally interrogated, the rookies help Andy solve a mystery that may reveal Swarek's location

programme.title: Class Dismissed
programme.desc: As high schools wind to a close for summer, dangerous pranks abound - including the theft of a police car.

programme.title: Girls' Night Out
programme.desc: Hell breaks loose when a carload of girls from a bachelorette party hits another vehicle, killing the driver.

programme.title: Messy Houses
programme.desc: When Andy answers a domestic disturbance call, the social worker turns out to be her estranged mother.

programme.title: Coming Home
programme.desc: A noise complaint leads Andy and Swarek to an illegal warehouse party, and to an injured John Doe.

programme.title: Leap of Faith
programme.desc: A gifted psychic (or a gifted conman) helps find the missing witness in an organized-crime case.

programme.title: Inicia la conquista
programme.desc: Omar le sugiere a Fernando emborracharse para poder ver a Lety más bonita; Simón intenta conquistar a Paula María y ella les confiesa a las del club que no puede estar con él porque no tiene dinero.

programme.title: Sin embargo
programme.desc: El licenciado Sánchez le sugiere a Tomás seguir con el embargo a Conceptos, pero Tomás se niega.

programme.title: Sin liquidez
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Omar que Lety no quiere a Tomás. Tomás le cuenta a Lety todo lo que ha pasado con el licenciado Sánchez. Simón le pide a Paula María formalizar su relación, pero ella lo rechaza.

programme.title: Plan en marcha
programme.desc: Marcia le pide a Lola que le explique por qué las despidió Juanita y le ofrece un préstamo para pagar el celular de Jazmín. Tomás le da una carta a los niños para que se la entreguen a Alicia.

programme.title: Una oportunidad
programme.desc: Omar ignora las insinuaciones de Alicia; Lety se molesta porque Omar invita a Fernando a salir con las modelos; Fernando le dice a Lety que no ama a Marcia y le pide que se den una oportunidad para descubrir lo que sienten.

programme.title: Engaño consumado
programme.desc: Omar se burla de Fernando por besar a Lety; Fernando le asegura que logró convencerla de que él está enamorado de ella, pero que ella no siente nada por él.

programme.title: Mentira sobre ruedas
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Fernando que las del cuartel le dijeron a Alicia que Tomás era su novio; Ariel le ofrece a Alicia presentarle a un amigo para hacerse amantes y ella se ofende.

programme.title: Noche de fiesta
programme.desc: Las del cuartel aconsejan a Simón no insistir con Paula María; Omar evita a Alicia, quien le pide dinero prestado a Celso; Fernando deja plantada a Lety en un centro nocturno, dos hombres se le acercan y se alejan al verla sonreír.

programme.title: Engaño malvado
programme.desc: Lety y Fernando se besan en un antro y casi los descubre Paula María; Tomás se pone muy borracho; Fernando se siente confundido; Simón encuentra a Paula María con otro y le arma un escándalo.

programme.title: Sospechas
programme.desc: Martha le dice a Lety que Marcia sospecha que Fernando tiene una amante; Alicia le hace pensar a Marcia que Fernando le está mintiendo; Simón se hace el indiferente ante Paula María.

programme.title: Rival imaginado
programme.desc: Marcia piensa interrogar a Lety para descubrir quién es la amante de Fernando; Omar se burla de Fernando porque Lety no quiere nada con él y le dice que deberá conocer a su adversario.

programme.title: Defendiendo el honor
programme.desc: Alicia esconde las llaves del automóvil de Omar para ofrecerle el suyo, pero él la rechaza y sale con una modelo; Lety le ordena a Tomás quitar la fotografía de Alicia de la computadora.

programme.title: Cambio de imagen
programme.desc: Fernando despierta cuando Marcia le pide que reaccione; Marcia le dice que quien quiera apartarlo de ella tendrá que esforzarse mucho; Lety está decidida a dejar de ser Lety La Fea por Fernando.

programme.title: Última oportunidad
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Lola y a Martha que no puede hacer nada por Paula María y reprende a Alicia por no ir a la recepción; Simón lleva a todos a ver como llora Paula María.

programme.title: Relación formal
programme.desc: Ricardo felicita a Conceptos por los comerciales y Luigi presenta su nuevo anuncio para Bella Life; Jazmín se preocupa porque Efrén no contesta el teléfono.

programme.title: Horrible look
programme.desc: Tomás finge ser un ejecutivo y le dice a Alicia que es el gerente de Filmo Imagen; Marcia y Alicia encuentran una fotografía de Patricia Manterola en bikini entre las cosas de Fernando.

programme.title: Totalmente enamorada
programme.desc: Adrianita cuestiona a Lola sobre su divorcio; Simón festeja a los niños; Luigi regaña a Jazmín por no hacer bien su trabajo; Efrén entra a Conceptos enyesado y con muletas.

programme.title: Intuición
programme.desc: Fernando intenta demostrarle a Marcia que no tiene ninguna amante; Eduardo le dice a Fernando que intuye que Marcia lo ama.

programme.title: Celebración cumpleañera
programme.desc: Omar le aconseja a Fernando salir con Lety para festejar su cumpleaños; Eduardo le dice a Fernando que Lety lo quiere y lo respeta, de modo que él debe valorarla.

programme.title: Última esperanza
programme.desc: José reconoce a Eduardo y permite el acceso a las del cuartel; Eduardo le pide al mariachi que cante; Marcia regaña a Alicia por coquetearle a Tomás; Lola y Efrén discuten frente a la juez.

programme.title: Apuesta inútil
programme.desc: Irmita le dice a Jazmín que Lola y Efrén deberán repartirse los bienes; Alicia se empieza a portar muy amable con Eduardo cuando se entera de que tiene dinero, incluso, apuesta con Luigi que lo va a conquistar.

programme.title: Cena de cumpleaños
programme.desc: Marcia siente que Fernando pone muchos pretextos para no ir con ella y le pide a Alicia que lo siga; Lety les dice a las del cuartel que saldrá a festejar con Tomás y le confiesa a Eduardo que está enamorada de Tomás.

programme.title: Invitación a cenar
programme.desc: Don Erasmo le reclama a Tomás por la cuenta del celular y se niega a pagarla; Lety se ve obligada a invitar a Marcia al festejo, pero ella se niega.

programme.title: Conviviendo con la familia
programme.desc: Omar y Fernando van juntos a un bar y Alicia se disfraza para espiarlos; Tomás juega billar con Sánchez y Rosales.

programme.title: Cita frustrada
programme.desc: Alicia le dice a Marcia que sospecha que Fernando fue a una casa de citas; Julieta y Don Erasmo le presumen a Fernando todos los logros académicos de Lety.

programme.title: Después de la fiesta
programme.desc: Román y un joven se suben al automóvil de Marcia y Alicia y reciben una rociada de gas pimienta; se arma un escándalo y todos son llevados a la delegación para aclarar la situación.

programme.title: Noche de amor
programme.desc: Fernando lleva a Lety a un hotel y hacen el amor por primera vez. Fernando no ama a Lety, pero sabe que fue una noche muy especial.

programme.title: Remordimientos
programme.desc: Paula María le cuenta a Lety sobre su noche con Simón; Jazmín se enoja con Efrén porque no quiere pedir la mitad de la casa de Lola; Fernando intenta explicarle a Lety que no pasó nada entre él y Marcia en el departamento.

programme.title: Por el bien de la empresa
programme.desc: Jazmín se niega a salir con Efrén, acepta la invitación de Simón y apaga el celular; Lety se atraganta al escuchar a Lola decir que la cuestionó Marcia; Alicia cuelga el teléfono cuando Román la reconoce.

programme.title: Compromisos obligados
programme.desc: Alicia se niega a empeñar sus joyas y su automóvil. Fernando pone a Carolina, Marcia, Luigi y Omar al tanto de las nuevas contrataciones. Luigi menciona la boda entre Fernando y Marcia, de modo que Lety se pone triste.

programme.title: Hermano despechado
programme.desc: Efrén le dice a Jazmín que pedirá la mitad de la casa de Lola; Ariel amenaza a Fernando con pedir la disolución de la empresa si no se casa con Marcia.

programme.title: Continúa el plan de boda
programme.desc: Fernando le declara su amor a Lety y le pide que se queden juntos; Martha le confiesa a Paco que la liposucción no le sirvió de nada, pero él le asegura que la quiere así.

programme.title: Artista de visita
programme.desc: Lety se emociona al leer la tarjeta que Fernando le dejó; Simón lleva a Patricia Manterola a conocer al personal de Conceptos y Alicia le avisa a Marcia de inmediato.

programme.title: Evento en el museo de cera
programme.desc: Alicia le aconseja a Marcia ir tras Patricia Manterola; Omar le dice a Fernando que Lety salió destrozada de la oficina. Fernando acepta que Luigi trabaje para Patricia Manterola. Marcia, Omar y Fernando viajan a Alemania.

programme.title: Escape del museo
programme.desc: Leticia y el Cuartel de las Feas asisten al museo de cera. Marcia y Alicia van para tratar de descubrir a Fernando con su amante y Omar le aconseja a Fernando seducir de nuevo a Lety.

programme.title: Dulce despedida
programme.desc: Alicia le sugiere a Marcia buscar a Fernando; Omar le ofrece su departamento a Fernando para llevar a Lety; Paula María se molesta porque escucha a Simón decirle a Celso que saldrán con unas chicas.

programme.title: La apuesta
programme.desc: Román y sus amigos interceptan a Alicia y le reclaman por sus mentiras; Lety le recuerda a Fernando sobre la llegada de Miguel y la apuesta que hizo con Román.

programme.title: Prioridades
programme.desc: Marcia le dice a Alicia que no quiere viajar con Fernando quien le confiesa a Omar que ya no quiere seguir engañando a Lety porque ella lo ama.

programme.title: Recocimiento merecido
programme.desc: Román le deja un recado por teléfono a Alicia; Fernando impide que Lety se vaya; Luigi ofende a las del cuartel, Cristina se molesta con él y lo obliga a que se las presente.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Episode 1
programme.desc: A tale of wandering and vengeance by Hai Itto, a master of the Suio style of swordsmanship and a former official intermediary with a sword blade, and his son Daigoro, who lost his wife's life and his job at the hands of the Yagyu clan led by Retsudo.

programme.title: One Armed Swordsman - Tange Sazen: The Legendary Blades
programme.desc: The world was in the time of the 8th Tokugawa Shogun, Yoshimune. ------The feudal lord of the Matsukura clan in Oshu was an enthusiastic collector of famous swords.He was eager to acquire two of the most famous swords in the world, Magoroku of Seki, and two swords, Kengun and Kunryu, large and small.Eizaburo Suwa, one of his retainers and the best swordsman in the clan, was ordered to acquire these two swords even if it cost his life.

programme.title: Chivalrous Inn
programme.desc: Patriotic sword fighters are for and against the Ching (Manchu) Dynasty as they head towards the Martial Inn. Three old men with long silver hair (who are very difficult to tell apart!) are key characters, along with a number of young men and very pretty young women, all very capable sword fighters. Buried under the smoldering looks, suspicions and even lines spoken in dialogue poetic couplets, there's even a murder mystery.

programme.title: Method Man aka Fearless Young Boxer
programme.desc: After his father is murdered by a cold blooded killer, Xiao Lung joins an acrobat troupe in order to further his skills in martial arts. One day while performing he sees the killer, who is after other members of the troupe, like Xiao Lung's father they are-break away members of a large and powerful gang. Xiao Lung is no match for the killer, but after all the other members of the troupe are wiped out, it's up to Xiao Lung to get revenge on them all.

programme.title: Wandering Monk
programme.desc: After a number of deathly mishaps, Monk Lu bravely rescues the bewildered young orphan Cheng, and teaches him the essence of martial arts. The two roam the countryside seeking the murderers of Cheng's father...

programme.title: 52 Masters: KENJUTSU-SWORD of the SAMURAI with Bruce Nguyen
programme.desc: Will trains in the ancient samurai art of the sword: Kenjutsu.

programme.title: A Life of Ninja
programme.desc: A Kendo teacher (Chen Kuan-Tai) protects a businessman from ninja assassins.

programme.title: Ninja Kill
programme.desc: Purple ninjas are on the rampage and plan to assassinate an important senator and create a puppet state headed by the vixen Miss Littleton. For Gordon, the only way to stop them is to learn their ninja laws and then take on each fighter one by one. And then he still has to contend with Littleton and her acrobatic ninja ladies before the country is secure.

programme.title: Thunder Blade & Lightning Foot
programme.desc: Flash Legs Tan stars as a member of the Foot Clan, whose leader is killed by a mysterious masked swordsman using the Thunder-Blade. Tan sets out on his quest to find the murderer and he enlists the help of the Eagle Claw Clan. Together they un-mask the culprit and bring peace to the martial world once again.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Episode 5
programme.desc: Hai Itto is always a target. Just as he was receiving a request for assassins from Saeki in the precincts of the Ararenji Temple, the Ura Yagyuans, led by Ishine, attacked him with arrows. Itto, who had been cutting down these Yagyuans sent by Yagyu, who were hiding in the form of Unsui, was hit in the chest by an arrow with a poisoned tip, which Ishine had fired. Daigoro tried his best to save Itto, who was still in a coma.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 15
programme.desc: Okei meets Tako in a village haunted be a demon and Tono-sama and Sengoku are recruited to become security enforcers.

programme.title: Duel at Forest aka Duel at the Forest
programme.desc: Pai Lung (Man Kong-Lung) returns home from a prison sentence for accidentally killing the father of his girlfriend Snow (Sally Chen). Upon arriving, he finds that Snow has gotten married to the town's gambling addict an all-around loser Chu Hu. The casino in town is being run by a Westerner (Robameice Deimikor) and his band of thugs that keep things running smoothly.

programme.title: Diamond Ninja Force
programme.desc: Born a Ninja, die a Ninja! A century old feud between the Black Ninja Clan and the Diamond Ninja Empire is on the brink of erupting once again with the discovery of the ancient tomb of the Ninja warriors. Black Ninja descendant, Cogan is determined to defeat the Diamond Ninjas once and for all, but with Gordon of the Diamond Ninjas doing everything to stop him, he is willing to go to hell and back to enlist the Ghost Ninjas to do his evil bidding.

programme.title: Shaolin Iron Claws
programme.desc: Warlords rebel against the government. One chief leaks a secret document to the police. The two brothers discover the power of the document and numerous assassins and warlords are deployed to try to force them to give up the secret.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 4
programme.desc: While relaxing on their journey, the travelers get caught up in a battle of heirs after a local lord dies.

programme.title: Hell's Wind Staff
programme.desc: Kung fu super villain, Hwang Jang-Lee (known among fans as "Silver Fox,") is the main attraction in this brilliant kung fu flick, which was reportedly adapted from a comic book. Impudent but likeable kung fu students Tiger Wong (Meng Yuen Man) and Stone Dragon (Meng Hoi) have the potential to be great fighters but seem more interested in driving their teachers to distraction.

programme.title: Point the Finger of Death
programme.desc: The story centers on a secret society that plots to overthrow the Qing Dynasty and resume the Ming monarchy. The organization gains the support of numerous righteous martial clans, but the Qing government has its own plans of squashing the rebellion. The scheming prince of Qing poisons the rebels' central figure, Chi Zi Qiang (Jimmy Wang), and uses the antidote to force him to surrender.

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai Episode 6
programme.desc: Iemitsu attempts to solidify the bond between the shogunate and the imperial court by offering his sister to be the consort of the emperor. A series of conspiracies led to the formation of the notorious Ura-yagyu group, led by Jubei.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 7
programme.desc: Tako meets a beautiful girl in jail. When they get out, she is attacked by a group of men. Tako and Lord come to her aid, but now must discover why those men were after her.

programme.title: Island Art of SILAT
programme.desc: A Journey across Indonesia to explore the relatively undiscovered martial art of Pencak Silat and to reveal the secrets of Silat to a waiting audience worldwide. Historically, technique was passed down from generation to generation within the same bloodline and written records and public demonstrations were rare. "Our Silat was only for our family" says Mas Amien of Chakra Lima. "Before 2007 we never shared our technique.

programme.title: 72 Desperate Rebels
programme.desc: A true classic! An all star cast with untold weapons! The Emperor's spy (Wei Tze-Yung), the daughter of the killed governor Shih Han (Wei Hai-Min), a mysterious mercenary (Wan Shan) and a blind swordsman (Lung Fei) team up to defeat chief pirate (Bai Ying), leader of the 72 Desperate Rebels, but eventually it will be his daughter (Yang Hsiu-Chian) who will decide at the end of the movie. This superb martial arts movie has nice imaginative touches and a very good planning direction.

programme.title: Secret Rivals
programme.desc: A classic kung fu movie! Wong Tao plays Shen Yi Wei, the son of a General, who travels to Gold Valley in Korea, to investigate a gold heist that took place 3 years ago. Shen Yi Wei finds out that the only way that he can get closer to the gang that robbed the gold, is by entering a competition sponsored by the gang leader, who is looking for a top kung fu fighter to become his bodyguard.

programme.title: The Bone Crushing Kid
programme.desc: Sung (Chin Lung) is a young man who is ambitious to make his name in a theatrical troupe. The leader of the troupe is unimpressed with Sung. Sung responds by studying kung fu from an old master of the monkey style and soon becomes an expert however his new master is also the sworn enemy of the Cross fists master (James Tien) .Now Sung has a new fight on his hands.

programme.title: 18 Fatal Strikes
programme.desc: The action is incredible in this great kung fu classic. An Abbot Monk is injured and ends up in the home of two young men, and soon are targets of the Ching Army and evil leader Wong Wu Ti. They acquire skills from the Abbot and the battle begins...

programme.title: The Dark Alley
programme.desc: Set against the backdrop of Thai International Boxing, what starts out as a happy love story between Wong, a champion boxer, and his beloved, develops into a violent and explosive saga of blood and guts. 'The Dark Alley' lights up in a furor of incredible kung fu fighting and ruthless revenge that will leave you breathless'

programme.title: Ninja the Protector
programme.desc: Ninja the Protector, a deadly samurai warrior, one of the elite groups of master-fighters descended from the ancient tradition. Forged U.S. banknotes are making their way in huge quantities into Hong Kong and a special unit is set up by Interpol to catch the counterfeiters. Ninja secret agent John Hart has to infiltrate the gang and rescue an undercover cop before he can take on the leader of the Forgery Gang, Fo, whose skills in this ancient art of ninja are equally matched.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Episode 2
programme.desc: Itto receives an assassination request to kill a Shichiri, an elite messenger of the shogunate with license to kill, who is responsible for the brutal rape and murder of a young woman. He soon finds himself caught in the middle of a power struggle within a major clan.

programme.title: 8 Masters
programme.desc: Carter Wong plays Chu Shiao Chieh, rescued from his house as a child and ferried to the Shaolin Temple, before the Eight Masters,who are bent on revenge, and wanting to kill him. Once safely at the temple, he learns martial arts and is taught the virtues of patience and mercy. After he reaches manhood, Chu must pass final tests in the temple in order to leave and repay the debt to his mother.

programme.title: 10 Tigers of Shaolin
programme.desc: The Famed Ten Tigers of Kwangtung, one woman and nine men, defeat a local warlord who's exploiting the villagers.

programme.title: Warriors of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Two brothers rendered blind and dumb by Chang must learn crippled kung fu, and with the help of a vengeful warrior lady set out to take on the gang and their villainous leader. Two sons of the head of gangsters and an expertise Kung Fu master, comes to Canton and kills Yu-Sing. In this incident, Yu's one son, Yu-Yung loses his eye-sight and his brother, Yu-Ho becomes dumb. They have to be trained in special cripple-Kung Fu. The two sons leave Canton to Fuchow to take revenge on the gangsters.

programme.title: Challenge of the Lady Ninja
programme.desc: During the Japanese occupation of Shanghai, a Chinese woman trains in the covert arts. When she arrives in Hong Kong, she learns that her brother fights for the Japanese cause. Soon she pulls together a team of women warriors to stop her brother.

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai Episode 2
programme.desc: The fierce battle between Iemitsu and Tadanaga is getting more heated. Jubei leads a team on an ambush, which turns out to be a trap with dire consequences.

programme.title: Dragon Against Vampire
programme.desc: Terror from beyond the grave. Explicit sadistic sexuality. A fabric of perversion and witchcraft. Three friends rob a grave and evoke the wrath of a powerful practitioner of black magic, the Black Dragon, who is seeking the book of Shaolin Sorcery Martial Arts. Unknown to Tony, the surviving gang member, he has a magical power which, if given the right training, will overcome Black Dragon and his sadistic vampiric tendencies.

programme.title: Dragon's Snake Fist
programme.desc: Two competing kung fu schools, the Dragon Fist and the Jeet-Kune, battle it out for supremacy, with technique after technique being employed to get the upper hand. Will Snake Fist Lee vanquish the deadly Golden Needles of his arch-enemy Ho and bring honor to his clan? A duel to the death is the only inevitability!

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Episode 9
programme.desc: Lord Retsudou ordered teams of assassins to kill Ogami. The lone wolf made new allies and now he must fight his way through this journey full of betrayals and deceits.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub-Assassin on the Road to Hell (Kozure Ohkami)
programme.desc: The tale of Ogami Itto and his son Daigoro has come full circle with the greatest sword actor of all time, Wakayama Tomisaburo now playing Lone Wolf's mortal enemy, the evil Lord Yagyu Retsudo, who masterminded Ogami's fall from grace. Brilliant sword actor Takahashi Hideki takes over as the former shogunate decapitator, and his stunning swordsmanship is second to none! The story of Lone Wolf and Child has been told many times, but never before like this.

programme.title: Grizzly-pendence Day
programme.desc: The troopers respond to shots fired during a landlord-tenant dispute; a suspect flees on foot into the woods.

programme.title: Hostage Standoff
programme.desc: A belligerent man turns a loaded gun on his pregnant girlfriend; a search-and-rescue mission in the forest; road rage could become fatal when a gun is involved.

programme.title: Armed & Squatting
programme.desc: Troopers confront a man living illegally on public land; a toddler has disappeared in the woods; a man evades capture in a remote village.

programme.title: Armed and Bootlegging
programme.desc: A "dry" village manufactures illegal alcohol; a routine traffic stop uncovers a meth cook.

programme.title: Bloody Warrior
programme.desc: The troopers resort to the Taser when faced with a hostile man; a machete assault; suspicious vehicle investigation.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.
