programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: This week, Melvyn explores Taiwan. He scales the altitudes of Taiwan's central mountains to meet an aboriginal woman. With her, Melvyn discovers some unique local produce and learns how to prepare a dish that dates back to the hunting days of the Atayal men.

programme.title: Barbeque
programme.desc: When it comes to cooking, barbecue is the broadest category of them all. It could be a cooking method, astyle of food, a flavor or sauce, a name for a type of gathering, or even the actual machine used to cook foods! But when you mix all of that up together...the end result is a shockwave of salty... smoky... and juicy... flavors trapped inside a mouthwatering piece of meat.

programme.title: Morocco
programme.desc: Discover the world through some of the most delicious and unusual dishes from countries like China, Morocco and Venezuela. In each episode, we will explore colourful local markets, discovering new flavours and regional produce. The ingredients we find will form the basis for some very special dishes that are simple to make at home.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: In tonight's programme, Gordon takes his son Jack fishing in the Scottish Highlands and then gets the rest of the family to help turn an old Robin Reliant into a salmon smoker in his garden.

programme.title: The Future
programme.desc: Climate change, a global pandemic, and a booming world population mark an opportune time to be in the food business, not unlike the first wave of the industrial food revolution that gave people the first globally mass-produced, processed foods.

programme.title: Petits Fours
programme.desc: Julia Child demonstrates how to turn sugar and water into white fondant icing which can be used to ice and decorate petits fours.

programme.title: El Rincón
programme.desc: The "Semana Santa" belongs to Marqués de Griñón and his family. During the Holy Week, simple meals are traditionally served but the Count has invited the cultural and social elite of Madrid for a Gala Dinner to El Rincon.

programme.title: Riegersburg Castle
programme.desc: Riegersburg Castle is one of the largest castles in Austria and in the ownership of Prince Emanuel von und zu Liechtenstein.

programme.title: Asparagus
programme.desc: Andre Pachon is the leader of the French chef community in Japan. Several of his apprentices have already appeared, but this time Pachon sends his number one man.

programme.title: Pork Belly
programme.desc: The younger sibling of the Liang brothers, rulers of Cantonese cuisine in Japan, faces the Iron Chef Chinese.

programme.title: Edinburgh
programme.desc: Michelin starred Chef, Tom Kerridge takes Fred to Edinburgh for a fine dining experience at Kitchin, the Michelin starred restaurant of Chef Tom Kitchin. Kitchin specialises in showcasing Scottish ingredients, sourced from a network of suppliers to ensure that the menu really captures a taste of Scotland.

programme.title: Northeast India
programme.desc: Gordon immerses himself in the life of a local tribe in Nagaland, visits Assam to enter a housewives' competition and sets up shop on the streets of Calcutta.

programme.title: Leftovers
programme.desc: Find out why "nasty bits" deserve to be on the kitchen table.

programme.title: London
programme.desc: Travel with Chef April Bloomfield to London, where her cooking career began.

programme.title: Spain
programme.desc: This episode is all about Spain's influence on Chang's career. He visits with some of his idols--Juan Mari Arzak and Andoni Aduriz, makes fideos, salt cod omelet and a sponge cake from chef Albert Adria.

programme.title: Episode 14
programme.desc: In Lancashire, Molly is bringing her latest commission to life: a two-foot square beach scene complete with jelly sea, crispy marshmallow rocks and dozens of hand-carved bathers.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Molly tackles a cake with some bite with a giant white shark birthday cake.

programme.title: Rule 7: Think Before You Speak
programme.desc: The rule is simple, guests must take at least two bites of the dishes presented to them by host Khleo Thomas.

programme.title: Rule 8: Three's A Crowd
programme.desc: The rule is simple, guests must take at least two bites of the dishes presented to them by host Khleo Thomas.

programme.title: PASTA
programme.desc: Everybody loves pasta and so does Lidia. Today, she makes three dishes that viewers will love. Her first dish is an Orecchiette with Clams and Zucchini, made with scallions, pepperoncino and garlic. Her Spaghetti Caruso is made with a hearty sauce of mixed mushrooms, tomatoes, peas and chicken livers. She finishes with a unique dish of Rigatoni with Cauliflower, Saffron and Golden Raisins.

programme.title: Friday Final Number Four
programme.desc: Professional chefs Nigel Haworth, Atul Kochhar, Ryan Simpson and Mary Ann Gilchrist pair up with their chosen home cook partners and go head to head. Pierre Koffmann judges.

programme.title: Celebratory Food Traditions
programme.desc: Rutledge Wood and Damaris Philips find themselves in the unofficial Cajun capital of the south -- the French Louisiana region of Acadiana in Lafayette, Louisiana. Their first stop is Cafe Vermilionville for their New Orleans-inspired Crawfish 'Beignets' and Turtle Soup. Next, it's off to roadside stop Best Stop Boudin for their Boudin Blanc, Boudin Balls and fan-favorite Cracklins.

programme.title: Biloxi's Big Eats
programme.desc: In a city like Biloxi, Mississippi, it's a must to indulge in all the fresh seafood fished daily from the gulf so Damaris Philips and Rutledge Wood waste no time settling in. Their tour starts at local favorite seafood joint Hook with their fresh-caught fare like speckled trout smothered with a scratch-made Pass Christian sauce. On a visit to White Pillars, they feast on exceptional farm-to-table fare, chowing down on chicken-fried rabbit with black rice and grits.

programme.title: Special Occasion Comfort
programme.desc: Dinner worth celebrating: burgundy chicken stew with porcini-mushroom grits and pancetta, and whole roasted pork belly with fresh salsa verde.

programme.title: Comforting Family Faves
programme.desc: Nostalgia on a plate: moussaka crown, Italian herb roast halfchickens in sundriedtomato cream sauce, and velvety eggnog crème caramel.

programme.title: Canadian Comfort
programme.desc: Spencer puts a Canadian spin on comfort: meat tourtière pies, Newfoundland-style figgy duff with mapleliqueur, and West Coast salmon rolls.

programme.title: Hot Soup Comfort
programme.desc: Spencer ladles up comforting bowls, including spicy spinach and Taleggio wonton soup in chorizo broth, jerk-rubbed chicken ramen, and rich cream of mushroom soup.

programme.title: Steak Night With London Broil
programme.desc: There is nothing better than a great piece of meat! In today's episode, Lidia takes a less expensive cut, London Broil, and marinate it to perfection. Her menu includes a delicious Vegetable Patty served with green salad which works as an appetizer or by itself as a quick lunch, London Broil with Sun Dried Tomato Marinade and one of her Grandma Rosa's favorite Corn and Walnut Cake

programme.title: Rustico Italiano
programme.desc: Vanessa and Stefania plan a rustic Italian menu with a table to match! There's nonna's salad, Sunday sauce, rapini with garlic and chili, Sicilian sea bass, and so much more!

programme.title: Cooking With Beef
programme.desc: Host Dez Daniels and Manitoba Beef Producers' Anna Borys make 4 delicious recipes: Flaky Pizza Roll with Sweet & Spicy Italian Beef Sausage, Ginger Beef Egg Rolls, Carne Asada Nachos, Pulled Beef Sliders with Mango Fennel Slaw.

programme.title: The Rochester
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - The Rochester Garbage Plate! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Croque Madame
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Croque Madame! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Osijek/Clondalkin
programme.desc: This week Catherine gets a guided tour of Old Town of Tvrđa and the Old City Walls, she visits a Regional Wine Cellar in the Old Town and tastes wine from the Danube region made by wine producers from Osijek, she will listen to some traditional music on the typical traditional instrument in eastern Croatia (Slavonia), a mandolin like instrument "tamburica".

programme.title: Let's Get Lost
programme.desc: Chaing Mai, Thailand: Jumping into a Thai tuk tuk taxi, Bourdain attempts to soak up Thai culture and get lost in the cuisine of Chaing Mai. From spicy soups and noodles in the busy city, to the hospitality and delicate salads of the countryside, Tony learns to appreciate all things Thai.

programme.title: How to be a Carioca
programme.desc: Brazil: What is Carioca? These natives of Rio de Janeiro are lovable scamps who somehow find ways to avoid work altogether, preferring the beach, flirting, and hanging out at restaurants and bars. Mr. Bourdain, under the tutelage of an exemplary Carioca, gives the lifestyle a try, enjoying a savage tan, Brazilian barbecue, and one too many Caipirinhas!

programme.title: Laid Back Turkey
programme.desc: Julia learns about dates for her Cheese Stuffed dates. Also prepared -- Kentucky Ham Mousse and Laid Back Turkey with Mushroom stuffing. With Jim Cohen and Richard G. Peterson.

programme.title: Chicken: Winged Victory
programme.desc: Julia picks a plump and perfect chicken for her dinner table. A first course of Fresh Santa Barbara Shrimp is prepared by Wolfgang Puck and Richard Graff suggests wines.

programme.title: The Fenwick Arms Revisited
programme.desc: When Gordon last visited The Fenwick Arms, Sunday service was booming and Gordon's brainchild, the 'Campaign for Real Gravy', was in full swing. But times have changed and new competition is threatening The Fenwick's success.

programme.title: Celebratory Food
programme.desc: Tom prepares decadent, showstopping dishes for special occasions, including an elegant asparagus served with his ultimate salad dressing, a slow-roast duck, deep-fried oysters, spiced monkfish, and a refreshing gin and tonic granita.

programme.title: Family Food
programme.desc: Tom shares some of his family favorites inspired by simple food he enjoyed growing up that the family will absolutely love, including a flavorful omelette, a proper baked beans on toast, roast chicken, and an apple toffee crumble pie.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Huw grows native citrus fruits and collects industrial objects. Could ex-flight attendant Marianne or art lover Julie create a delicious dish to win his heart?

programme.title: Natto
programme.desc: Natto, a Japanese delicacy, is the ingredient of battle for Iron Chef Morimoto and Tatsutoshi Kumamoto.

programme.title: Pumpkin
programme.desc: Iron Chef Kobe is pitted against an unusual chef of Italian cuisine who operates out of his own food cart.

programme.title: Ladyfingers Genoise with Flo Braker
programme.desc: Flo Braker, author of two cookbooks, prepares petits fours, ladyfingers, madeleines and miniature Florentine squares.

programme.title: Pecan Sticky Buns and Savory with Nancy Silverton
programme.desc: Nancy Silverton, one of America's noted bread bakers, prepares twice-baked brioche, savory brioche pockets, pecan sticky buns and brioche tart with white secret sauce.

programme.title: Chef Eric's Culinary Classroom
programme.desc: Join world-renowned Chef Eric Crowley for his first Masterclass video series inspiring you to feel confident in the kitchen with several spectacular dishes that are easy to create.

programme.title: Tranekær Castle
programme.desc: Cuisine Royale invites us to share the dining secrets of nobility. Count and Countess Ahlefeld-Laurvig live on the Danish island of Langeland.

programme.title: Romanian Royal Court
programme.desc: The 90th Jubilee of King Michael I is being celebrated at the Romanian Royal Court.

programme.title: Alpharetta On-Trend
programme.desc: From lobster pasta to poke donuts, Alpharetta has it all! See what makes this town worth another visit, then cook a classic sweet potato souffle with Skye.

programme.title: Sugar Rush
programme.desc: We're looking at three of food's sweetest hits: incredible ice cream sundaes, cupcakes, and the king of all cookies - the chocolate chip.

programme.title: The New South
programme.desc: Damaris Philips and Rutledge Wood are all about mixing old traditions with new flavors in the mountain town of Asheville, North Carolina. Nestled in the Appalachian Mountains, Rutledge and Damaris discover hip, true-to-the-region cooking starting with a trip to Biscuit Head where they're knocking out amazing biscuit concoctions like their Country Ham Biscuit with fried green tomato and red-eye gravy.

programme.title: Battle Shiitake Mushrooms
programme.desc: Will Iron Chef Chen be ready for Takaya Nakazawa, a challenger from Shizuoka who happens to know everything about Chinese vegetarian dishes?

programme.title: Decorative Loaves with Steve Sullivan
programme.desc: Steve Sullivan, proprietor of the Acme Bread Company, prepares walnut bread and decorative loaves.

programme.title: Argentina
programme.desc: Chef Natalia Machado shares her own Christmas feast recipes and stories from her native country of Argentina to help inspire your holiday feast.

programme.title: Mayo (Castlebar) / Larnaka, Cyprus
programme.desc: In this Tastes Like Home episode, our contributors are Parents and Daughter, Lorcan + Betty and Colleen. Colleen has been living in Larnaka for 4 years now. She lives there with her husband Julian and their twin daughters, we first meet Betty and her husband Lorcan cycling on the Greenway route to find out who is the family member living away from home.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Gordon prepares a spectacular set of Christmas dishes that include his recipe for the ultimate turkey, superb stuffing, perfectly cooked vegetables and a stunning Christmas dessert. It's the Ultimate Christmas meal.

programme.title: Episode 14
programme.desc: Nastassja makes a three-foot-tall spiral cake from salted caramel and mango.

programme.title: Episode 26
programme.desc: Michelle makes a cake for a charity as Parkinson's UK celebrates its 50th anniversary.

programme.title: All About Grandma
programme.desc: Grandma Erminia's favorites grace today's menu and include a Rice & Pea Soup; a simple Prosciutto Cotto sandwich and a dish that the family finds on many Sunday menus: Baked Stuffed Shells.

programme.title: BRAISING
programme.desc: There are few things better than a great piece of meat braised in Barolo wine. When accompanied by some braised vegetables, you've got yourself a great meal. In this episode, Lidia prepares a crispy golden Italian Style Quiche followed by a fork tender Beef Braised in Barolo. Her side dish is a Braised Broccoli Rabe with garlic and extra virgin olive oil. This is a meal any family will love.

programme.title: ROASTING AND BAKING
programme.desc: The oven is on in Lidia's kitchen, and she is using it for sweet and savory dishes. To start, she makes a springtime crunchy, Cheese Roasted Asparagus dish. Next is a family favorite, Baked Eggplant with Tomatoes, created with cheese, herbs and topped with a baked egg. Then it's time for sweets as she prepares an Almond Torte with Chocolate Chips served with a mound of whipped cream.

programme.title: The Future of Food
programme.desc: The figure might bring urban farming, veganism and insect protein production.

programme.title: El, Fly, Chic
programme.desc: Dianne Smith articulates her bold artistic vision revolving around a shared historical experience, as does LeRone Wilson whose elegant, fly, and chic art truly expands the mind.

programme.title: Albert Elkerson
programme.desc: Chef Cisse Elhadji welcomes us to Renaissance Harlem, a restaurant reflective of Harlem's myriad cultures, while Kevin and Kim share the joys of operating a craft brewery. We will also meet with Albert Elkerson, a man of many talents.

programme.title: Laid Back Turkey
programme.desc: Julia learns about dates for her Cheese Stuffed dates. Also prepared -- Kentucky Ham Mousse and Laid Back Turkey with Mushroom stuffing. With Jim Cohen and Richard G. Peterson.

programme.title: episode 4
programme.desc: Rory prepares risotto alla parmagiana to start this week's three course meal. Rory follows this with a warm salad of quail with grapes, honey and bacon. and pudding is a refreshing dish of candied citrus zests.

programme.title: episode 7
programme.desc: Roast cauliflower with red onions and cumin seed and muhammara. Grilled chicken paillard with roast grapes, almonds and rosemary. Chocolate and caramel whip langues de chat.

programme.title: A Moveable Feast with America's Favorite Chefs
programme.desc: Join Jose Andres, Lidia Bastianich, Rick Bayless, Chris Kimball, Ruth Reichl and Ming Tsai as each chef cooks up a single course, shares memorable stories and samples each other's dishes at a one-of-a-kind progressive dinner party.

programme.title: Popular
programme.desc: Chef Dev shares straightforward recipes for street foods that have gained popularity around the world.

programme.title: Steak 'n' Kimchi Mac 'n' Cheese
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Steak 'n' Kimchi Mac 'n' Cheese! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Rice Bowl
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Rice Bowl! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Outlart/Boston
programme.desc: On Tastes Like Home Catherine Fulvio travels to Boston and visits the iconic Cheers Pub on Beacon Hill, previously known as the Bull & Finch Pub, she gets to experience Oyster Happy Hour in Boston's Marliave Restaurant, as well as walking the famous grounds of the prestigious Harvard University where Sarah-Jo worked.

programme.title: Estelle and Joe Zee
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle invites her friend, fashion guru Joe Zee, over for a simple Shrimp Scampi served over Angel Hair Pasta. She tops off the meal with Apple-Peach Compote and Vanilla Ice Cream. Then, British Grammy Award-winning singer Estelle comes by and Patti makes her feel right at home with her very own version of Fish and Chips with Tartar Sauce.

programme.title: Ta'Rhonda Jones and Lance Gross
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle has star power in her kitchen today. First, Ta'Rhonda Jones drops by to learn Patti's delicious Pork Chops with Sauteed Cabbage. Then, Patti refreshes her palate with actress Kaitlin Doubleday over a vegan lunch of Sauteed Portobello Mushrooms with Garlic and Butter. Finally, Patti is joined by actor Lance Gross, to help her prepare Pan-Seared Salmon served with Sauteed Green Beans "A La Bella."

programme.title: Laverne Cox and Tamron Hall
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle hangs out in the kitchen with Orange is the New Black star Laverne Cox. Patti goes fresh, tasty and delicious for this mega star, serving her sauteed red snapper with arugula, onion and heirloom tomato salad drizzled with her lemon-infused vinaigrette. Later, Tamron Hall drops by and Patti makes her Shrimp, Crab and Lobster Linguine with White Sauce -- a meal that is sure to satisfy all seafood lovers.

programme.title: Uncommon Curry
programme.desc: If mace, fenugreek, and cloves aren't at the front of your spice shelf yet, they will be by the end of this episode! Co-hosts Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim bring these spices to a trio of fabulous recipes! First, octopus gets a slow bath in mace-scented olive oil before picking up a smoky char on the grill. A refreshing Thai Mango Salad gets amped up with the big flavour of fenugreek. Lastly, lamb chops get treated to an aromatic marinade of clove-spiked basil and parsley pesto.

programme.title: Spice + Fat
programme.desc: Co-hosts Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim explore the relationship between spices and fats in three rich recipes. Juicy watermelon gets treated two ways: as a sauce and as a spicy pickle, both to top a caraway-infused Panna Cotta! Next, a lesson in infusing spice into compound butters: a zingy Za'atar and Lemon Butter for bread and a smoky Paprika and Bay Butter for Grilled Steak! Finally, flaky cod gets basted in juniper and rosemary butter before being sat on a bed of du puy lentils!

programme.title: Kerala
programme.desc: Gordon ends his travels to India by heading south, living in an ashram in Kerala and working alongside one of India's top chefs in Mumbai.

programme.title: Forest
programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik put their heads together to design a three-course menu, highlighting the gifts of the forest! Mushrooms, venison, cranberries, and - of course - black forest cake!

programme.title: Aquarius
programme.desc: Chef Siobhan is all in for Aquarius! She makes an air-themed dish for an Air Sign - Endive Salad with an Blue Cheese Foam! The next dish is sesame-crusted Tuna Tataki with kinpira. After that, she's inspired by Aquarius colour - blue - and whips up a stunning Blueberry Chimichurri to pair with some smoky grilled pork chops! Finally for the maverick of the zodiac, Siobhan doesn't have just any old dessert, she has sticky-sweet Blue Caramel Corn - with toasted sesame seeds!

programme.title: Fire & Smoke
programme.desc: See why for good BBQ, you need a good BBQ pit.

programme.title: Reunion Island
programme.desc: Discover the world through some of the most delicious and unusual dishes from countries like China, Morocco and Venezuela. In each episode, we will explore colourful local markets, discovering new flavours and regional produce. The ingredients we find will form the basis for some very special dishes that are simple to make at home.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: On tonight's menu is a simple but delicious scrambled egg with wild mushrooms, succulent bream with peas and bacon and a light summer dessert of citrus fruit with a champagne sabayon.

programme.title: The Impact
programme.desc: Food brands travel around the world, stick around and change the places they visit; once the food is adopted by eager taste buds, it becomes part of local culture and tradition.

programme.title: Salade Nicoise
programme.desc: Julia Child makes the Mediterranean salad that's a meal in itself. Lettuce, tomatoes, potatoes, beans, eggs, tuna fish, capers, anchovies -- all spiced with the authentic flavor of the Riviera, and filmed in Nice.

programme.title: Romanian Royal Court
programme.desc: The 90th Jubilee of King Michael I is being celebrated at the Romanian Royal Court.

programme.title: Family Kitchen Revival 102
programme.desc: Meet Minna Waldeck whos son, Mikey, took his life several years ago. Its been an unimaginable journey including therapy at a horse ranch.

programme.title: The Sweet Life In Vidalia
programme.desc: Take a tour around Vidalia, GA to find southern comfort food, outrageous sandwiches, and homemade donuts. Skye uses local pecans in a family recipe.

programme.title: Campfire Classics
programme.desc: Cooking over a campfire is one of life's great pleasures. And on Food's Greatest Hits we're all about Campfire Classics...hot dogs, potato chips, and some ooey gooey s'mores.

programme.title: French Fridays
programme.desc: Prepare to feast on fantastic French cuisine on Xumo Free Food TV, as top chefs cook up culinary masterpieces right in your living room!

programme.title: Wales Dessert
programme.desc: It is the dessert course and the last opportunity for the chefs to impress. Chris is hoping to triumph with another dish which showcases the foraged ingredients available around his restaurant, while Jason attempts a technical feat in his dessert inspired by a childhood hospital stay and Andrew is inspired by a dish by his great-grandmother used to cook. Which two will make it through to the judging chamber?

programme.title: Wales Judging
programme.desc: It is the Wales regional final as the two remaining chefs do everything they can to impress the judging panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. After tensions ran high in the week, the chefs are under pressure to deliver perfection. The judges are joined by Aneira Thomas, the first baby born on the NHS, who is named in tribute to the service's founder Aneurin Bevan and who went on to dedicate her life to the service. Who will win a place in the national finals?

programme.title: South West Starter
programme.desc: It's the turn of three chefs representing the south-west, including two who have competed before but meet in the kitchen this week for the very first time. The chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their celebratory starters.

programme.title: South West Fish
programme.desc: It's the fish course and with Tom renowned as a fish specialist all eyes are on him. He's cooking his take on a classic British fish supper in tribute to a charity which looks after the health of local fishermen. Jude is attempting a complex fusion dish featuring four different fish and an unusual X-Ray themed presentation, while Olivia is paying tribute to the staff who looked after her during the birth of her first son with her take on curried monkfish.

programme.title: South West Main
programme.desc: It's the main course and two of the chefs are hoping duck will win the day. Tom is preparing a technically challenging duck dish steeped in NHS history while Jude is making a multi-element Chinese duck dish inspired by his mum. Olivia is hoping her dish, using two unusual cuts of beef, will score top points. Olivia also visits her local children's hospital, home of the second-busiest paediatric A&E in the country.

programme.title: South West Dessert
programme.desc: With just one more chance to impress their veteran judge, the chefs are all hoping to use their pastry skills to deliver technically complex desserts. Tom's cooking an 'Invalid Fruit Tart' inspired by a 1950s recipe, while Jude is making six different apple elements for his 'An Apple A Day'. Olivia is using stout in reference to an outdated old wives' tale which suggested the drink was a healthy source of iron during pregnancy.

programme.title: South West Judging
programme.desc: It's time for the two remaining chefs representing the South West to go head-to-head as they cook their menus again for the exacting panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. With a spot in the National Finals at stake, both are aiming for perfection as they bid for glory. The judges are joined by Barbara Childs, a Matron in the Cardiac Intensive Care Unit at Great Ormond Street Hospital, who isn't afraid to speak her mind in the chamber.

programme.title: North West Starter
programme.desc: Three chefs take to the kitchen in a bid to represent the north-west in the national final. They include Ellis Barrie, from the award-winning Marram Grass in Anglesey, Liam Simpson-Trotman, an accomplished pastry chef and co-owner of the 4 AA rosette Orwell's in Oxfordshire, and Craig Sherrington, who sharpened his skills working under top names including Eric Chavot and is now Chef Patron of Virginia House in Cumbria.

programme.title: North West Fish
programme.desc: It's the fish course and the chefs are all gunning for tens. Craig pays tribute to a friend who has revolutionised hospital food in Morecambe Bay, while Liam is inspired by health advice his grandma gave him and Ellis is dedicating his dish to the staff who delivered his son Albert. With cod, mackerel, shrimp and cockles on the menu, which of the chefs will score highly?

programme.title: North West Main
programme.desc: Time for the chefs to cook their mains and the pressure is on. Craig is hoping to impress using two cuts of Dexter beef, while Liam prepares his take on a Bajan lamb stew and Ellis prepares four cuts of suckling pig. Liam meets his personal hero, Nola Ishmael OBE, who became the UK's first ever black Director of Nursing.

programme.title: North West Dessert
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the last chance for the North West chefs to impress in a bid to make it through to the regional final. Liam is cooking 'Not So Hot Toddy' in honour of a friend who works night shifts in the NHS, while Ellis' 'Worth Their Weight in Gold' is dedicated to the staff who saved his brother's life and Craig's dish 'The Missed Celebration' pays tribute to his wife with an unusual Christmas concept.

programme.title: North West Judging
programme.desc: The two highest scoring chefs from the week return to cook their menus again. Judging them are Matthew Fort, Oliver Peyton and Andi Oliver who are joined by Dr Jake Dunning MBE, an infectious disease specialist who has been recognised for his work during the West Africa Ebola epidemic.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Starter
programme.desc: Three chefs are doing battle to represent Northern Ireland. Tommy Heaney, Head Chef at the Great House Hotel in South Wales, is taken on by Shauna Froydenlund, Chef Patron at Marcus Wareing's two Michelin starred restaurant, and James Devine, the 2017 National Chef of the Year.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Fish
programme.desc: After a tense starter course, the chefs return to the kitchen to cook their fish dishes. James is making his elevated take on a fried chicken takeaway as a tribute to the NHS staff who care for his sister. Shauna is also taking inspiration from a personal connection with a tribute to staff from a facility in her hometown of Londonderry. Tommy is hoping to impress with a dish dedicated to the discovery of DNA.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Main
programme.desc: With two courses down it's time for the chefs to cook their main courses. It's the battle of beef with each using the same meat in their innovative creations. Tommy also meets the first baby ever born on the NHS.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Dessert
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the final chance for the chefs to impress. After such a tightly fought battle all week, each is hoping to deliver a technically perfect dessert. Tommy and James are both using passion fruit in their complex dishes while Shauna is hoping to use her pastry chef training to score full marks.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Judging
programme.desc: The two chefs representing Northern Ireland go head-to-head. Judging as ever are Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver who are joined by Shehan Hettiaratchy, lead trauma surgeon at St Mary's Hospital who helped treat victims of the Grenfell Tower fire.

programme.title: Finals Starter
programme.desc: The winning chefs from all eight regions must battle it out for the honour of a spot on 2018's 'Feast To Say Thank You' banquet menu, celebrating 70 years of the NHS, one of Britain's most prized institutions.

programme.title: Finals Fish
programme.desc: The chefs must prepare fish courses, and after some exceptionally high-scoring dishes in the starter round, everyone is desperate to deliver perfection. Once again, the chefs present their innovative, witty and heart-warming creations.

programme.title: Finals Main
programme.desc: It's main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. Both chefs and judges alike are amazed at the high standard of cooking and an incredible number of 10s are dished out as the chefs serve up venison, rabbit, duck, beef, lamb and pork for scrutiny.

programme.title: Finals Dessert
programme.desc: It's dessert day and with just one place remaining at the banquet feast, each chef is giving everything they've got for a chance to say thank you to the heroic NHS staff. All the chefs have significantly re-worked or re-invented their desserts since the regional heats, proving that they'll do everything they can in a bid for that final winning spot.

programme.title: Banquet
programme.desc: It's the grand finale as the winning chefs cook their dishes at a banquet for the heroes of the NHS. Having arrived at St Bartholomew's Hospital, the chefs are shown the incredible location for event, the almost three-hundred-year-old Great Hall.

programme.title: London and South East - Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Competing for the top spot are 3 new chefs to the competition representing some of the most exciting culinary talent from London, Paul Walsh, Luke Selby and Ben Marks.

programme.title: London and South East Mains and Desserts
programme.desc: The three chefs are halfway through their heat and the pressure is mounting. Only two will proceed to Friday's judging and have a chance to represent the London and the South East region at the regional finals.

programme.title: London and South East - Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining London chefs must cook their four-course menus again. The chefs need to impress the formidable judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: North East: Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Three chefs new to the competition compete in the North East heats. Three of the region's chefs battle it out for the top spot: Mike Carr, Samira Effa, and Tom Anglesea. The three chefs must present the menu of their careers, inspired by 50 years of British pop music.

programme.title: North East: Main and Dessert
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through their heat and will serve up their main courses and desserts. The stakes are high, and again they are each serving a unique take on the pop music brief. Mike is confident about his northern dish, 'Rack n Roll', which puts both classic Yorkshire hogget and traditional Lancashire hotpot in the spotlight.

programme.title: North East: Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four-course menus again for the judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the British pop industry's finest.

programme.title: Central Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Newcomer Kray brings an urban edge to proceedings, with a starter inspired by grime music called 'Fire in the Booth'. It combines hot sauce, veal sweetbreads and tuna belly. Returner Sabrina is compiling a dish of her favourite ingredients, including pasta and ox cheek, for her Italian inspired starter called 'My Mixtape'.

programme.title: Central Main and Dessert
programme.desc: For his main course, Ryan Simpson-Trotman is confident his dish, `The UK's Number 1', will hit the top spot with his combination of a beef pie and rump cap. Sabrina Gidda is taking inspiration from her grandad's collection of old 45s for her `Sunday Jukebox' main: pork Wellington and Black Country faggots.

programme.title: Central Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining Central chefs must cook their four-course menus again for judges food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: North West Starter and Fish
programme.desc: Competing for a place on the banquet menu are two chefs returning to the competition for a second time, plus a supremely talented newcomer. Liam Simpson, who co-owns a high-end gastropub near Henley-on-Thames, is hoping to make it all the way after being knocked out in the heats during the 2018 competition.

programme.title: North West Main and Dessert
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through the regional heats and, as the lowest scoring chef will be eliminated from the competition at the end of the show, the pressure is on. They start by cooking their all-important main courses, the centrepiece of the banquet menu. Michelin-starred newcomer Hrishikesh Desai is pushing himself to the limit with a complex multipart venison dish, inspired by the bands which play at the Kendal Calling music festival.

programme.title: North West Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from the north-west cook their dishes head to head for a panel of expert judges, in a bid to secure themselves a place in the national finals. Will they have acted on the advice given by the veteran judge earlier in the week, and learn from their mistakes?

programme.title: Scotland Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Three of Scotland's finest chefs do battle for a chance to cook at the banquet celebrating 50 Years of Popular Music. Gordon Jones, the only newcomer, faces returners Lorna McNee and Ben Reade, who are going head-to-head for the second time.

programme.title: Scotland Main and Dessert
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and desserts, each battling to produce smash hit dishes that wow their veteran. For her main, Lorna is confident her lamb dish `With A Little Help From My Friends', dedicated to supportive friends, is a celebratory dish fit for the banquet.

programme.title: Scotland Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining Scottish chefs must cook their four courses again, but this time they'll need to appeal to four new palates. Food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver plus a celebrity guest judge.

programme.title: South West Starter and Fish
programme.desc: Emily Scott is the chef proprietor of Cornwall's renowned 'St Tudy Inn'. Her two rivals are from across the sea on Jersey. Joe Baker is largely self-taught, but at just 28 already running his own restaurant, 'No 10', in St Helier. A neighbouring restaurant is Michelin starred 'Samphire' where Lee Smith is head chef.

programme.title: South West Mains and Dessert
programme.desc: Emily's David Bowie-inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes, and she uses Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Meanwhile, Joe has also sourced his ingredients locally.

programme.title: South West Judging
programme.desc: The chefs need to impress the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate. They are joined by one half of the synthpop duo The Communards, Reverend Richard Coles.

programme.title: Wales Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Tom "Westy" Westerland is a former National Chef of Wales and head chef of the Brasserie at Lucknam Park in Wiltshire. Cindy Challoner is the former head chef at prestigious teaching restaurant "The Classroom" in Cardiff. They face Andy Sheridan formerly of Sosban restaurant in Llanelli, returning to the competition for his second attempt at making it to the banquet.

programme.title: Wales Main and Dessert
programme.desc: Andy cooks venison in celebration of his favourite band, Oasis. He accompanies the loin with rhubarb and beetroot ketchup, black pudding purée, pickled beetroot and a pistachio crumb. Westy's beef dish 'The Cow Shed' is named after a former stage at the Glastonbury Festival.

programme.title: Wales Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Wales must cook their four-course menus again. They must take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their tributes to Britain's music success.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Starter and Fish

programme.title: Empire State
programme.desc: A security guard (Liam Hemsworth) and his childhood pal (Michael Angarano) make plans to rob an armored car.

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: Unable to pay back the $20,000 he owes the mob, small-time hustler Link (Antonio Fargas) instead gives up the identity of an undercover cop (Terry Carter) who happens to be dating his sister, Foxy Brown (Pam Grier). When gangsters later kill the cop, Foxy is quick to make the connection and swears vengeance. Posing as a prostitute, and with the help of a group of neighborhood vigilantes, she gradually tracks down the hit men, their Mafia bosses and her own brother.

programme.title: Thick as Thieves
programme.desc: Macklin (Alec Baldwin), a hit man with a passion for rare jazz records, accepts what he thinks is a routine job. The hit turns out to be a setup, though, because Pointy (Michael Jai White), an up-and-coming gangster, wants Macklin out of the way. When Macklin realizes who's behind the setup, the two criminals enter into an increasingly deadly cat-and-mouse game. Before long, the feud expands to include tough female cop Petrone (Rebecca De Mornay) and top Mafia bosses.

programme.title: Reclaim

programme.title: Brooklyn's Finest
programme.desc: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny.

programme.desc: The 20-year arms dealing career of Queens, N.Y., outcast Yuri Orlov (Nicolas Cage) serves as a window onto the end of the Cold War and the emergence of worldwide terrorism. He finds himself reassuring his more ethically challenged younger brother, Vitaly (Jared Leto), while adeptly sidestepping the pursuit of federal agent Jack Lawrence (Ethan Hawke). The globetrotting arms dealer also pursues the woman of his dreams, supermodel Ava Fontaine (Bridget Moynahan).

programme.title: Belly
programme.desc: Ever since they were kids, Sincere (Nas) and Buns (DMX) have lived life close to the edge, doing whatever it takes to survive. As adults, they build up their kingdom of crime on drug dealing and robbery. But Sincere grows weary of the criminal lifestyle and joins a black Muslim religious group. Buns, on the other hand, sinks deeper into criminality and faces serious prison time. The cops offer him a deal, however -- assassinate the head of the Muslim group, and he will go free.

programme.title: State Property 2
programme.desc: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone.

programme.desc: Exciting Deer hunts from around the country.

programme.title: Mass Pursuit Tv
programme.desc: Taking a look back at our great hunts in Oklahoma. Wilbur and Pro-Staffer Drew Garrison getting it done.

programme.title: Dying Breed Tv
programme.desc: Join Host Shawn Chatham for a fast-paced episode featuring highlights of Big Game hunts from the past and a great bow harvest with Robbie O'Bryan. Then we take you to Spy Ranch for some awesome CIA training with Jason Hanson.

programme.title: Surviving Mann
programme.desc: The 32 are selected; the challenge begins; who will have what it takes to survive Mann?

programme.title: Mojo Untamed
programme.desc: Terry heads to Alaska to meet with the guys of Bushwhack Alaska in hopes of calling in a giant Coastal Brown Bear. Changing weather conditions make the first day of hunting a challenge but determination and perseverance end up paying dividends.

programme.title: Game On With Blaine Anthony
programme.desc: Hunting tips and tricks from host Blaine Anthony.

programme.title: Doug Koenig's Championship Season
programme.desc: Join Shooting Pro Doug Koenig and his son Trevor as they travel to Branson, MO for the 31st Sportsman's Team Challenge National Championship. Doug is the Match Director and Trevor competes in the Pistol & Rifle stages with team Six Sigma.

programme.title: Truck N Outdoors
programme.desc: Pursuit Channel Presents: Truck N Outdoors Fishing Fun.

programme.title: Ted Nugent Spirit Of The Wild
programme.desc: This episode features a hunter at Sunrise Safaris who wanted to hunt with Ted. Later that afternoon, Ted took another mature whitetail with his Mathews.

programme.title: Hank Parker's Outdoor Magazine
programme.desc: Hank and his guest, Billy Henderson, set out for a day of nothing but doubles in the Florida Pits. It's a largemouth bonanza!

programme.title: The Spirit of Mango
programme.desc: Explores the people, cultures, and communities shaped by one of the world's most beloved fruits, revealing how mango connects livelihoods, traditions, and food across the Americas.

programme.title: Fly Rod Chronicles
programme.desc: Curtis & his wife Shelly travel to historic Cass, West Virginia to hop on a steam engine train to Bald Knob. They meet up with Skip and travel by horseback to a remote fire tower for an overnight stay before some backcountry fly-fishing!

programme.title: Bass Pro Shop's Collegiate Bass Series
programme.desc: It only takes one big bass to take home the top prize and bragging rights to the first ever 2018 Association of Collegiate Angler's Texas Lunker Challenge on Sam Rayburn Reservoir, Texas!

programme.title: Red Arrow Tv
programme.desc: After taking a hunting season off to recover from Lyme Disease, Kip Campbell is back in the saddle and on a mission in Texas to empty his whole quiver!!

programme.title: The High Road With Keith Warren
programme.desc: This week on The High Road with Keith Warren, we're in farm country of Saskatchewan, Canada where we have a mixed bag of ducks and geese on this waterfowl extravaganza.

programme.title: Jim Crowley Outdoors
programme.desc: Jim & Kirk show how effective jerkbaits can be for cold water smallmouth bass. Detailed techniques and complete equipment list are discussed.

programme.title: Slock Master
programme.desc: Pursuit Channel Presents: Slock Master 06/30/25.

programme.title: Mark Peterson's The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark and Earl Peterson head to the Lone Star State to chase big Texas whitetails.

programme.title: The Way It Was Tv
programme.desc: The WTL banquet takes center stage, providing the majority of the funds needed to spread the message of Jesus Christ across the world. This banquet is not just about hunting; it's a ministry dedicated to sharing hope and faith.

programme.desc: Alex Debogorski is trusted with a valuable load; the load-count rivalry gets personal; Austin battles his first solo heavy haul of the season.

programme.desc: Jack rushes to get out of town due to extreme temperatures on the oil fields; Darrell makes a risky decision on one of the Dalton's steepest inclines.

programme.desc: Alex hauls a dangerous load of deadly compressed gasses; Jack gets derailed by a torturous load; Austin meets a trucker stuck on Atigun Pass; Porkchop meets the boss to answer for his performance on the road.

programme.desc: Jack and Darrell make the final run to the village of Nuiqsut; Ray tries to prove he still has what it takes after a breakdown; Alex gambles with an extra large trailer to haul.

programme.title: Amor de padre
programme.desc: Reverte conoce a Roberta. Mía saldrá con Gastón para desenmascararlo. Reverte le inventa a Gandía que Mendiola es su amigo para que lo acepte como profesor. Vico discute con su papá. Mía ve a Romina besar a Miguel.

programme.title: Obligaciones
programme.desc: Miguel le pide ayuda a Santos para que Romina lo deje de acosar; Giovanni trabajará en la carnicería de su papá; Diego y Tomás creen que Giovanni fue a cuidar a su papá porque está enfermo; Gastón le advierte a Hilda que no se meta en sus asuntos.

programme.title: Acciones injustas
programme.desc: Hilda encuentra a Romina y Miguel acostados en el pasto besándose; Gandía se escandaliza al ver la estatua de Roberta; Mabel le reclama a León que obligara a Diego a declarar en su contra; Alma renuncia al contrato para modelar la ropa de Franco.

programme.title: Malentendido
programme.desc: Lupita trata de hacer que Lola sea una mujer más responsable, pero ella no planea seguir sus consejos. Franco golpea a Miguel al pensar que trató de abusar de Mía.

programme.title: Engaño descubierto
programme.desc: Mía se pone nerviosa al pensar que Miguel vivirá en su casa por un tiempo. Roberta le dice a Diego que Sol lo engaña y le entrega una dirección para que descubra que es verdad lo que dice.

programme.title: Junto a ella
programme.desc: Santos busca cualquier pretexto para estar cerca de Lupita y ella se pone nerviosa. Mía encuentra a Miguel y Romina juntos en su habitación.

programme.title: Afuera llueve
programme.desc: Pilar le llama a Mía de forma anónima para que descubra que Celina le mintió. Mía deja a Miguel afuera de su casa bajo la lluvia.

programme.title: Mentiras piadosas
programme.desc: Sol y Pilar planean incluir a Celina en su nuevo grupo de popularidad. Lupita no quiere que Lola descubra que salió con Santos. Diego golpea a Santos. Sol termina su relación con Diego, y Agustina con Giovanni. José amenaza con golpear a Raquel.

programme.title: Padre estricto
programme.desc: Mía ve un video y se da cuenta de que Celina le ha estado mintiendo para salir con un chico. León le advierte a Diego que tiene que ganar las elecciones sí o sí, o lo castigará.

programme.title: El fraude
programme.desc: Mía cuestiona a Celina por no decirle que anda con Alex. Es el día de la votación y gana Diego, pero José está segura de que hicieron fraude. Roberta trata de quejarse, pero la castigan y Reverte la consuela, mientras Alma los ve de manera extraña.

programme.title: Cuidando a Miguel
programme.desc: Miguel está muy enfermo y Mía lo cuida a pesar de todos los problemas que tienen. Diego engaña a Roberta para llevarla a su departamento y hablar con ella.

programme.title: El ladrón de la pluma
programme.desc: Romina se queda a cuidar a Miguel. Gandía pide a Diego, Giovanni y Tomás que encuentren al ladrón de su pluma. Miguel va a la escuela y Gastón lo corre, así que se esconde. Teo va al desfile de las Top Girls y se pelea con José.

programme.title: El desfile
programme.desc: Diego reconoce ante todos que hizo trampa para ganar la Presidencia. Miguel logra meterse a la escuela y habla con Mía. Roberta provoca que se le caiga la falda a Raquel. Mía se presenta en el desfile, modelando y regalando ropa de la marca Colucci.

programme.title: Sueño de amor
programme.desc: Mía y Miguel se reconcilian y le dice que siempre soñó con volver a estar así con él. Rocco le insinúa a Giovanni que ante la careta de machito que tiene, se esconde un gay. Roberta le dice a José que se está haciendo daño.

programme.title: Amigas de nuevo
programme.desc: Mía se reconcilia con Vico y Celina. Vico enfrenta a Pilar porque se entera de que ella causó su separación de Giovanni. Miguel regresa a la escuela y todos descubren que volvió con Mía. Tomás y Giovanni creen que Roberta y Diego andan a escondidas.

programme.title: Desconfianza
programme.desc: Alma sigue desconfiando de Reverte. Santos le dice a Teo que si ya no se siente bien termine con José. Roberta se entera de que Diego está diciendo que pasaron la noche juntos. Alma vuelve a ver a Octavio abrazando a Roberta y le exige que la suelte.

programme.title: Beso peligroso
programme.desc: Alma explota ante Reverte y le pide a Roberta tener cuidado con él. Lola entra al cuarto de Santos en la noche y lo besa, pero él la confunde con Lupita. Gastón descubre a Mía y a Miguel besándose.

programme.title: La mejor compañía
programme.desc: Miguel le explica a Mía que Gastón lo obligó a hacer un trabajo con Romina. Lupita le dice a Santos que la que lo besó fue Lola. Roberta le encarga a Rocco que la grabe cuando se le declare a Diego. Teo le pide a Jose que lo acompañe a ver a su mamá.

programme.title: Visita al hospital
programme.desc: Lupita recrimina a Santos por rechazar a Lola y decirle que era por ella. Teo no resiste ver a su mamá mal y sale corriendo. Lola le dice a Lupita que la detesta. Roberta exhibe un video para demostrar que Diego y ella no tienen relaciones sexuales.

programme.title: Gran ayuda
programme.desc: Miguel no acepta que Franco le pague la colegiatura para que deje de ser becado; Teo le reclama a José por decirle a Gastón que tiene asma para que no lo aceptara en el equipo de fútbol; Roberta se disculpa con Diego por lo del video.

programme.title: Grandes consejos
programme.desc: Roberta insulta a Iñaki por inventar que Diego hablaba mal de ella. Teo le da clases de equitación a Raquel; León rechaza tajantemente la idea de Diego de dedicarse a la música. Martín Octavio quiere platicar con Roberta sobre su cuadro.

programme.title: Nuevas experiencias
programme.desc: El profesor Reverte lleva a Roberta a conocer niños de la calle y así aprenda a valorar lo que tienen en la vida. Alma le reclama a Reverte por haberse llevado a Roberta sin permiso. Iñaki se vuelve el técnico de RBD.

programme.title: Una nueva banda
programme.desc: Celina le asegura a Mía que Sol es una buena persona. León lleva a cabo sus planes para lograr que Diego abandone la banda. Alma descubre que Octavio tiene un hermano gemelo.

programme.title: Una nueva vocalista
programme.desc: Diego convoca a sus compañeras para que hagan pruebas y así encontrar a las suplentes de Roberta y Lupita, debido a que ellas decidieron dejar el grupo.

programme.title: Pruebas de amor
programme.desc: Vico decide hacer la audición para ser la nueva vocalista de la banda. Lola le confiesa a Roberta el gran amor que siente por Santos. Mía logra que Sol no se quede en la banda.

programme.title: Corazones destruidos
programme.desc: Luján sufre al saber que Teo decidió terminar su relación. Diego se encela al ver a Roberta besándose con Nikki. Alma sospecha que Octavio no es el buen hombre que dice ser. Gastón lleva a cabo sus planes para deshacerse de Luján.

programme.title: Vida interesante
programme.desc: Lola sufre al saber que Santos jamás se enamorará de ella. Diego se molesta al saber que Roberta le robó sus canciones. Gastón lleva a cabo sus planes para hacerle la vida imposible a Luján.

programme.title: Verdad descubierta
programme.desc: Giovanni tiene muchos problemas para escribir una carta dirigida al director. Jose se enoja con Roberta porque no le contó que Teo la engaña con Raquel. Roberta planea destruir Rebelde. Mía logra que Selina le confiese su plan.

programme.title: La venganza
programme.desc: Diego y sus amigos hacen un plan para que Roberta vaya a su departamento. Sol vierte pegamento en el cabello de Mía. Roberta rechaza a Iñaki porque ella no quiere tener novio. Mía les muestra a sus amigas que recuperó su cama en el dormitorio.

programme.title: La huida
programme.desc: Luján quiere renunciar a la escuela. Alma se preocupa cuando encuentra una carta de Roberta donde le dice que se irá por unos días, pero Roberta ha decidido irse de manera definitiva. Roberta se deprime al recordar su solitaria infancia.

programme.title: El plan de Mia
programme.desc: Mía contrata a un estilista para que le quite el pegamento que Sol le echó en el cabello. Diego le confiesa a Iñaki que pasó la noche con Roberta. Mía cobra venganza y le juega una broma pesada a Sol.

programme.title: El gran día
programme.desc: Pascual trata de arruinar el concierto de RBD en beneficio de los niños de la calle. Roberta se las ingenia para dejar la escuela incomunicada y estropear las intenciones de Pascual. Roberta no quiere contarle a su mamá que Diego la secuestró.

programme.title: Inseguridades
programme.desc: Roberta es descubierta en la dirección por Pascual. Jose descubre que Roberta le escribió a su tutor. Alma no está segura quien es el padre de Roberta. Roberta discute con Luján porque quiere dejar el colegio.

programme.title: Viaje a París
programme.desc: Mía no quiere irse a París con su papá, pues no quiere dejar a Miguel y a la banda. Miguel trata de convencer a Mía de viajar con su padre. El padre de Mía habla con Pascual para que Alma deje de darle clases a su hija.

programme.title: El reencuentro
programme.desc: Alma le hace creer a Pascual que él podría ser el padre de Roberta. Pascual encuentra el celular que estaba desaparecido. Mia decide ayudar a Roberta y se juntan todos los miembros originales de la banda para el concierto.

programme.title: El concierto RBD
programme.desc: RBD tiene un concierto donde deben demostrar su talento. Todos los alumnos de la Elite Way participan en el concierto lo que los pone nerviosos, contentos y entusiasmados. Alma sigue pensando que Pascual puede ser el padre de Roberta.

programme.title: Emocionados
programme.desc: León lleva a la policía al concierto de RBD para impedir que su hijo cante y Roberta presenta a León como patrocinador de su presentación.

programme.title: La carta
programme.desc: Mía se despide de sus amigas, pues debe viajar con su padre, ella les pide que le entreguen una carta a Miguel. Giovanni busca a Victoria para preguntarle si sale con Rocco. Roberta comienza a llevarse bien con el nuevo novio de su mamá.

programme.title: Reclamo inesperado
programme.desc: Sabrina recrimina a Miguel porque no aceptó cantar para una niña enferma. Diego culpa a Roberta de todo lo que le pasa. Diego y Tomás le piden trabajo al papá de Giovanni en su carnicería. Vico descubre que su papá se gasta su dinero en apuestas.

programme.title: Mala relación
programme.desc: Iñaki está emocionado por la carta que le dio Roberta. Vico está muy triste y Rocco llega a consolarla. Teo habla con José para decirle que su mamá quiere verla a ella, pero ella no quiere. Celina está muy nerviosa.

programme.title: Desnudos
programme.desc: Pascual va a buscar a su hija y los persigue por toda la casa. Miguel va al hospital a buscar a Sabrina, donde ella está muy bien y hace labor social. Giovanni pide ayuda a su mamá, pero cuando llega, se avergüenza de ella mientras Diego la defiende.

programme.title: Amigo desplazado
programme.desc: Alma le propone a Martín trabajar como su bailarín y corista. Mía y Miguel se extrañan mutuamente. Pascual habla con Alma sobre la reunión de los alumnos en la que estaban desnudos, pero él tiene problemas con Galia porque se pone celosa de Alma.

programme.title: Dinero prestado
programme.desc: Vico le pide a Celina más tiempo para poder pagarle el dinero que le debe. Rocco les pregunta a Diego y a Giovanni si saben algo del papá de Vico. Una mujer llega de manera abrupta a ver a León para exigirle por su hijo.

programme.title: Madre desesperada
programme.desc: La mamá de Diego regresa para verlo, pero León no se lo permite. Vico empeña la pulsera de la amistad que le regaló Mía para conseguir dinero y dárselo a su papá.

programme.title: Amor del pasado
programme.desc: Vico le inventa a Rocco que es amante de un anciano y ella es la que le da dinero; Sol se enoja al no ser elegida como modelo para una campaña; Alma acusa a Reverte de homosexual por acosar a Iñaki; Diego amenaza con matar a la profesora Julia.

programme.title: Madre insoportable
programme.desc: Gandía le aclara a Alma que Reverte no es homosexual. Alma le confirma a Gandía que Roberta no es su hija. León amenaza a Mabel con lastimar a Diego si se atreve a buscarlo. Diego le exige a Roberta que le diga cómo supo del enema que le hicieron.

programme.title: Importante entrevista
programme.desc: El padre de Sabrina quiere hacerles una entrevista al grupo RBD, lo que pone a los chicos muy felices, pero ella lo que busca es acercarse más a Miguel.

programme.title: Pelea por amor
programme.desc: Diego se enoja con Tomás al descubrir que fue él quien dijo lo de su enema. Celina recrimina a Sol por alejar a Alan de ella. Diego confiesa que extraña a su mamá. Teo golpea a Gastón por maltratar a Jose. Rocco cree que Vico consume drogas.

programme.title: Mentira descubierta
programme.desc: Las chicas están en una reunión con la maestra Fátima, la cual dice que ella está para dirigirlas en su equipo de porristas sustituyendo a Alma.

programme.title: Un buen plan
programme.desc: Roberta hace un plan para que José tenga una cita en el departamento de Diego y demostrarle a Teo que ya lo olvidó. Mía discute con su padre y él le dice que cambie esa cara pesada.

programme.title: Lugar secreto
programme.desc: Sol le dice a Ana que si no ha visto a Celina, aprovecha también para decirle que ella está para servir en la escuela entonces le pide una orden de alimentos larga.

programme.title: Nuevo novio
programme.desc: El papá de Rocco por fin conoce a su novia Victoria y le dice que se ve mejor sin sus lentes obscuros, ya que es de mala educación tenerlos puestos y más si no hay rayos del sol.

programme.title: Importante apuntes
programme.desc: Celina gana un concurso en el que participa en la radio y Pascual le dice que hay un tipo que pregunta por ella y resulta que es el cantante Ricardo Montaner.

programme.title: Amistad en peligro
programme.desc: Victoria llora en un pasillo de la escuela, a lo lejos. Mía se da cuenta y le dice que le cuente qué es lo que le pasa.

programme.title: Ropa cara
programme.desc: Roberta entra al examen de Diego para distraer a la maestra de Literatura y la maestra le dice que es mentira lo que dice.

programme.title: Malos entendidos
programme.desc: Mía se molesta con Miguel porque no usa el traje que le regaló y prefiere ir con una chamarra y jeans, sin importarle que van a la ópera.

programme.title: Enfrentamiento
programme.desc: Gastón enfrenta a Roberta debido a que él, con el pretexto de buscar a José, irrumpe en su dormitorio a horas inapropiadas con violencia.

programme.title: Caridad
programme.desc: Todos los chicos le donan ropa a Sabrina para los niños del hospital, Jack emocionado le dice a Miguel que ya quiere volver a ver a Sabrina, el dinero que recauden es para medicinas de los niños del hospital.

programme.title: Secretos entre amigas
programme.desc: Mía les cuenta a Celina y Vico que estuvo a punto de entregarse con Miguel, pero que Gastón casi los descubre. León sorprende a Diego y sus amigos intentando salir del colegio. Vico tiene dificultades con su padre. Jose sufre al ver a Raquel y Teo.

programme.title: Las argucias de Sol
programme.desc: Diego y Giovanni le dicen a Tomás que Sol lo engaña, pero Sol le dice que sus amigos los quieren separar porque están interesados en ella y Tomás la perdona.

programme.title: Protesta estudiantil
programme.desc: Los alumnos hacen una protesta, pues con el entrenamiento de fútbol no tienen tiempo de estudiar. Roberta propone entrenar los fines de semana y todos se ponen en su contra.

programme.desc: Tagg (Jimmy Hawkins) protests having to entertain Lofty's (Brad Johnson) 10-year-old niece. With Melinda Plowman, Gail Davis.
